intro.en: Custom spiral coiled cable assemblies balance retracted package, working extension, restoring force, cable construction, endpoints and a defined motion cycle.
intro.zh: 定制螺旋卷线电缆组件需要平衡收缩包络、工作拉伸、回弹力、线缆结构、端点与明确动作循环。

knowledge.en: A coiled cord is a complete moving cable system; extension ratio, force and life cannot be selected independently.
knowledge.zh: 卷线是一套完整运动线缆系统，拉伸倍率、作用力与寿命不能相互独立选择。

notes.en: Provide retracted and working dimensions, coil geometry, both endpoints, circuits, restoring force, environment and motion profile.
notes.zh: 请提供收缩与工作尺寸、线圈几何、两端接口、回路、回弹力、环境与动作谱。

delivery.en: Release records the cable build, coil dimensions, tail directions, endpoints, forming conditions and agreed dimensional, electrical and cycle evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线缆结构、线圈尺寸、尾段方向、端点、成型条件与约定的尺寸、电气及循环证据。

subtitle.en: Reach when the equipment moves. Recover when it returns.
subtitle.zh: 设备移动时延伸，归位后有序回收

lead.en: Balance reach, force, stored strain and installed space as one system.
lead.zh: 将可达距离、作用力、储存应变与安装空间作为一个系统平衡。

intro.en: Custom ultrasonic-welded branch harnesses combine specified conductors into compact solid-state splices through a validated preparation, tooling, parameter, protection and inspection process.
intro.zh: 定制超声波焊接分支线束通过经过验证的备线、工装、参数、防护与检验工艺，把规定导体组合成紧凑固相焊点。

knowledge.en: The released weld window belongs to the exact wire combination, tooling and equipment; a material or size change requires review.
knowledge.zh: 放行焊接窗口属于准确线材组合、工装与设备，更换材料或线径需要重新审核。

notes.en: Provide every wire material and area, circuit, branch geometry, strip and protection needs, environment, standard, quantity and validation limits.
notes.zh: 请提供每根线材与截面积、回路、分支几何、剥线和防护、环境、标准、数量与验证限值。

delivery.en: Release records wire stack, preparation, nugget limits, tooling, machine, parameter window, protection and inspection evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线材叠放、备线、焊点限值、工装、设备、参数窗口、防护与检验证据。

introduction.zh: 经过验证的固相分支焊点

faq.zh: 超声波焊接分支常见问题

subtitle.en: A compact branch comes from a validated process window
subtitle.zh: 紧凑分支焊点来自经过验证的工艺窗口

lead.en: Control wire input, placement, tooling, parameters and evidence as one process.
lead.zh: 将线材输入、摆放、工装、参数与证据作为一套工艺控制。

intro.en: Custom EMI-shielded cable assemblies coordinate cable geometry, foil or braid, connector termination, bonding, ferrites and defined validation around the real noise source and coupling path.
intro.zh: 定制 EMI 屏蔽电缆组件围绕真实噪声源与耦合路径，协同定义线缆几何、铝箔或编织、连接器端接、搭接、铁氧体与验证。

knowledge.en: Shielding is a system path; coverage, endpoint continuity, enclosure bonding, routing and frequency determine performance.
knowledge.zh: 屏蔽是一条系统路径，覆盖、端点连续性、机壳搭接、走线与频率共同决定性能。

notes.en: Provide the source, victim circuit, frequency range, interfaces, route, grounding architecture, environment and target test method.
notes.zh: 请提供噪声源、受扰回路、频率范围、接口、走线、接地架构、环境与目标测试方法。

delivery.en: Release records pair geometry, shield construction, endpoint termination, ferrite details, grounding notes and agreed inspection or EMC evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线对几何、屏蔽结构、端点端接、铁氧体细节、接地说明与约定检验或 EMC 证据。

faq.zh: EMI 屏蔽电缆常见问题

subtitle.en: Control the coupling path, not only the cable appearance
subtitle.zh: 控制耦合路径，而不只是改变线缆外观

lead.en: Define source, victim, path, endpoints and validation as one system.
lead.zh: 将噪声源、受扰对象、路径、端点与验证作为一个系统定义。

intro.en: Custom FTDI cable assemblies combine USB conversion electronics, a defined serial electrical layer, purpose-built endpoints and project-specific validation.
intro.zh: 定制 FTDI 电缆组件将 USB 转换电子器件、明确串行电气层、专用端点与项目特定验证结合起来。

knowledge.en: An FTDI cable is an active electronic assembly; connector appearance does not prove protocol, voltage, pinout or driver identity.
knowledge.zh: FTDI 线属于有源电子组件，接口外观不能证明协议、电平、针脚或驱动身份。

notes.en: Provide the host, target equipment, pin map, serial layer, I/O voltage, signals, driver behavior, protection and validation method.
notes.zh: 请提供主机、目标设备、针脚表、串行电气层、I/O 电平、信号、驱动行为、防护与验证方法。

delivery.en: Release records electronics, programmed configuration, cable BOM, endpoints, circuit map, labels and agreed passive and active tests.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录电子器件、编程配置、线缆 BOM、端点、回路图、标签及约定的被动与有源测试。

introduction.en: USB to a Precisely Defined Serial Interface
introduction.zh: 从 USB 到被准确说明的串行接口

faq.zh: FTDI 电缆组件常见问题

subtitle.en: USB on one side, a defined serial interface on the other
subtitle.zh: 一端是 USB，另一端必须是被准确说明的串行接口

lead.en: Define electronics, electrical layer, pinout, endpoint and software as one product.
lead.zh: 将电子器件、电气层、针脚、端点与软件作为一个产品定义。

intro.en: Custom waterproof wire harnesses are developed as complete sealed systems around the real exposure, mating state, cable entries, branches and agreed validation.
intro.zh: 定制防水设计线束需要围绕真实暴露、插合状态、出线、分支与约定验证，作为完整密封系统开发。

knowledge.en: IP67, IP68 and IP69K are different defined test questions; a component rating does not automatically transfer to a complete harness.
knowledge.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 对应不同规定试验，元件等级不会自动转移到完整线束。

notes.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, cable diameters, unused cavities, orientation, exposure, movement and required test method.
notes.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚表、线缆外径、空腔、方向、暴露、运动与所需试验方法。

delivery.en: Release records the sealing stack, preparation dimensions, assembly controls and project-specific evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录密封链、备线尺寸、装配控制与项目特定证据。

subtitle.en: Water follows every unfinished path
subtitle.zh: 水会沿着每一条未封闭路径前进

lead.en: Define the complete sealed system before production.
lead.zh: 生产前定义完整密封系统。

intro.en: Custom panel-mount and bulkhead cable assemblies turn a cable end into a defined equipment interface, with the connector, cutout, hardware, seal, cable construction and validation engineered together.
intro.zh: 定制面板安装与隔板电缆组件，将线端变成边界清晰的设备接口，并将连接器、开孔、五金、密封、线缆结构与验证协同开发。

knowledge.en: Panel mounting describes installation, not signal capability, ingress protection or an interchangeable connector family.
knowledge.zh: 面板安装描述安装方式，并不自动代表信号能力、防护等级或通用接口。

notes.en: Provide the exact interface, panel material and thickness, cutout drawing, mounting side, hardware, route, environment and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确接口、面板材料与厚度、开孔图、安装方向、紧固件、路径、环境及测试要求。

delivery.en: Approve mechanical fit, interface sample, sealing stack, circuit map and project-specific test evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认机械配合、接口样件、密封叠层、回路图及项目特定测试证据。

faq.zh: 面板安装电缆常见问题

subtitle.en: Design the equipment boundary, not only the cable ends
subtitle.zh: 设计设备边界，不只是线缆两端

lead.en: Coordinate both sides of the panel as one interface.
lead.zh: 将面板两侧作为一个接口协同定义。

intro.en: Custom Micro-D cable assemblies for compact aerospace, defense, instrumentation, medical and industrial electronics, with defined interface, circuit map, cable construction, retention, shielding and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向紧凑型航空航天、国防、仪器、医疗及工业电子设备定制 Micro-D 电缆组件，明确接口、回路图、线缆结构、锁紧、屏蔽与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Micro-D identifies a miniature connector family, not a complete cable or qualification statement.
knowledge.zh: Micro-D 标识微型连接器家族，并不等于完整电缆规范或资质声明。

notes.en: Provide exact mating references, contact arrangement, wiring view, cable construction, hardware, route and acceptance requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确对插料号、触点排列、接线视图、线缆结构、锁紧件、路径及验收要求。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, termination sample, mechanical configuration and electrical inspection evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认接口清单、端接样品、机械配置与电气检验证据。

subtitle.en: High-density miniature interconnects, fully defined
subtitle.zh: 高密度微型互连，也要完整定义

lead.en: Define the complete mechanical, electrical and documentation system before production.
lead.zh: 生产前定义完整的机械、电气与文件体系。

intro.en: Custom FFC and FPC cable assemblies for displays, cameras, control panels and compact equipment, with defined pitch, contact side, tail geometry, mating, routing and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向显示、摄像、控制面板与紧凑设备定制 FFC 和 FPC 电缆组件，明确节距、触点面、尾端几何、插接、布线与检验要求。

knowledge.en: FFC and FPC are related flexible interconnects, but their construction, thickness, copper geometry and connector compatibility are not interchangeable by name.
knowledge.zh: FFC 与 FPC 都属于柔性互连，但结构、厚度、铜路几何及接头兼容性不能仅凭名称互换。

notes.en: Provide both endpoint references, pitch, circuits, contact-side views, tail dimensions, installed route, motion duty and inspection requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供两端接口、节距、回路数、触点面视图、尾端尺寸、安装路径、运动工况与检验要求。

delivery.en: Approve the cable drawing, connector system, mating method, routing sample and electrical evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认线缆图纸、接头体系、对插方法、布线样品与电气证据。

subtitle.en: Interface geometry, mating, flex routing and controlled inspection
subtitle.zh: 接口几何、对插、弯折布线与受控检验

lead.en: Define the complete flexible interconnect before production.
lead.zh: 生产前定义完整柔性互连体系。

intro.en: Custom IDC ribbon cable assemblies for board-to-board, panel and internal equipment connections with defined cable geometry, orientation, tooling and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向板间、面板及设备内部连接定制 IDC 扁平排线组件，明确线缆几何、方向、工装与检验要求。

knowledge.en: IDC is a termination method, not one universal connector or cable specification.
knowledge.zh: IDC 是端接方法，并不是一种通用接头或排线规范。

notes.en: Provide the mating interface, pitch, circuit count, AWG, pin map, orientation, dimensions, route and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供对插接口、节距、回路数、AWG、针脚表、方向、尺寸、路径与测试要求。

delivery.en: Approve cable, connectors, tooling, first-article orientation and continuity evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认排线、接头、工装、首件方向与导通证据。

introduction.en: Define the Interface Before Mass Termination
introduction.zh: 批量端接前先定义完整接口

subtitle.en: Pitch, orientation, tooling and circuit verification
subtitle.zh: 节距、方向、工装与回路验证

lead.en: Coordinate the cable geometry, contact system, pin map and installation route.
lead.zh: 协同排线几何、接点系统、针脚映射与安装路径。

intro.en: Custom PTFE-insulated wire and cable assemblies for high-temperature instruments, sensors, heaters and compact equipment, with defined materials, stripping, termination and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向高温仪器、传感器、加热设备与紧凑装置定制 PTFE 绝缘电线及电缆组件，明确材料、剥线、端接与检验要求。

knowledge.en: PTFE is a material family identifier, not a complete wire or termination specification.
knowledge.zh: PTFE 是材料体系标识，并不是完整的线材或端接规范。

notes.en: Provide the exact wire specification, conductor construction, terminal system, route, temperature zones and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确线材规范、导体结构、端子体系、布线路径、温区及试验要求。

delivery.en: Approve materials, tooling, first article and controlled inspection evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认物料、工装、首件及受控检验证据。

introduction.en: Define the Wire Before the Termination
introduction.zh: 先定义线材，再定义端接

faq.zh: PTFE 电缆端接常见问题

subtitle.en: Material identity, controlled stripping and reliable termination
subtitle.zh: 材料识别、受控剥线与可靠端接

lead.en: Coordinate the exact wire, terminal, process, route and acceptance plan.
lead.zh: 协同准确线材、端子、工艺、路径与验收计划。

intro.en: Custom molded cable exits that manage pull, bend and torsion through coordinated geometry, resin compatibility, insert control and validation.
intro.zh: 通过协同几何、树脂相容性、嵌件控制与验证，定制管理拉力、弯曲与扭转的注塑出线结构。

knowledge.en: A cable boot is a controlled mechanical transition between a rigid interface and a flexible cable.
knowledge.zh: 线缆护套是刚性接口与柔性线缆之间的受控机械过渡。

notes.en: Provide insert and cable drawings, jacket construction, installed bend envelope, environment and test method.
notes.zh: 提供嵌件与线缆图纸、护套结构、安装弯曲包络、环境与试验方法。

delivery.en: Approve tooling, first article, critical dimensions and mechanical/electrical evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认模具、首件、关键尺寸以及机械与电气证据。

introduction.en: A Small Boot Carries a Large Mechanical Job
introduction.zh: 一个小护套，承担完整的机械任务

faq.zh: 注塑应力消除常见问题

subtitle.en: Load transfer, bend control and verified overmolding
subtitle.zh: 载荷转移、弯曲控制与受验证包覆成型

lead.en: Coordinate the cable, insert, resin, geometry and test plan as one system.
lead.zh: 把线缆、嵌件、树脂、几何与试验计划作为一个系统协同。

intro.en: Custom fine-pitch wire-to-board and compact sensor harnesses using project-approved 32AWG or other fine conductors.
intro.zh: 采用项目认可的 32AWG 或其他细导体制作细间距板端与紧凑传感线束。

knowledge.en: Fine geometry requires exact control of contact, wire, stripping, crimping, insertion and strain relief.
knowledge.zh: 精细几何需要准确控制触点、线材、剥线、压接、装壳与应力释放。

notes.en: Provide complete connector references, wire construction, circuit map, routing envelope and inspection limits.
notes.zh: 提供完整接口料号、线材结构、回路图、布线包络与检验限值。

delivery.en: Approve the crimp setup, sample, magnified inspection and electrical test records before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认压接设置、样品、放大检验与电气测试记录。

introduction.zh: 尺寸更小，工程定义不能更少

subtitle.en: Fine wire, micro terminals and controlled assembly
subtitle.zh: 细导体、微型端子与受控装配

lead.en: Define the complete miniature connection system.
lead.zh: 定义完整微型连接体系。

intro.en: Custom fuse-holder, battery-feed and power-distribution harnesses built around specified Littelfuse or Eaton Bussmann components.
intro.zh: 围绕指定 Littelfuse 或 Eaton Bussmann 元件制作熔断器座、电池馈电与配电线束。

knowledge.en: Fuse, holder, conductor, busbar, enclosure and fault conditions form one protection system.
knowledge.zh: 熔断器、底座、导体、母排、外壳与故障条件共同构成保护系统。

notes.en: Provide exact part numbers, circuit duty, fault current, cable sizes, environment and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 提供准确料号、回路工况、故障电流、线缆规格、环境与验证要求。

delivery.en: Approve the schematic, BOM, sample, torque and electrical inspection records before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认原理图、BOM、样品、扭矩及电气检验记录。

subtitle.en: Fuse selection, power distribution and controlled validation
subtitle.zh: 熔断器选型、配电与受控验证

lead.en: Define the complete protection system before production.
lead.zh: 生产前定义完整保护系统。

intro.en: Custom wire harnesses using specified Panduit terminals, cable ties, identification and routing components, reviewed by exact part number, material and installation method.
intro.zh: 采用指定 Panduit 端子、扎带、标识及布线部件制作定制线束，并按准确料号、材料与安装方法审核。

knowledge.en: A component family name does not define a complete harness; control the circuit, conductor, route, installation and acceptance method together.
knowledge.zh: 部件系列名称不能定义完整线束，仍需共同控制回路、导体、路径、安装与验收方法。

notes.en: Provide original part numbers, wire range, bundle diameter, environment, drawings and the approved substitution boundary.
notes.zh: 提供原始料号、适用线径、束径、环境、图纸及认可替代边界。

delivery.en: Approve the component schedule, harness-board baseline, workmanship sample and inspection record before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认部件清单、线束板基准、工艺样品及检验记录。

subtitle.en: Termination, bundling, identification and routing
subtitle.zh: 端接、捆扎、标识与布线

lead.en: Control the complete component and harness system.
lead.zh: 控制完整部件与线束系统。

intro.en: Custom Phoenix-interface terminal, sensor and equipment harnesses, with defined pinouts, conductor preparation and installation requirements.
intro.zh: 定制 Phoenix 接口端子、传感器及设备线束，明确针脚、导体处理及安装要求。

knowledge.en: Identify the exact terminal, circular or heavy-duty interface before defining conductor preparation, protection and test requirements.
knowledge.zh: 先识别准确的端子、圆形或重载接口，再定义导体处理、防护与检验要求。

notes.en: Provide the mating reference, wiring view, conductor range, installation environment and required approval method.
notes.zh: 提供对插料号、接线视图、导体范围、安装环境及所需认可方法。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, workmanship sample and controlled inspection record before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前认可接口清单、工艺样品及受控检验记录。

subtitle.en: Interface selection, conductor preparation and controlled installation
subtitle.zh: 接口选型、导体处理与受控安装

lead.en: A controlled assembly links the exact interface to its conductor, mating equipment and operating environment.
lead.zh: 受控组件需要把准确接口与导体、对插设备及工作环境联系起来。

intro.en: Custom Binder-interface sensor, data and equipment cables, with specified coding, pinouts, materials and installation support.
intro.zh: 定制 Binder 接口传感、数据及设备电缆，明确编码、针脚、材料与安装支撑。

knowledge.en: Select the exact family, coding and protection condition before defining the cable.
knowledge.zh: 定义电缆前，先选择准确系列、编码及防护条件。

notes.en: Provide mating references, wiring views, lengths and the actual environment.
notes.zh: 提供对插料号、接线视图、长度及实际环境。

delivery.en: Approve the sample and controlled material and inspection documents.
delivery.zh: 认可样品及受控物料、检验文件。

introduction.en: Binder Cable Assemblies: Selection, Installation and Service
introduction.zh: Binder 电缆组件：选型、安装与维护

subtitle.en: Connector families, material decisions and field-ready wiring
subtitle.zh: 接头系列、材料决策与现场布线

lead.en: Binder-compatible wiring covers a broad set of signal, data and power connections. The right design starts with the actual interface and follows the cable through the equipment: how it is mounted, exposed, moved and serviced. This guide explains the family choices, materials, applications and production details that turn a connector selection into a controlled cable assembly.
lead.zh: Binder 兼容布线覆盖多种信号、数据及供电连接。合适设计从实际接口开始，并沿电缆在设备内的路径考虑安装、暴露、运动及维护。以下介绍系列选择、材料、应用与生产细节，说明如何将接头选型转化为受控电缆组件。

openingCaption.en: Ultrasonic sensor illustrates the equipment end of a sensor connection.
openingCaption.zh: 超声传感器展示传感连接的设备端。

title.en: Binder Connector Cables: More Than One Interface
title.zh: Binder 连接电缆：不止一种接口

copy.en: This category covers sensor leads, equipment extensions, panel feedthroughs, distribution branches and power or data connections built around specified Binder interfaces. A connector family name is not a complete cable definition. Identify the mating part, circuit, cable construction, length and installation environment together. Super Smile reviews original components and approved alternatives separately, with the supplied part references and required inspection recorded before production.
copy.zh: 本小类覆盖围绕指定 Binder 接口制作的传感器引线、设备延长线、面板穿通、分配支路及供电或数据连接。接头系列名称不是完整电缆定义，应共同识别对插件、回路、线缆结构、长度与安装环境。超斯迈尔分别审核原装零件和认可替代件，在生产前记录所供应料号及所需检验。

caption.en: Industrial network converter shows one equipment interface context.
caption.zh: 工业网络转换器展示设备接口应用。

title.en: M8: Compact Sensor and Actuator Wiring
title.zh: M8：紧凑传感器与执行器布线

copy.en: Binder 768 and 718 series include M8 automation connections with different contact counts and cable or panel configurations. Small size is useful near sensors, but access to the coupling and cable bend must still be checked. Confirm the complete reference, straight or angled exit and appropriate conductor range. More contacts within a similar envelope do not imply the same current rating or identical installation clearances.
copy.zh: Binder 768、718 系列包含不同触点数量及线端、面板配置的 M8 自动化连接。小尺寸适合传感器附近空间，但仍需检查锁紧操作及线缆弯曲位置。应确认完整料号、直出或弯出形式和适用导体范围；相近外形内增加触点，不代表电流额定值或安装间隙相同。

caption.en: Compact inductive switch illustrates sensor installation space; not a Binder M8 part reference.
caption.zh: 紧凑电感开关说明传感器安装空间，不作为 Binder M8 料号参考。

title.en: M12 A-Coding: Define the Sensor Circuit
title.zh: M12 A 编码：明确传感器回路

copy.en: The 713 and 763 M12-A families provide cable and panel connections for many automation configurations. A-coding identifies the mating geometry, not one universal wiring map. Confirm pin count, contact gender, circuit assignment and panel mounting thread. A prewired receptacle tail also needs the correct length and end preparation. Compare the front mating view with the equipment drawing before transferring a pinout to the manufacturing document.
copy.zh: 713、763 M12-A 系列为多种自动化配置提供线端及面板连接。A 编码识别对插几何，并不代表统一接线图。应确认针数、触点公母、回路分配及面板安装螺纹；预接线插座尾线还需匹配长度与末端处理。将针脚写入制造文件前，应先用前端对插视图核对设备图纸。

caption.en: Cylindrical proximity sensor: confirm the actual connector and circuit separately.
caption.zh: 圆柱接近传感器，实际接口及回路须另行确认。

title.en: M12 D and X: Match the Data Channel
title.zh: M12 D 与 X：匹配数据通道

copy.en: D- and X-coded M12 systems serve different Ethernet channel arrangements. They differ in contact layout and shielding architecture, so an adapter must preserve the intended pairs rather than merely join numbered pins. Binder 825 and 876 references include data-connection variants; select the exact termination and cable construction. Connector capability is not a promise of complete-channel speed: cable length, pair handling and the other interface remain part of the verification.
copy.zh: D、X 编码 M12 系统面向不同以太网通道结构，触点布局及屏蔽架构不同，因此转接组件应保留预定线对，而不只是连接相同编号。Binder 825、876 参考系列包含数据连接版本，应选择准确端接与线缆结构。接头能力不代表完整通道速率承诺，线长、线对处理及另一端接口都属于验证范围。

caption.en: Industrial Ethernet switch and installed network cabling.
caption.zh: 工业以太网交换机及现场网络布线。

title.en: K and L Coding: Separate AC and DC Power
title.zh: K 与 L 编码：区分交流与直流供电

copy.en: M12 power connectors are not interchangeable with signal-coded versions. Binder K-coded configurations address AC supply, while L-coded configurations address DC supply. Confirm protective or functional earth requirements from the exact device circuit, not cable color alone. Conductor size, terminal range, load profile and temperature rise require joint review. The connector rating does not remove the need for suitable protection and installation rules in the finished equipment.
copy.zh: M12 供电接头不能与信号编码版本互换。Binder K 编码配置用于交流供电，L 编码配置用于直流供电。应依据具体设备回路确认保护接地或功能接地需求，不能只凭线色判断。导体尺寸、端接范围、负载特征及温升需共同审核，接头额定值不能代替整机适当的保护与安装要求。

caption.en: Servo training equipment illustrates separate power and control connections.
caption.zh: 伺服教学设备展示供电与控制连接的区分。

title.zh: 卡扣、卡口与 ELC 系列

copy.en: Not every Binder interface uses a threaded metal coupling. Snap-in and bayonet families provide other handling options, including selected medical-grade versions. The 570 ELC uses a snap-in mechanism with a plastic housing; 620, 720 and 770 are separate systems. Check the release action, keying, cable grip and specified protection of the exact version. A medical-grade component designation does not certify the complete device or establish compatibility with every cleaning agent.
copy.zh: 并非所有 Binder 接口都采用金属螺纹锁紧，卡扣与卡口系列提供其他操作方式，其中包含指定医疗级版本。570 ELC 使用塑料外壳及卡扣机构，620、720、770 则是不同系统。应核对具体版本的解锁动作、键位、电缆夹持及规定防护。医疗级元件名称不会认证整机，也不能证明适应所有清洁剂。

caption.en: Tuchel circular connectors illustrate differing coupling geometries, not Binder snap-in or ELC products.
caption.zh: Tuchel 圆形接头用于观察不同锁紧几何，并非 Binder 卡扣或 ELC 产品。

title.en: Materials and Workmanship: Control the Interface
title.zh: 材料与工艺：控制接口细节

copy.en: Incoming parts should match the approved reference, finish and dimensional requirements. During assembly, control stripping, termination, contact seating and cable support; a visually neat jacket cannot compensate for a damaged strand or incomplete contact insertion. Record the inspection points that matter to this configuration. Where an ingress or mechanical test is required, agree its method and acceptance criteria rather than assuming every assembly receives every possible laboratory test.
copy.zh: 来料应符合认可料号、表面及尺寸要求。装配时需控制剥线、端接、端子到位与电缆支撑；外观整齐的护套不能补偿导体损伤或端子未完全插入。应记录对本配置有意义的检验点，若需要防护或机械试验，应约定方法及验收标准，而不是默认每个组件都进行所有实验室测试。

caption.en: Contact crimp tool; the correct tool and terminal combination must be specified.
caption.zh: 触点压接工具，需规定正确工具与端子的组合。

copy.en: Start with the equipment topology: which sensors remain on the machine, which modules are removed and where the cabinet boundary lies. This determines whether a direct lead, extension, splitter or panel feedthrough is useful. Keep installation datums and branch lengths unambiguous. The practical aim is a repeatable circuit that can be installed and serviced without forcing the cable across a sharp edge, hot surface or moving component.
copy.zh: 从设备连接关系开始：哪些传感器固定在机器上，哪些模块需要拆卸，控制柜边界位于哪里。这决定采用直连引线、延长、分线或面板穿通是否合适。安装基准与分支长度应清楚，实际目标是形成可重复的回路，使安装及维修时不必强迫电缆跨越锐边、热表面或运动部件。

caption.en: Cable identification equipment illustrates circuit tracing during installation.
caption.zh: 电缆识别设备说明安装中的回路核对。

copy.en: For a medical-equipment project, identify whether the cable is internal, operator handled or patient adjacent. These positions create different material and documentation requirements. Connector color and keying can support identification, while jacket selection should follow the specified cleaning process. Repeated wiping, fluid exposure and storage bends should be described before sampling. Required device-safety or cleaning validation remains a project-specific requirement, not a consequence of selecting a familiar connector brand.
copy.zh: 医疗设备项目应识别电缆属于内部布线、操作者手持还是患者附近连接，不同位置带来不同材料及文件要求。接头颜色和键位可辅助识别，护套则应跟随规定清洁工艺。打样前应说明反复擦拭、液体暴露及存放弯折；所需整机安全或清洁验证属于项目要求，不是选用熟悉品牌后自动获得的结果。

caption.en: Cleaning-wipe context; chemical compatibility must be confirmed for the actual assembly.
caption.zh: 清洁湿巾作为维护场景参考，实际组件须确认化学兼容性。

title.en: Outdoor Connections: Review Every Entry Path
title.zh: 户外连接：审核每一条进入路径

copy.en: Rain may reach the mating face, rear cable entry, enclosure joint or an open branch. Define all of those boundaries before selecting a sealing configuration. The same lead may also experience sunlight, cold starts and vibration, which an ingress code alone does not describe. Plan cable support and drainage so liquid is not encouraged toward an unsealed end. Any environmental test should represent the intended assembled condition.
copy.zh: 雨水可能到达对插面、尾部进线、机壳接缝或开放分支，选密封配置前应明确所有边界。同一引线还可能经历日晒、低温启动及振动，而防护代码不能独自描述这些条件。应规划电缆支撑及排水，避免液体被引向未密封末端；环境试验应对应预定装配状态。

caption.en: Outdoor monitoring sensor exposed to a real field environment.
caption.zh: 真实户外环境中的监测传感器。

title.en: Cable Construction: Load, Signal and Motion
title.zh: 线缆结构：负载、信号与运动

copy.en: Choose the conductor from load, voltage drop, termination range and the installation duty. For a data channel, preserve the required pairs and shielding; thinner insulation alone does not suppress interference. PVC and PUR are construction choices with grade-specific properties, not universal performance rankings. Verify the actual jacket diameter against the connector entry. Static bending, repeated flexing and torsion must be distinguished when evaluating a cable for moving equipment.
copy.zh: 应依据负载、压降、端接范围及安装工况选择导体。数据通道需保留规定线对和屏蔽，单纯减薄绝缘不能抑制干扰。PVC 与 PUR 是具有具体牌号属性的结构选择，并非通用性能排名。实际护套外径应匹配接头进线口，为运动设备评估线缆时，应区分静态弯曲、反复弯折及扭转。

caption.en: Copper-tape shielded cable cross-section illustrates layered construction, not a specified Binder cable size.
caption.zh: 铜带屏蔽电缆截面展示分层结构，并非指定 Binder 线缆规格。

copy.en: Metal and polymer housings solve different mechanical, handling and environmental requirements. Use the selected part specification rather than assuming all Binder shells use one alloy. A metal shell contributes to shielding only when the intended electrical path is maintained. Mounting thickness, nut access and anti-rotation features affect the installed connection. Review the connector with the actual panel stack so tightening does not distort the enclosure or strain an internal lead.
copy.zh: 金属与聚合物外壳解决不同机械、操作及环境需求，应使用所选零件规范，而不是假设所有 Binder 外壳采用同一种合金。金属壳只有保持预定电气通路时才能参与屏蔽。安装厚度、螺母操作空间及防转结构会影响成品连接，应结合实际面板叠层审核，避免拧紧时使机壳变形或拉紧内部引线。

caption.en: Cable glands in different materials illustrate mounting and cable-entry choices.
caption.zh: 不同材质电缆夹头展示安装及进线口选择。

title.en: Seals: Geometry Before a Material Label
title.zh: 密封件：材料名称之外还要看几何

copy.en: An elastomer works as a seal only with suitable compression, surface condition and dimensions. Cable diameter, roundness and jacket softness affect the rear seal, while panel seals must fit the actual mounting face. Check compatibility with temperature and the specified fluid rather than assigning one chemical resistance to all rubber. Assembly cleanliness matters: a trapped fiber or damaged sealing edge can defeat an otherwise appropriate component selection.
copy.zh: 弹性体只有在压缩量、表面状况及尺寸合适时才能形成密封。线缆直径、圆度及护套软硬影响尾部密封，面板密封则必须适合实际安装面。应核对温度及指定液体相容性，而不是为所有橡胶赋予同一种耐化学性能。装配清洁同样重要，夹入纤维或损伤密封边缘会破坏原本合适的元件选择。

caption.en: A distorted O-ring illustrates why seal geometry and installation matter.
caption.zh: 变形 O 形圈说明密封几何与安装的重要性。

title.en: Contacts and Plating: Preserve the Approved Pair
title.zh: 触点与镀层：保持认可组合

copy.en: Contact alloy, mating finish and termination geometry act together. Select the exact contact reference and approved wire range; a similar-looking terminal is not a substitute for a documented match. Plating color cannot establish thickness or condition. For mixed-source assemblies, assess both mating finishes and the required evidence before approval. The finished circuit should be checked against its electrical requirements, with damaged or incompletely seated contacts handled under a defined rework rule.
copy.zh: 触点合金、对插镀层及端接几何共同起作用。应选择准确端子料号及认可线材范围，外观相似的端子不能代替有文件依据的匹配。镀层颜色不能证明厚度或状态；混合来源组件应在认可前审核两端表面及所需证据。成品回路应按电气要求检查，受损或未到位端子需按明确返工规则处理。

caption.en: Electrolytic nickel as a material reference, not a finished connector coating certificate.
caption.zh: 电解镍作为材料参考，并非成品接头镀层认证。

copy.en: Dust protection and water protection describe different challenges. Consider whether fine particles are present during mating, whether the enclosure breathes through temperature changes and whether condensation can form inside. A sealed mating interface does not remove moisture already trapped in the assembly. Keep unused ports protected with the specified accessories and define inspection after service. Do not treat an IP rating as a universal guarantee against dust, cleaning jets and long-term immersion together.
copy.zh: 防尘与防水描述不同挑战。应考虑对插时是否存在细颗粒、机壳是否随温度变化换气，以及内部是否可能结露。密封对插面不能排除装配时已被困在内部的水分。未用端口应采用指定附件保护，并规定维修后的检查，不能将某个 IP 等级同时当作防尘、耐清洗喷射及长期浸水的通用保证。

caption.en: Dust-suppression spray in a mining environment illustrates combined dust and moisture exposure.
caption.zh: 矿业现场抑尘喷雾展示粉尘与潮湿共同暴露。

title.zh: 未对插防护与 NCC 配置

copy.en: The environmental boundary changes when a cable is unplugged. Binder NCC families include closed-contact arrangements, but the protected receptacle condition must be distinguished from the exposed cable plug. Confirm the exact series and use the specified cap where required. This distinction matters for washable equipment and removable accessories. State protection in the drawing for both normal operation and service, instead of listing a single code without the mating condition.
copy.zh: 拔下电缆后，环境边界会改变。Binder NCC 系列包含闭合触点结构，但需区分受保护插座状态与暴露电缆插头。应确认具体系列，并在需要时使用指定防护盖，这对可清洗设备及可拆卸附件尤为重要。图纸应分别描述正常工作与维修状态的防护，而不是不带对插条件地列出单一代码。

caption.en: A diving light connector closure illustrates the need to examine openings; not an NCC rating example.
caption.zh: 潜水灯接头封闭结构说明检查开口的重要性，并非 NCC 防护等级示例。

title.zh: 工业自动化：从传感到控制

copy.en: Sensor clusters, I/O modules, valve islands and cabinet interfaces create different branch and connector needs. An approved wiring diagram should describe the signal type and any shared supply before a splitter is built. Label branches where they remain visible after installation. Check the service route with the machine guards in place; accessible coupling nuts and clear channel identification can simplify replacement without changing the validated circuit.
copy.zh: 传感器组、I/O 模块、阀岛及控制柜接口带来不同分支和接头需求。制作分线组件前，认可接线图应描述信号类型及共享供电。分支标识应在安装后仍可见，并在机器防护罩装好时检查检修路径；可操作的锁紧螺母和清楚通道识别，有助于在不改变认可回路的情况下更换。

caption.en: Sensor board and pin adapter illustrate the connection from sensing to electronics.
caption.zh: 传感器板与针脚转接展示从感知到电子系统的连接。

title.en: Medical Equipment: Define the Accessory Boundary
title.zh: 医疗设备：明确附件边界

copy.en: A monitor cable and a removable diagnostic accessory may require different flexibility, cleaning and safety evidence. Record the intended equipment and the approved electrical interface rather than calling every lead medical grade. Connector component data can support material selection, but the complete accessory must be assessed within the device requirements. Clear labels and controlled replacement specifications are particularly important when multiple similar channels sit next to one another.
copy.zh: 监护电缆与可拆卸诊断附件可能要求不同柔性、清洁及安全证据。应记录目标设备及认可电气接口，而不是把每根引线都称为医疗级。接头元件资料可以支持选材，但完整附件仍需按整机要求评估。多个相似通道紧邻时，清晰标签和受控替换规范尤其重要。

caption.en: Ultrasound probe illustrates a handled medical accessory, not our medical-device approval.
caption.zh: 超声探头展示需要手持操作的医疗附件，不代表我们的医疗器械批准。

title.zh: 机器人：区分弯曲与扭转

copy.en: A robot dress pack may twist, while a cable carrier may primarily bend through a defined radius. Select construction for the actual motion, not a generic flexible label. Keep connectors outside the repeated flex zone and support the cable without crushing it. Describe travel, orientation and duty cycle before agreeing a prototype evaluation. Intermittent continuity under motion should be investigated at its source rather than hidden with a longer sleeve.
copy.zh: 机器人管线包可能承受扭转，拖链则可能主要沿规定半径弯曲。应按实际运动选择结构，而不是依赖笼统的柔性标签。接头应离开反复弯折区域，电缆支撑不能挤伤护套。约定样品评估前，应描述行程、方向及工作循环；运动中的间歇导通应追查根因，而不是用更长套管遮盖。

caption.en: Industrial robot demonstration illustrates moving equipment and routing constraints.
caption.zh: 工业机器人演示展示运动设备与布线路径约束。

copy.en: Outdoor monitoring, control actuators and local equipment power can each need different cable assemblies. Distinguish low-voltage control connections from a generation system main power circuit. Sunlight, temperature variation, water exposure and maintenance access all affect material selection. Route the cable to avoid abrasive supports and standing water where possible. A connector used in an energy project does not by itself establish suitability for every photovoltaic or wind-power circuit.
copy.zh: 户外监测、控制执行器及设备局部供电可能各需不同电缆组件。应将低压控制连接与发电系统主功率回路区分，日晒、温差、水暴露及维护空间都会影响选材。布线应尽量避免磨损性支撑和积水。接头用于能源项目，并不代表它适合所有光伏或风电回路。

caption.en: Installed solar inverters illustrate outdoor energy equipment and cable routing.
caption.zh: 已安装太阳能逆变器展示户外能源设备及布线。

title.zh: 交通与轨道：安装方式同样重要

copy.en: Vehicle and rail equipment can impose vibration, temperature and fire-performance requirements beyond a stationary cabinet. Identify the mounting location and applicable customer specification before choosing a cable. Connector locking cannot compensate for unsupported mass or a harness rubbing against a bracket. Material declarations, routing restraints and any required qualification evidence must apply to the actual configuration; a general industrial family name is not a rail approval.
copy.zh: 车辆及轨道设备可能提出超出固定控制柜的振动、温度和燃烧性能要求。选线前应识别安装位置及适用客户规范。接头锁紧不能补偿未支撑重量或线束与支架摩擦的问题。材料声明、布线约束及所需资格证据必须对应实际配置，普通工业系列名称并不等于轨道认可。

caption.en: Rail transport in heavy rain illustrates the actual exposure environment.
caption.zh: 暴雨中的轨道交通展示实际环境暴露。

title.en: Quality Control That Matches the Drawing
title.zh: 与图纸对应的质量控制

copy.en: A meaningful inspection plan checks the features that could make this assembly wrong: the interface, circuit, dimensions, contact seating, labels and required protection. Use an approved sample as a reference alongside the drawing, not as a replacement for it. Continuity and visual inspection are basic checks; additional tests follow project requirements. Keep results linked to the production version so a later change can be evaluated against the same baseline.
copy.zh: 有意义的检验方案应检查可能使组件不合格的特征：接口、回路、尺寸、端子到位、标签及规定防护。认可样品应与图纸共同作为参考，而不能代替图纸。导通及外观属于基础检查，其他试验按项目要求执行。结果需关联生产版本，便于后续变更在同一基准下评估。

caption.en: Multimeter as an electrical inspection tool; project-specific checks remain necessary.
caption.zh: 万用表作为电气检查工具，仍需按项目规定检验。

copy.en: Threaded, snap-in and bayonet couplings require different handling. Follow the exact connector instructions for alignment and tightening rather than twisting a cable until it feels secure. Check access with neighboring connections present. A cable clamp should carry the planned service load so the coupling is not used as the only support. After maintenance, verify both mechanical engagement and circuit identification before restoring operation.
copy.zh: 螺纹、卡扣及卡口锁紧需要不同操作。应按具体接头说明对准及拧紧，而不是扭动电缆直到主观感觉牢固。检查时应装上邻近连接，确认实际操作空间。固定夹应承受预定使用载荷，避免锁紧接头成为唯一支撑；维修后恢复运行前，应同时核对机械到位及回路识别。

caption.en: Secured Hirschmann industrial connector illustrates a mechanical retention feature; not a Binder interchangeability claim.
caption.zh: 已锁紧的 Hirschmann 工业接头展示机械保持结构，不代表与 Binder 可互换。

copy.en: Contact wear, a damaged seal and a broken conductor can produce similar intermittent symptoms but need different corrections. Preserve evidence from the failed location before choosing a replacement. The lowest purchase price may not be the lowest installed cost when access, labeling and replacement time are considered. A suitable configuration should balance electrical requirements, environment and serviceability, without promising a universal lifespan or eliminating every possible failure.
copy.zh: 触点磨损、密封损伤及导体断裂可能产生相似间歇症状，却需要不同修正。选择替换件前应保留失效位置证据。考虑操作空间、标识及更换时间后，最低采购价未必对应最低安装使用成本。合适配置应平衡电气要求、环境及可维修性，但不承诺统一寿命或消除所有失效可能。

caption.en: Corrosion on electronics illustrates the value of preserving physical failure evidence.
caption.zh: 电子部件腐蚀说明保留实物失效证据的价值。

copy.en: Specify where each length starts and ends: mating face, backshell exit, branch point or prepared wire end. A drawing should separate useful installed reach from service allowance. Too little length loads the connection; unnecessary loops can rub, trap dirt or occupy maintenance space. Agree dimensional tolerance with the cable and assembly process, and check a sample on the equipment when the routing is complex.
copy.zh: 应规定每个长度从何处起止：对插面、尾壳出口、分支点或处理后的线端。图纸应区分有效安装距离与检修余量，过短会加载接头，多余线圈则可能摩擦、积污或占据检修空间。尺寸公差需结合线缆与装配工艺约定，复杂布线应在设备上检查样品。

caption.en: Tape measure illustrates dimensional datums and installation allowance.
caption.zh: 卷尺说明尺寸基准与安装余量。

copy.en: Document the connector view, circuit name and wire identity before assembly. Front and rear views can appear mirrored, and a standard shell does not guarantee a standard device pinout. For a branch harness, record shared connections explicitly instead of relying on color alone. Final circuit testing should compare the finished assembly with the approved map, including intended unused contacts and any shield connection.
copy.zh: 装配前应记录接头观察方向、回路名称及电线身份。正反视图可能呈镜像，标准外壳不保证设备针脚标准化。分支线束应明确记录共享连接，不能仅靠颜色推断。最终回路测试应将成品与认可接线表比较，包括预定空置触点及屏蔽连接。

caption.en: An eight-pin DIN mating face illustrates contact-view orientation; not a Binder pinout.
caption.zh: 八针 DIN 对插端面说明触点观察方向，并非 Binder 针脚表。

title.zh: 一条组件中的混合接口

copy.en: A Binder-interface lead can transition to a terminal block, another circular connector or a defined equipment plug. Identify each end separately and confirm that the circuit, shielding and mechanical support remain appropriate through the transition. An adapter is not a protocol converter unless electronics are explicitly included. Mixed connectors can simplify installation, but only when the new assembly is documented and tested as one complete electrical path.
copy.zh: Binder 接口引线可过渡至端子台、另一种圆形接头或明确设备插头。应分别识别每一端，并确认过渡过程中的回路、屏蔽及机械支撑保持适当。除非明确包含电子电路，否则转接组件不是协议转换器。混合接口可以简化安装，但新组件必须作为完整电气通路进行文件定义与测试。

caption.en: Microphone and interface accessories illustrate different connection forms in one system.
caption.zh: 麦克风与接口附件展示同一系统中的不同连接形式。

copy.en: Describe the actual heat, cold, oil, chemicals, sunlight and movement rather than requesting a tough cable without conditions. Material performance depends on grade and exposure time. A jacket change can also alter outer diameter, stiffness and the fit of seals or clamps. Review those effects before substituting cable. The acceptance sample should reflect the intended jacket, markings and protection, not a temporary material that only resembles the production choice.
copy.zh: 应描述实际高低温、油液、化学品、日晒及运动，而不是不带条件地要求耐用电缆。材料表现取决于牌号和暴露时间，护套变化还会改变外径、刚度及密封或固定夹配合，替换前需审核这些影响。验收样品应体现预定护套、标识和防护，而不是外观近似量产选择的临时材料。

caption.en: EPR-insulated cable section illustrates material layers, not a recommended small-signal cable gauge.
caption.zh: EPR 绝缘电缆截面展示材料层次，并非推荐的小信号线径。

copy.en: Start with the mating references, circuit drawing, dimensions, quantity range and operating conditions. Engineering review resolves uncertain interfaces and material choices before sampling. After approval, release the drawing, material list and inspection plan together. Lead time depends on confirmed parts, tooling and checks, so it is quoted for the project rather than promised universally. Any approved substitution should be recorded before the next batch is built.
copy.zh: 从对插料号、回路图、尺寸、数量范围及工作条件开始。工程审核在打样前解决不确定接口与材料选择，认可后共同放行图纸、物料清单和检验方案。交期取决于确认零件、工装及检查，应按项目报价而非统一承诺。任何认可替代都应在下一批生产前记录。

caption.en: Gauged wire-stripping scissors illustrate controlled end preparation before assembly.
caption.zh: 带规格孔的剥线剪展示装配前的受控线端处理。

q.en: Are all M12 connectors interchangeable?
q.zh: 所有 M12 接头都可互换吗？

a.en: No. Coding, contact count, gender, termination and circuit assignment must match. Physical diameter alone cannot define a compatible interface.
a.zh: 不是。编码、触点数量、公母、端接及回路分配都需匹配，仅凭外径不能定义兼容接口。

q.en: Does Binder mean an office cable clip?
q.zh: Binder 是指办公夹子吗？

a.en: Here Binder refers to connector-interface families. Cable clamps and routing supports are separate components chosen for the equipment, not office binder clips.
a.zh: 这里 Binder 指连接器接口系列。电缆夹及布线支撑是按设备选用的独立零件，不是办公长尾夹。

q.en: Can you supply an original-brand build or an alternative?
q.zh: 可以采用原品牌件或替代件吗？

a.en: The project review and quotation identify the approved source. Original components and alternatives are listed separately; this page does not claim Binder authorization.
a.zh: 项目审核及报价会明确认可来源，原品牌件与替代件分别列明，本页不表示获得 Binder 授权。

q.en: Is the assembly protected when unplugged?
q.zh: 拔下后组件仍有防护吗？

a.en: That depends on the exact plug, receptacle and cap configuration. The drawing must define mated and unmated conditions separately.
a.zh: 取决于具体插头、插座及防护盖配置，图纸需分别定义对插和未对插状态。

q.en: What is needed for a custom harness?
q.zh: 定制线束需要什么？

a.en: Provide the mating references or samples, circuit map, length datums, cable requirements, quantity and operating conditions. Unclear interfaces are resolved before sample production.
a.zh: 提供对插料号或样品、回路表、长度基准、线缆要求、数量及工作条件；不明确接口应在样品制作前解决。

q.en: How is a failed connection evaluated?
q.zh: 连接故障如何评估？

a.en: Record where and when it occurs, retain the failed sample and compare wiring, contact seating, support and exposure with the approved specification. Replacement should address the cause, not only the visible symptom.
a.zh: 记录故障位置及发生条件，保留失效样品，并将接线、端子到位、支撑及暴露与认可规范比较。替换应针对原因，而不只处理可见症状。

intro.en: Custom push-pull cable assemblies for instruments, equipment and removable modules, with defined mating parts, pinouts and strain relief.
intro.zh: 面向仪器、设备及可拆卸模块的定制推拉式电缆组件，明确对插件、针脚与应力释放。

knowledge.en: Match the connector series, cable construction and handling conditions.
knowledge.zh: 匹配接头系列、线缆结构及操作条件。

notes.en: Provide the full mating reference, circuit map, cable dimensions and environment.
notes.zh: 提供完整对插料号、回路表、线缆尺寸及环境。

delivery.en: Approve the sample and controlled specification before repeat manufacture.
delivery.zh: 重复制造前认可样品及受控规范。

introduction.en: Push-Pull Connections, Engineered as a Complete Cable
introduction.zh: 推拉式连接：以完整电缆为设计对象

subtitle.en: Interface families, surface finishes and the moving cable exit
subtitle.zh: 接口系列、表面处理与运动出线端

lead.en: This category includes instrument leads, extensions, adapters, coiled cables and equipment harnesses, not one fixed product. The following guide moves from connector selection to use conditions, surface treatment and strain relief, then to sample approval. It separates the connector specification from the behavior of the finished cable so the requirements remain clear when a project moves into production.
lead.zh: 这个小类包含仪器引线、延长组件、转接线、螺旋电缆及设备线束，而不是单一固定产品。以下从接头选择展开，介绍使用条件、表面处理及应力释放，再进入样品认可；将接头规范与成品电缆表现分开讨论，使项目进入生产时仍有清楚要求。

openingCaption.en: A photographed ten-contact LEMO plug with its cable exit.
openingCaption.zh: 十触点 LEMO 插头及其出线端实拍。

title.en: LEMO Interfaces: Define the Complete Assembly
title.zh: LEMO 接口：定义完整组件

copy.en: A push-pull cable can connect a sensor, instrument, camera or removable machine module. The interface is only one part of the design: cable construction, circuit assignment, shielding, length and support points determine how the complete assembly behaves. Super Smile can review straight leads, extensions, branches and coiled configurations against supplied drawings or mating samples. Original-brand components and approved alternatives must be identified separately in the bill of materials.
copy.zh: 推拉式电缆可连接传感器、仪器、摄影设备或可拆卸机器模块。接口只是设计的一部分，线缆结构、回路分配、屏蔽、长度及支撑位置共同影响完整组件表现。超斯迈尔可依据图纸或对插样品审核直线、延长、分支及螺旋配置；原品牌零件与认可替代件应在物料清单中分别标明。

caption.en: Instrument-mounted pump and tubing illustrate an equipment-module environment.
caption.zh: 安装于仪器的泵与管路，展示设备模块使用环境。

title.en: Push to Latch, Pull the Sleeve to Release
title.zh: 推入锁紧，拉动套筒解锁

copy.en: A self-latching push-pull mechanism retains the plug after insertion; normal release uses the outer sleeve rather than pulling the cable. Installation space must therefore include room for fingers or the specified handling tool. Check full engagement with the actual receptacle, not only an audible click. Key alignment and latch engagement are different checks, and a cable restraint should prevent routine loads from being carried by the connector.
copy.zh: 自锁推拉机构在插入后保持插头，正常拆卸应操作外部解锁套筒，而不是拉扯电缆。因此安装空间需留出手指或指定工具的操作位置。应结合实际插座核对完全啮合，不能只听是否有声响；键位对准和锁紧到位是不同检查项，布线支撑应避免日常拉力直接作用于接头。

caption.en: LEMO plug and socket contact faces and outer locking sleeves.
caption.zh: LEMO 插头、插座触点面与外部锁紧套筒。

title.en: B Series for Protected Equipment Connections
title.zh: B 系列：受保护设备连接

copy.en: The B series uses keyed metal push-pull interfaces for protected environments. Its standard IP50 designation must not be presented as waterproofing. Select shell size, contact arrangement, termination and cable collet together; different versions within a family can have different needs. A panel receptacle also needs suitable mounting thickness and access behind the panel. Review the wiring path with neighboring connectors fitted so that the release sleeve remains usable.
copy.zh: B 系列采用带键位的金属推拉接口，面向受保护环境，标准 IP50 标识不能被宣传为防水。应共同选择壳体尺寸、触点布局、端接方式及电缆夹头，同系列不同版本也可能有不同要求。面板插座还需匹配安装厚度及面板后方空间，应在相邻接头全部装好时检查布线路径，确保解锁套筒仍能操作。

caption.en: A laboratory oscilloscope illustrates protected indoor instrument use, not a specific LEMO interface.
caption.zh: 实验室示波器说明受保护室内仪器应用，并非指定 LEMO 接口。

title.en: K and T: Sealing Is an Assembly Condition
title.zh: K 与 T：密封取决于装配条件

copy.en: Outdoor keyed families such as K and T provide specified sealed configurations, but the rating applies under defined mating and assembly conditions. Cable roundness, jacket diameter, seal selection and the rear termination all matter. A sealed front interface cannot stop moisture entering an unsealed cable branch elsewhere. Drawings should state the exposure, mated or unmated condition and any cap requirement before an ingress verification method is agreed.
copy.zh: K、T 等户外带键位系列具有规定的密封配置，但等级适用于明确的对插及装配条件。线缆圆度、护套外径、密封件选择及尾部端接都很重要，前端密封无法阻止水分从其他未密封分支进入。约定防护验证方法前，图纸应说明暴露形式、对插或未对插状态及防尘盖需求。

caption.en: Field electrical measurements near water illustrate exposure requirements.
caption.zh: 水边现场电气测量，说明环境暴露需求。

title.en: S and E: Stepped Inserts and Cable Groups
title.zh: S 与 E：阶梯绝缘体及线缆组别

copy.en: S and E families use stepped-insert configurations, including unipole and multipole options. S generally serves protected environments, while E includes watertight configurations with the appropriate mating and cable assembly. Do not choose a mate from outer diameter or pin count alone. Coaxial contacts additionally require the correct cable group; a cable with a familiar RG designation still needs the contact and assembly dimensions checked.
copy.zh: S、E 系列采用阶梯绝缘体结构，包含单极及多极选项。S 通常用于受保护环境，E 包含在正确对插和线缆装配条件下的防水配置。不能仅凭外径或针数选择对插件；同轴触点还需要匹配线缆组别，即使看到熟悉的 RG 电缆名称，也应核对触点及装配尺寸。

caption.en: LEMO 00 coaxial connectors and adapters shown beside a scale.
caption.zh: 比例尺旁的 LEMO 00 同轴接头与转接件。

title.en: REDEL Plastic Interfaces for Handling and Identification
title.zh: REDEL 塑料接口：操作与识别

copy.en: REDEL P, SP and MP are distinct connector systems rather than interchangeable plastic versions of one metal plug. Shell geometry, keying, color coding and contact arrangement influence handling and identification. The selected material must also suit the equipment cleaning routine. In a medical project, connector selection remains separate from device-level electrical safety, biocompatibility or validated sterilization; those requirements must come from the customer specification.
copy.zh: REDEL P、SP、MP 是不同连接系统，并非某一种金属插头的可互换塑料版本。外壳几何、键位、颜色编码及触点布局影响操作和识别，所选材料还需适应设备清洁方式。在医疗项目中，接头选择与整机电气安全、生物相容性或已验证灭菌工艺属于不同层面，后者应由客户规范明确。

caption.en: LLDPE resin granules illustrate polymer selection; they are not identified as REDEL housing material.
caption.zh: LLDPE 树脂颗粒用于说明聚合物选择，不被标注为 REDEL 外壳材料。

title.zh: 工业与机器人布线路径

copy.en: A moving connection is a system of cable, connector, clamps and available travel. Define repeated bending separately from torsion, then select a cable intended for that duty. Keep the flexing zone away from solder joints and rigid backshell transitions. Check minimum bend radius under the actual load and movement, not only on a static bench sample. Functional monitoring during an agreed motion test can reveal intermittent faults that a stationary continuity test misses.
copy.zh: 运动连接由线缆、接头、固定夹及可用行程组成。先将反复弯曲与扭转区分，再选择面向相应工况的线缆；弯曲区域应远离焊点及刚性尾壳过渡段。最小弯曲半径需结合实际载荷与运动检查，不能只看静态台面样品。在约定运动试验中监测功能，可发现静态导通测试遗漏的间歇故障。

caption.en: A cable carrier with installed cables shows a defined moving route.
caption.zh: 装有线缆的拖链展示明确的运动布线路径。

title.en: Coiled Leads: Reach, Return and Pull Force
title.zh: 螺旋引线：伸展、回弹与拉力

copy.en: A coiled lead provides changing reach, but its restoring force still acts on the equipment. Specify relaxed length, usable extended length, coil diameter and straight tails separately. Review the working position at both travel limits and provide a support point where necessary. Excessive extension can permanently distort the coil or load the connector. The electrical path follows the entire conductor length, so voltage drop and signal behavior cannot be estimated from the relaxed coil length.
copy.zh: 螺旋引线提供变化的使用距离，但回弹力仍会作用于设备。应分别规定收缩长度、可用伸展长度、圈径及两端直线段，并检查两个行程极限的工作位置，必要时增加支撑。过度拉伸会使线圈永久变形或增加接头负荷；电气通路沿完整导体长度展开，因此不能用收缩长度估算压降或信号表现。

caption.en: A suspended coiled cord illustrates changing reach and restoring force.
caption.zh: 悬垂螺旋线说明可变伸展距离与回弹力。

title.en: Medical Electronics: Start with the Use Environment
title.zh: 医疗电子：先明确使用环境

copy.en: A handheld diagnostic probe, a patient-adjacent lead and an internal instrument cable have different exposure and safety requirements. Describe cleaning agents, contact duration, reuse policy and handling cycles before selecting jacket and connector materials. Color and keying can help users identify channels, but cannot replace electrical safeguards. Any insulation, leakage-current, cleaning or environmental verification must be defined for the finished device and its approved accessories.
copy.zh: 手持诊断探头、患者附近引线及仪器内部电缆具有不同暴露与安全要求。选择护套和接头材料前，应说明清洁剂、接触时间、重复使用规则及操作次数。颜色和键位可帮助识别通道，但不能代替电气保护。绝缘、漏电流、清洁或环境验证均需依据整机及认可附件的要求定义。

caption.en: Handheld ultrasound probe and cable; medical-use context only.
caption.zh: 手持超声探头与电缆，仅作为医疗使用场景。

title.en: Contact Plating and Shell Finish Are Different
title.zh: 触点镀层与外壳表面处理不同

copy.en: Electrical contacts and external shells perform different jobs. A contact finish supports the mating surface, while a shell finish also responds to handling and environmental exposure. Record the actual material and finish code instead of describing the whole connector as gold plated. Plating thickness, porosity, contact force and the mating finish interact; color is not an acceptance measurement. Replacement contacts must retain the approved finish and dimensional specification.
copy.zh: 电气触点与外壳承担不同任务，触点镀层服务于对插表面，外壳处理还需面对操作与环境暴露。应记录实际材料及表面处理代码，而不是笼统描述整个接头为镀金。镀层厚度、孔隙、接触力和对端表面会相互影响，颜色不能作为验收测量；替换端子应保持认可的表面及尺寸规范。

caption.en: A gold-colored USB shell illustrates the distinction between external finish and contact specification.
caption.zh: 金色 USB 外壳说明外部表面处理与触点规范应区分。

title.en: Read Surface-Treatment Standards by Their Scope
title.zh: 按适用范围理解表面处理标准

copy.en: A standard number is useful only when attached to the correct material, process and acceptance clause. LEMO catalog references distinguish chrome treatment under SAE AMS 2460, nickel under AMS QQ-N-290 or a stated alternative, and gold under ISO 27874. These are not interchangeable labels. If a project requires documented plating, specify the exact component, revision and evidence required; a catalog citation is not certification of our complete cable assembly.
copy.zh: 标准编号只有对应正确材料、工艺及验收条款才有意义。LEMO 目录将 SAE AMS 2460 对应镀铬、AMS QQ-N-290 或指定替代规范对应镀镍，并列出 ISO 27874 镀金参考，这些不是可互换标签。项目若要求镀层文件，应明确零件、版本及所需证据；引用目录并不代表我们完整电缆组件获得相应认证。

caption.en: Nickel sheet as a material reference, not a coating certification.
caption.zh: 镍片材料参考，不代表镀层认证。

copy.en: Corrosion evaluation begins with where liquid can collect and how dissimilar materials meet. A laboratory salt-spray duration describes one test procedure, not an equivalent number of years outdoors. Examine contacts, shell joints, fasteners and cable exits separately. Cleaning residues or damaged finishes can change behavior after assembly. Agree the exposure method and acceptance criteria for the intended application instead of applying one advertised hour count to every configuration.
copy.zh: 腐蚀评估应从液体可能积聚的位置及不同材料接触方式开始。实验室盐雾时长描述一种试验程序，不能换算为户外使用年限。需分别检查触点、壳体接缝、紧固件和出线端，清洁残留或表面损伤也会改变装配后的表现。应根据应用约定暴露方法及验收标准，而不是为每个配置套用同一个宣传时长。

caption.en: A salt-spray chamber illustrates a defined laboratory exposure method.
caption.zh: 盐雾箱展示明确的实验室暴露方法。

title.en: Mating Cycles Are Not Cable Flex Life
title.zh: 插拔寿命不等于线缆弯折寿命

copy.en: Connector mating endurance and cable bending endurance are different measurements. A published component cycle rating uses specified conditions; it does not cover pulling the lead, contamination, side loading or an unsuitable cable exit. Define how often the connector is handled and how the cable moves in service. For frequently changed probes, inspect latch action, contact condition and the strain-relief transition together rather than counting insertions alone.
copy.zh: 接头插拔耐久与电缆弯折耐久是不同测量。元件公开循环额定值基于规定条件，并不覆盖拉扯引线、污染、侧向载荷或不合适的出线结构。应明确使用中接头操作频次及线缆运动方式；对于频繁更换的探头，应同时检查锁紧动作、触点状况及应力释放过渡，而不只是统计插拔次数。

caption.en: Micrometers illustrate dimensional inspection; this is not a mating-cycle test.
caption.zh: 千分尺说明尺寸检查，并非插拔循环试验。

title.en: Test and Measurement: Protect the Signal Path
title.zh: 测试与测量：保护信号通路

copy.en: A sensor extension can change the measurement chain through resistance, capacitance, shielding and additional contacts. Record whether the signal is low-level analog, a thermocouple, a coaxial channel or a digital interface. Cable selection and pin allocation follow that signal, not the appearance of the plug. For low-level measurements, grounding and cable movement may be as important as continuity. Compare the assembled lead in the actual instrument configuration.
copy.zh: 传感器延长线会通过电阻、电容、屏蔽及新增触点改变测量链。应记录信号是低电平模拟量、热电偶、同轴通道还是数字接口，选线与针脚分配应跟随信号要求，而不是插头外观。对于低电平测量，接地及线缆运动可能与导通同样重要，应在实际仪器配置中比较装配引线。

caption.en: Oscilloscope probes with their leads and terminations.
caption.zh: 示波器探头、引线及端接实拍。

title.en: Automation: Service Access and Channel Identification
title.zh: 自动化：检修空间与通道识别

copy.en: Removable sensors and tool modules need connections that technicians can identify without tracing the whole machine. Combine permanent labels, connector keying and a clear circuit drawing. Route the lead so the release sleeve is accessible after guards and adjacent equipment are installed. Keep power and sensitive signal routes appropriate to the machine design. A service loop should provide useful access without rubbing against motion components or becoming a snag point.
copy.zh: 可拆卸传感器和工具模块需要让技术人员不必追踪整台机器就能识别的连接。应结合耐久标签、接头键位和清晰回路图，并确保防护罩及邻近设备装好后仍能操作解锁套筒。动力与敏感信号路径应适应整机设计，检修余量既要方便操作，也不能摩擦运动部件或形成钩挂点。

caption.en: Organized patch-panel wiring illustrates identification and service access.
caption.zh: 整理后的配线架布线说明识别与检修空间。

title.en: Broadcast and Audio-Visual: Define the Channel
title.zh: 广播与视听：明确具体通道

copy.en: Camera power, control, timecode and audio leads may use compact circular connectors but carry entirely different circuits. Confirm the equipment pinout and direction before creating an extension or adapter. Coaxial channels require an appropriate impedance and termination, while power leads need a voltage-drop review at operating load. Mark both ends clearly. A connector brand alone does not establish compatibility with a particular camera or recording system.
copy.zh: 摄影机供电、控制、时间码及音频引线可能采用紧凑圆形接头，却承载完全不同回路。制作延长线或转接线前应确认设备针脚及方向。同轴通道需要合适阻抗及端接，供电线则需在工作负载下审核压降，并清楚标识两端。连接器品牌本身不能证明与某种摄影机或录制系统兼容。

caption.en: A broadcast camera provides the operating context for accessory leads.
caption.zh: 广播摄像机展示附件引线的使用环境。

title.zh: 诊断设备：可重复的连接

copy.en: A removable diagnostic accessory needs repeatable electrical and mechanical behavior between visits or test sessions. Document the reference pinout, label, cable length and connector orientation so that a replacement is not only visually similar. Consider repeated wiping, storage bends and operator grip. Evaluation of an accessory should include the equipment-defined checks; a continuity pass alone does not establish the accuracy or safety of a diagnostic system.
copy.zh: 可拆卸诊断附件需要在不同检测场次保持可重复的电气与机械表现。应记录基准针脚、标签、线长及接头方向，避免替换件只是外观相似。同时考虑反复擦拭、存放弯折及操作者握持方式。附件评估应包含设备定义的检查，仅导通合格不能证明诊断系统准确性或安全性。

caption.en: An instrument and handheld probe during a diagnostic examination.
caption.zh: 诊断检查中的仪器与手持探头。

title.en: Aerospace Projects: Specify Evidence Before Supply
title.zh: 航空航天项目：先明确交付证据

copy.en: A project-specific aerospace lead may require controlled materials, traceability, environmental tests and document retention beyond a general industrial assembly. Confirm those requirements before selecting parts or quoting. A familiar connector family is not proof that a cable is approved for flight or a defense program. The released drawing, accepted sources, manufacturing records and customer qualification route must describe the same configuration throughout the project.
copy.zh: 航空航天项目引线可能要求超出普通工业组件的受控材料、追溯、环境试验及文件保存。应在选料或报价前确认这些要求，熟悉的接头系列不能证明电缆获得飞行或防务项目认可。放行图纸、认可来源、制造记录及客户资格路径应在整个项目中对应同一配置。

caption.en: Archival spacecraft connector inspection; no program affiliation or product qualification implied.
caption.zh: 航天器接头检查档案实拍，不表示项目关联或产品资格。

title.zh: 弯曲保护：形成渐变过渡

copy.en: The exit from a rigid connector to a flexible cable concentrates bending. A bend relief should spread curvature over a useful length rather than move the sharp bend to its own end. Review the cable jacket, relief stiffness and available installation space together. An overly rigid boot can be as troublesome as no support. Prototype evaluation should reproduce the actual angle and repeated motion, with the connector held as it will be in use.
copy.zh: 从刚性接头到柔性电缆的出口容易集中弯曲，应力释放套应将曲率分散到有效长度，而不是把急弯转移到自身末端。需共同审核护套、尾套刚度及安装空间，过硬尾套可能与缺少支撑一样造成问题。样品评估应复现实际角度及重复运动，并按使用方式固定接头。

caption.en: A repaired power-lead exit illustrates a stiffness transition, not a specified production design.
caption.zh: 修复后的电源出线端说明刚度过渡，不作为指定量产设计。

title.zh: 注塑包胶：材料、结合与可维修性

copy.en: An overmold can provide shape control, protection and labeling at a cable junction. It does not automatically bond to every jacket or seal every hidden path. Match molding material and process conditions to the cable and insert, keeping the release mechanism free. Consider whether repair is required: a sealed-looking one-piece exterior can make internal rework impractical. Agree tooling, surface expectations and verification on a representative sample before production.
copy.zh: 包胶可在电缆连接处提供外形、防护及标识，但不会自动与所有护套结合或封住全部隐藏通路。应使包胶材料及工艺条件适应线缆和嵌件，并保持解锁机构自由动作。还需考虑维修需求，一体化外观可能使内部返工难以实施。生产前应通过代表性样品认可工装、表面要求及验证方式。

caption.en: Injection-molding equipment illustrates tooling and process context.
caption.zh: 注塑设备说明工装及工艺环境。

copy.en: The cable collet must fit the actual jacket diameter, not just the conductor gauge. Its purpose is to transfer mechanical load through the supported jacket rather than the electrical termination. Cable ovality, soft insulation and dimensional tolerance affect the fit. Define an agreed pull check where required and inspect for both slip and jacket damage. Do not compensate for a wrong collet by tightening without reference to the assembly instructions.
copy.zh: 电缆夹头应适配实际护套外径，而不是只看导体线规。其作用是通过受支撑护套传递机械载荷，避免载荷进入电气端接。线缆椭圆度、软绝缘及尺寸公差都会影响配合；如有要求，应约定拉力检查，同时检查滑移与护套损伤。不能脱离装配说明，单纯靠加大拧紧力度补偿夹头不匹配。

caption.en: Disassembled cable gland shows jacket clamping components; it is not a LEMO collet.
caption.zh: 拆开的电缆接头显示护套夹紧零件，并非 LEMO 夹头。

title.en: High-Flex Duty: Observe the Complete Motion
title.zh: 高柔性工况：观察完整运动

copy.en: Repeated bending, torsion and coil extension place different demands on conductors and insulation. Define the motion profile, travel, acceleration, temperature and target evaluation before choosing cable construction. Place clamps so movement occurs in the intended flex zone. A successful connector pull test is not evidence of dynamic cable life. If a prototype fails, review the location and failure mode before simply adding a thicker jacket or longer boot.
copy.zh: 反复弯曲、扭转及螺旋伸展对导体和绝缘提出不同要求。选择线缆结构前应明确运动轨迹、行程、加速度、温度及目标评估，并通过固定夹让运动发生在预定柔性区域。接头拉力测试合格不能证明动态线缆寿命，样品失效后应先分析位置及模式，而不是简单增加护套厚度或尾套长度。

caption.en: A cable carrier illustrates the defined bend path of a moving installation.
caption.zh: 拖链说明运动安装中明确的弯曲路径。

title.en: From Mating Sample to Controlled Pinout
title.zh: 从对插样品到受控针脚表

copy.en: Start with the equipment receptacle reference and a clearly stated view of the contacts. Front mating views and rear wiring views can appear mirrored. Confirm circuit names, polarity, shield assignment and any unused cavities before building a sample. Shell markings may identify only part of the connector designation, so retain the full approved part number. An adapter between brands is a new defined circuit, not automatic electrical interchangeability.
copy.zh: 从设备插座料号及明确的触点观察方向开始。正面对插视图与背面接线视图可能呈镜像，打样前应确认回路名称、极性、屏蔽分配及空余孔位。壳体标记可能只涵盖接头名称的一部分，因此需保留完整认可料号。跨品牌转接线属于重新定义的回路，不代表电气上自动互换。

caption.en: An archival connector test interface with clearly labeled positions.
caption.zh: 带清晰位置标记的接头测试接口档案实拍。

copy.en: Termination follows the selected contact and cable. Soldering requires controlled stripping and heat input without allowing an excessively stiff solder-wicked section to enter the flex zone. Crimping requires the specified contact, wire range and tooling. The shield needs its own defined termination rather than incidental contact with the shell. Keep conductor preparation, insulation clearance and final inspection consistent between the approved sample and repeat builds.
copy.zh: 端接应跟随所选触点与线缆。焊接需要受控剥线及热输入，避免过长吸锡硬化段进入弯曲区域；压接则需匹配指定端子、适用线材和工装。屏蔽应有明确端接方式，不能依靠与外壳偶然接触。认可样品和重复生产之间，应保持导体准备、绝缘间隙及最终检查一致。

caption.en: A soldering tool illustrates controlled electrical termination work.
caption.zh: 焊接工具说明受控电气端接作业。

title.en: Extensions: Check the Whole Electrical Path
title.zh: 延长组件：检查完整电气路径

copy.en: An extension adds conductor length and another pair of contacts. For power this changes voltage drop and heating; for data it changes the channel loss and discontinuities. Retain the intended twisted pairs, coaxial construction and shield path through the assembly. Validate the complete connection with the actual equipment or agreed electrical method. A high-speed connector attached to an unsuitable cable cannot restore the performance lost elsewhere in the channel.
copy.zh: 延长组件增加导体长度及一组触点。对于供电，这会改变压降与发热；对于数据，则会改变通道损耗及不连续性。应在组件内保留预定双绞对、同轴结构和屏蔽通路，并使用实际设备或约定电气方法验证完整连接。高速接头接上不适合的电缆，无法恢复通道其他位置已经损失的性能。

caption.en: A bench amplifier measurement illustrates checking the complete electrical path.
caption.zh: 台面放大器测量说明完整电气通路检查。

copy.en: A useful sample approval records more than whether the plug fits. Confirm pinout, length datums, cable exit, labeling, latch access and the required inspection results. Transfer accepted choices into the drawing and material list before repeat production. Continuity and visual inspection form the basic release checks; additional electrical, mechanical or environmental checks follow the agreed project requirements. Changes to the cable, contact, plating or supplier need review before substitution.
copy.zh: 有效样品认可不只是确认插头能插入，还应确认针脚、长度基准、出线方式、标识、解锁空间及规定检验结果。重复生产前，将认可选择转为图纸与物料清单。导通及外观检查构成基础放行项目，其他电气、机械或环境检查按约定项目要求执行。线缆、触点、镀层或供应来源变化，应在替换前审核。

caption.en: An electrical continuity tester illustrates basic circuit verification.
caption.zh: 电气导通测试器说明基础回路验证。

q.en: Are these original LEMO parts or compatible alternatives?
q.zh: 采用原装 LEMO 零件还是兼容替代件？

a.en: The quotation and approved material list must identify which is supplied. Original parts and alternatives are not presented as the same product, and this page does not imply authorization by LEMO.
a.zh: 报价及认可物料清单应明确所供应的类型。原装件与替代件不会被作为同一产品表述，本页不表示获得 LEMO 品牌授权。

q.en: Are all push-pull connectors waterproof?
q.zh: 所有推拉接头都防水吗？

a.en: No. Protected indoor and sealed outdoor configurations differ. Confirm the exact series, cable seal and mating condition, then define any required assembly test.
a.zh: 不是。受保护室内配置与户外密封配置不同，应确认具体系列、电缆密封及对插状态，再规定所需组件试验。

q.en: Can you make an extension or adapter?
q.zh: 可以制作延长线或转接线吗？

a.en: Yes, subject to review of both interfaces, pinout, cable length and signal or power requirements. Physical mating alone is insufficient to define an adapter.
a.zh: 可以，需审核两端接口、针脚、线长及信号或供电要求，仅物理对插不足以定义转接组件。

q.en: What is needed for a coiled cable quotation?
q.zh: 螺旋电缆报价需要什么资料？

a.en: Specify relaxed and usable extended lengths, coil diameter, straight tails, conductor requirements, connectors and expected movement. Restoring force and mounting space also need review.
a.zh: 请说明收缩与可用伸展长度、圈径、两端直线段、导体要求、接头及预期运动，还需审核回弹力与安装空间。

q.en: Can a photograph identify the full connector?
q.zh: 一张照片能识别完整接头吗？

a.en: It can start the review, but the complete designation, insert, contact orientation and cable collet may need drawings or the mating sample. We do not infer a final pinout from appearance.
a.zh: 照片可以开始审核，但完整名称、绝缘体、触点方向及电缆夹头可能需要图纸或对插样品，不会从外观推定最终针脚。

q.en: Does a connector rating certify the finished cable?
q.zh: 接头额定值代表成品电缆认证吗？

a.en: No. Complete-assembly performance depends on the cable, termination, mounting and application. Required evidence and testing must be agreed for the actual configuration.
a.zh: 不代表。完整组件表现取决于线缆、端接、安装及应用，所需证据和试验应针对实际配置约定。
