intro.en: Custom Hirose-interface harnesses for board wiring, miniature coax and equipment connections, with documented routing, materials and inspection.
intro.zh: 定制 Hirose 接口线束，覆盖板内布线、微型同轴及设备连接，明确路径、材料与检验。

knowledge.en: Identify the complete series, mating pair and cable construction before selection.
knowledge.zh: 选型前确认完整系列、对插件及线缆结构。

notes.en: Provide pinout, mating parts, dimensions, environment and required evidence.
notes.zh: 提供针脚、对插件、尺寸、环境及证据要求。

delivery.en: Review the specification, confirm samples and release the production version.
delivery.zh: 审核规格，确认样品后放行生产版本。

subtitle.en: From the board connector to the complete installation
subtitle.zh: 从板端接口到完整安装

lead.en: A Hirose harness is a category of connections, not one fixed product. It may carry discrete control signals, power or an RF antenna channel, using a connector selected for the board, enclosure and service conditions. Super Smile reviews project-defined assemblies from drawings, samples and confirmed mating references. The following guide explains the available interface directions, their engineering trade-offs and the information needed to turn a prototype into a repeatable build. Brand and series names identify selection references, not automatic qualification of the finished cable.
lead.zh: Hirose 线束是一类连接方案，并非单一固定产品。它可能承担离散控制信号、供电或射频天线通道，接头须配合板卡、外壳及维护条件选择。超斯迈尔根据图纸、样品与明确对插料号审核定制组件。以下介绍接口方向、工程取舍，以及将样品转化为可重复生产产品所需资料。品牌与系列名用于选型参考，不代表完整电缆自动取得相应鉴定。

openingCaption.en: Hirose TM21 modular plug parts illustrate why the complete connector set matters.
openingCaption.zh: Hirose TM21 模块化插头零件，说明完整配套件的重要性。

copy.en: Hirose interfaces cover internal board wiring, miniature coax and external equipment connections. HR10 compact push-pull and HR30 waterproof plastic circular connectors address different installation needs; neither is identified by pin count alone. Start with the full connector reference, mating half and cable termination. Include the panel opening, cable exit and space needed to release the lock. A cable that fits electrically can still be inaccessible once the enclosure is assembled.
copy.zh: Hirose 接口覆盖板内布线、微型同轴及设备外部连接。HR10 小型推拉式与 HR30 防水塑料圆形连接器面向不同安装需求，均不能只凭针数识别。先明确完整料号、对插件及端接方式，再确认面板开孔、出线方向和解锁空间。电气连接正确的线缆，也可能在外壳装好后无法拆卸。

caption.en: An industrial camera illustrates the space available for external equipment connections.
caption.zh: 工业相机实例：设备外部接口需要结合安装空间选择。

copy.en: DF is a family prefix, not a single mating interface. DF13 uses 1.25mm pitch, while DF11 and DF51 are 2mm families with different configurations and locking arrangements. For DF51, distinguish the housing, matching header and specified contact; its side-lock arrangement needs access from the correct direction. Wire gauge, insulation diameter and the number of loaded circuits affect selection. Copy the complete part number from the drawing rather than ordering a generic 'Hirose 4-pin cable'.
copy.zh: DF 是系列前缀，并非统一对插接口。DF13 间距为 1.25mm，DF11、DF51 为 2mm 系列，但配置与锁紧结构不同。使用 DF51 时须区分壳体、配套针座及指定端子，并为侧边锁扣保留操作空间。线规、绝缘外径及同时通电的回路数都影响选型。应从图纸确认完整型号，而不是仅按“Hirose 四针线”下单。

caption.en: Board-mounted ribbon connection: housing access and cable exit are part of the layout review.
caption.zh: 板端排线连接实拍：壳体操作空间与出线方向都须纳入审核。

copy.en: Keep the complete series name: Hirose ZE05, ZH05 and ZE064W are not the JST ZE or ZH families. Hirose describes ZE05 for internal vehicle connections and ZE064W for external waterproof interfaces. GT17 is a shielded automotive data connector family, not a universal sealed power connector. Determine the actual mounting zone, counter-connector, seals and cable acceptance before discussing environmental performance. A positive lock improves retention; it does not by itself establish waterproofing or lifetime vibration performance.
copy.zh: 须保留完整系列名称：Hirose ZE05、ZH05、ZE064W 与 JST ZE、ZH 并非同一系列。Hirose 将 ZE05 用于车辆内部连接，ZE064W 用于外部防水接口；GT17 则是屏蔽车载数据连接器系列，不能当成通用密封动力接头。讨论环境性能前，应明确实际安装区域、对插件、密封件及适配线缆。锁扣有助于保持连接，但不能单独证明防水性或全寿命耐振动能力。

caption.en: Rain on a vehicle windshield represents external exposure, not an assembly waterproof test.
caption.zh: 车辆挡风玻璃上的雨滴，用于说明外部环境，并非线束防水试验。

title.zh: U.FL 与 W.FL2 微型同轴

copy.en: Miniature coax links connect radio modules to antennas while saving board height. U.FL and W.FL2 are separate interfaces with their own plug, receptacle, cable and handling specifications. Define impedance, working frequency, cable length and insertion-loss budget together. A thinner cable may route more easily but has different attenuation and mechanical limits. Align the mating axes and use the specified removal method; never lift a miniature plug by pulling its cable. Catalogue frequency claims apply to identified configurations, not every custom assembly.
copy.zh: 微型同轴在节省板上高度的同时连接射频模块与天线。U.FL、W.FL2 是不同接口，各有对应插头、插座、线缆和操作规范。应共同定义阻抗、工作频率、长度与插入损耗预算。细线更易布置，但衰减及机械承受能力也不同。对插时须对准轴线，拆卸遵循指定方法，不能拉扯线缆拔出微型插头。目录频率指标只适用于明确配置，不代表所有定制组件。

caption.en: U.FL cable plug close-up; identify the complete mating interface before assembly.
caption.zh: U.FL 线端插头近照，装配前须识别完整对插接口。

copy.en: A controller-to-sensor assembly can combine a board connector, shielded branch and serviceable external interface. Work from the machine's circuit diagram and installed route. Separate noisy switching power from sensitive feedback, define where shields terminate and support cables before they enter small housings. Cabinet-door movement, tool access and replacement order deserve the same attention as continuity. We review these details with the supplied drawings so branch dimensions describe the installed machine, not only a flat sample.
copy.zh: 控制器至传感器组件可组合板端接头、屏蔽分支及可维护外部接口。应依据设备电路图和实际路径设计，将开关电源等干扰源与敏感反馈分开，明确屏蔽端接位置，并在细小壳体前设置线缆支撑。柜门运动、工具空间与更换顺序和导通一样重要。我们结合客户图纸审核这些细节，使分支尺寸适合真实设备，而非只适合平放样品。

caption.en: A smart-meter electronics demonstration bench connects several functional modules.
caption.zh: 智能电表电子系统演示台，展示多个功能模块之间的连接。

title.zh: 新能源汽车控制与监测线束

copy.en: Battery monitoring, auxiliary control and traction power are different circuits. A connector used inside an inverter or battery enclosure is not automatically suitable for carrying motor power. Identify working voltage, isolation boundaries, current, temperature and service procedures on the schematic. Keep sensing references and communications away from high-energy switching paths where practical. High-voltage or safety-related work requires a project-specific qualification plan and approved parts; a familiar automotive brand does not replace that review.
copy.zh: 电池监测、辅助控制和驱动动力属于不同回路。在逆变器或电池壳体内使用的接头，不代表能够承担电机动力传输。须在原理图上标明工作电压、隔离边界、电流、温度与维护方式，并尽可能使采样参考及通信远离高能量开关回路。高压或安全相关项目必须具备专门鉴定计划及认可零件，不能用熟悉的车载品牌代替审核。

caption.en: A small battery-management board illustrates low-voltage monitoring, not traction-power cabling.
caption.zh: 小型电池管理板示例，说明低压监测功能而非牵引动力电缆。

copy.en: For monitors, pumps and diagnostic instruments, first distinguish internal wiring from an operator-accessible or patient-connected interface. Cleaning fluids, touch surfaces, leakage-current limits and EMC requirements belong to the finished equipment's risk assessment. A connector catalogue is not evidence that the complete cable is biocompatible, sterile or approved for patient contact. Provide the intended use and validation requirements early, including bend exposure, disinfection method and any traceability documents required for the delivered batch.
copy.zh: 监护、泵类及诊断仪器应先区分机内布线、操作者可触及接口和患者连接接口。清洁液、接触表面、漏电流限制及电磁兼容要求属于整机风险评估内容。连接器目录不能证明完整电缆具有生物相容性、无菌性或患者接触资格。应提前说明用途与验证要求，包括弯折工况、消毒方式及交付批次需要的追溯文件。

caption.en: Syringe-pump equipment: maintenance and connection requirements follow the medical system.
caption.zh: 注射泵设备参考：维护和连接要求须服从完整医疗系统。

title.zh: 物联网布线与天线路径

copy.en: In a compact gateway, the shortest physical wire route is not always the best RF route. Leave the antenna clearance specified by the module or antenna designer, avoid trapping coax under enclosure screws and keep the plug free from persistent side loading. Define the board connector and antenna-end connector independently, including polarity variants at external RF ports. Photographs and a marked enclosure drawing help identify cover interference, connector height and service-loop needs before a prototype is built.
copy.zh: 在小型网关中，物理距离最短的走线未必是最佳射频路径。应保留模块或天线设计要求的净空，避免同轴被壳体螺钉压住，并防止插头持续承受侧向拉力。板端与天线端接口须分别定义，外部射频口还需注意极性变型。照片及标注外壳图能帮助打样前识别盖板干涉、接头高度和维护余量。

caption.en: Router board with antenna pigtails shows the RF path between board and enclosure.
caption.zh: 带天线引线的路由板，展示板卡与外壳之间的射频路径。

copy.en: A fit review compares the mating drawing, keying, cavity assignment, contact gender and locking travel. Housing colour and an audible click are insufficient evidence. A cable-side socket can use a different naming convention from the equipment's pin description, so identify the viewed face on every pinout. If alternatives are permitted, list them separately for approval rather than silently substituting a visually similar part. Brand names on this page identify interface references, not distributorship or universal interchangeability.
copy.zh: 对插审核比较配合图、键位、孔位分配、接点公母及锁扣行程。壳体颜色与咔哒声都不足以证明正确。电缆侧插座的命名可能与设备针脚描述不同，因此每份针脚表都须注明观察面。允许替代时，应单列方案供确认，不能悄悄换成外形相似零件。本页品牌名称用于识别接口，不代表经销授权或通用互换承诺。

caption.en: Two miniature coax interface sizes: a visual resemblance does not establish interchangeability.
caption.zh: 两种微型同轴接口尺寸，外形相似不代表可以互配。

copy.en: The conductor crimp and insulation support do different jobs. Use the specified terminal, wire construction and applicator combination, then verify the relevant strip length, crimp geometry and retention criteria. Soldered versions need controlled heat input and strain relief outside the stiffened wire section. For shielded or coaxial assemblies, inspect shield continuity and the transition at the connector as well as the centre conductor. A continuity buzzer can find an open circuit but cannot establish a high-frequency channel's loss or impedance.
copy.zh: 导体压接与绝缘支撑承担不同作用。应使用指定端子、线材结构和模具组合，再核查相应剥线长度、压接形态与保持力要求。焊接版本需要控制热输入，并在导线硬化段之外设置应力释放。屏蔽或同轴组件除中心导体外，还须检查屏蔽连续性及接头过渡结构。导通蜂鸣器能够发现断路，却不能证明高频通道的损耗或阻抗。

caption.en: Crimp-tool example; actual terminals require their specified tool and setup.
caption.zh: 压接工具示例；实际端子须采用指定工具及设置。

copy.en: Specify the conductor, insulation and jacket separately. PVC, XLPE, PUR, FEP and PTFE describe material families, not one universal level of flexibility, flame performance or chemical resistance. Check the particular compound against temperature, fluids, UV exposure and movement. Cable outside diameter must remain within the contact support, clamp and seal's permitted range. Combining individually suitable parts can still leave a leak path or a bending weak point if the assembled interfaces are not reviewed.
copy.zh: 导体、绝缘与外护套应分别规定。PVC、XLPE、PUR、FEP、PTFE 只是材料类别，并不代表统一的柔性、阻燃或耐化学等级。具体配方须对应温度、液体、紫外线和运动条件审核。线缆外径还应处于端子支撑、夹紧件与密封件允许范围内。若未审核组装界面，即使各零件单独合适，组合后仍可能出现渗漏路径或弯折薄弱点。

caption.en: Ribbon cable separates conductor arrangement from the connector-selection decision.
caption.zh: 排线实物：导体排列与连接器选型是需要分别确认的条件。

copy.en: Define length between repeatable reference points, such as mating faces or branch centres, rather than an ambiguous 'overall length'. Add tolerances, connector orientation, breakout protection and labels to the drawing. Wire colour helps assembly but should not replace cavity numbers or circuit identification. A prototype records the approved routing and service allowance; production follows the released revision. Customization changes the cable configuration, not the moulded connector's available pin count or mating geometry.
copy.zh: 长度须在可重复的基准之间定义，例如对插面或分支中心，避免模糊的“总长”。图纸还应包括公差、接头朝向、分叉防护和标签。线色有助于装配，但不能替代孔位号及回路识别。样品用于确认路径与维护余量，生产按放行版本执行。定制改变的是线缆配置，并非随意改变注塑接头现有针位数或配合结构。

caption.en: Caliper scale close-up: define the measurement datum and method on the drawing.
caption.zh: 卡尺刻度近照：图纸须明确测量基准和方法。

copy.en: Cameras, audio devices and portable instruments often need short internal interconnects between boards, controls and power modules. The useful design question is whether the cable can be assembled and serviced without damaging a small header. Review mating height, latch access and the order in which boards enter the enclosure. Fine pitch saves space, but connector choice must still follow current, wire size and handling requirements. This application context is not a claim that every consumer device uses the same DF connector.
copy.zh: 相机、音频设备及便携仪器常需连接板卡、控制件和电源模块的短内部线。实际设计应关注装配或维护时能否避免损伤小型针座，并核查对插高度、锁扣空间与板卡装入顺序。小间距有助于节省空间，但仍须依据电流、线规及操作要求选型，不能推断所有消费电子都使用同一种 DF 接头。

caption.en: Electronics inside a digital caliper illustrate compact instrument packaging.
caption.zh: 数显卡尺内部电子组件，展示便携仪器的紧凑安装空间。

copy.en: PLC peripherals, machine vision and distributed sensors mix power, discrete I/O and data. Mark which cable sections remain fixed and which move during adjustment or maintenance. Give each branch a readable identifier and keep spare length away from hot or moving surfaces. A replaceable sensor connection can reduce service work only when the plug is reachable and the replacement cannot be mis-mated. Check those conditions in the installed equipment, not simply on the bench.
copy.zh: PLC 外设、机器视觉及分布式传感器同时涉及供电、离散 I/O 与数据。应标明固定线段及调节、维护时运动的线段，为分支设置易读标识，并避免余线接近高温或运动表面。可更换传感器接口只有在易于操作且不易误插时，才能减少维护工作；这些条件须在真实设备中核查，而非只在台面上检查。

caption.en: Controller board and stepper motor demonstrate the signal-to-actuator connection path.
caption.zh: 控制板与步进电机，展示信号到执行机构的连接路径。

title.zh: 汽车与新能源汽车应用

copy.en: Instrument panels, lighting controls and battery-management electronics have very different exposure levels. A cabin installation may be sheltered from direct water yet subject to heat cycling and vibration; an external connection needs a defined sealing system. Review the approved automotive connector and wire specifications for the installation zone. Do not extend a low-voltage monitoring connector's approval to a traction cable, or infer pressure-wash resistance from the vehicle application's name.
copy.zh: 仪表板、灯光控制及电池管理电子装置的环境差异很大。座舱连接可能不直接淋水，却仍受冷热循环与振动影响；外部连接则需要明确的密封系统。应依据安装区域审核认可车载接头和电线规范。不能把低压监测接头的认可范围延伸到动力高压线，也不能因为用于车辆就推断能够承受高压冲洗。

caption.en: An electric vehicle at a charging point illustrates system context, not cable qualification.
caption.zh: 充电点的电动汽车，用于说明系统场景，不代表线缆取得相关鉴定。

copy.en: An internal display cable, a detachable handpiece lead and a diagnostic sensor cable need different service and validation plans. Repeated cleaning may affect jackets and markings; frequent disconnection may require a connector with an appropriate mating-life specification. Identify whether the cable is a replaceable accessory or an internal component. Agree the relevant equipment-level standards and test responsibilities with the device manufacturer before quoting regulated or patient-related work.
copy.zh: 机内显示连接、可拆手柄线及诊断传感器电缆需要不同维护与验证计划。反复清洁可能影响护套和标识，频繁插拔则要求相应寿命规格。须明确电缆属于可更换附件还是内部零件。涉及法规或患者相关项目时，应在报价前与设备制造商约定适用整机标准及试验职责。

caption.en: Patient-monitor equipment: internal electronics and accessible patient connections have different duties.
caption.zh: 患者监护设备：内部电子连接与患者可触及接口承担不同职责。

copy.en: Router antenna pigtails, radio modules and network equipment connect RF and digital channels that must be specified separately. For coax, document impedance and frequency-dependent loss. For differential data, define the pair arrangement, shielding and interface requirement. A shielded connector is not a guarantee that a custom cable supports every data rate. Test adapters, reference planes and acceptance limits need to match the channel being evaluated, particularly when comparing prototypes from different suppliers.
copy.zh: 路由器天线尾线、无线模块和网络设备的射频与数字通道须分别定义。同轴应明确阻抗及随频率变化的损耗，差分数据则应说明线对排列、屏蔽及接口要求。使用屏蔽接头不代表定制线缆支持所有速率。特别是在比较不同供应商样品时，测试转接件、参考面和验收限值必须与被测通道一致。

caption.en: Wireless router and external antennas place cable routing within the complete radio system.
caption.zh: 无线路由器及外置天线，线缆路径是完整无线系统的一部分。

copy.en: Connector retention and cable flex life are separate questions. Keep bending away from the termination, support the cable at the moving structure and distinguish repeated bending from torsion. The motion profile should include travel, acceleration, bend radius, rotation and the required service interval. Cable-carrier suitability cannot be inferred from a soft jacket alone. Prototype routing checks should look for rubbing, snagging and load transfer into small board connectors through the full movement.
copy.zh: 接头保持力与电缆弯折寿命是两个问题。应使弯曲远离端接区，在运动结构处支撑线缆，并区分往复弯曲与扭转。运动描述应包括行程、加速度、弯曲半径、转角及维护周期。不能仅因护套柔软就认定适合拖链。样机须在完整运动范围内检查摩擦、勾挂及拉力是否传递到小型板端接头。

caption.en: Industrial robot cells illustrate repeated motion and the need to separate moving and fixed routes.
caption.zh: 工业机器人单元，展示重复运动及动静布线路径划分的需求。

copy.en: These projects require a defined qualification route rather than a brand-based assurance. Connector series, wire construction, flammability, outgassing, traceability and acceptance records may all be controlled by the equipment specification. Ground test equipment and flight-installed harnesses are different scopes. Submit the actual standards and intended installation for capability review. A commercial Hirose interface or an aerospace application photograph does not establish military qualification, flight approval or space suitability for our assembly.
copy.zh: 此类项目需要明确鉴定路径，而非依靠品牌作保证。设备规范可能同时约束接头系列、线材、燃烧性能、释气、追溯及验收记录。地面测试设备与飞行安装线束属于不同范围。请提交实际标准和安装用途开展能力审核。商用 Hirose 接口或航空应用配图，都不能证明本公司组件具有军规、飞行或空间应用资格。

caption.en: Aircraft cockpit-panel exhibit; application context is not aerospace approval.
caption.zh: 飞机座舱仪表板展品；应用参考并非航空资格证明。

title.zh: 智能家居与物联网应用

copy.en: Sensors, smart meters and connected appliances place antennas near power supplies, displays and metal covers. Verify wireless performance in the finished enclosure because a cable that works in an open prototype can behave differently after assembly. Define antenna spacing and routing constraints with the electronics designer. Small connectors should be supported during service, and label or colour variants should prevent crossed antenna branches. Keep test access available without repeatedly disturbing a limited-cycle micro-coax connection.
copy.zh: 传感器、智能电表及联网电器常将天线布置在电源、显示屏与金属盖板附近。须在完整外壳中验证无线性能，因为开放样机中正常的线缆，装机后表现可能不同。应与电子设计人员共同规定天线间距及走线限制。维护时需支撑小型接头，用标签或颜色防止天线分支接错，并预留测试入口，避免反复扰动插拔次数有限的微型同轴接口。

caption.en: Smart-meter gateway installed in a cabinet: access and routing are enclosure-dependent.
caption.zh: 安装于柜内的智能电表网关，操作空间和路径取决于外壳布局。

copy.en: Contact resistance, wire resistance and complete-loop resistance are not interchangeable measurements. Record the test points and method before setting an acceptance limit. A two-wire measurement includes lead resistance; a four-wire method can help resolve low resistance when the fixture is appropriate. Current produces heating according to I²R, but the temperature rise also depends on cooling and neighbouring loaded contacts. Compare results under controlled conditions and against the selected component or assembly specification, not an invented universal milliohm value.
copy.zh: 接触电阻、导线电阻和完整回路电阻不是同一种测量。设定限值前应记录测试位置与方法；两线法包含测试线电阻，合适夹具下的四线法有助于分辨低电阻。电流按 I²R 产生热量，但温升还与散热及邻近通电接点有关。结果应在受控条件下与所选零件或组件规范比较，不能编造统一毫欧限值。

caption.en: Digital multimeter reference; low-resistance measurements need a suitable method and fixture.
caption.zh: 数字万用表参考；低电阻测量须配合适用的方法及夹具。

copy.en: A catalogue mating-cycle rating describes a specified test, not unlimited service use. Small internal RF connectors and repeatedly operated external circular connectors can have very different intended duty. Count prototype debugging and production testing as well as field maintenance when considering wear. Use the correct mating tool or handling method and inspect for damaged contacts or shells. Qualification cycling is normally a planned sample test, not a reason to consume the full rated life of every shipped connector.
copy.zh: 目录插拔次数对应指定试验，并非无限维护使用。小型机内射频接头与经常操作的外部圆形接头，设计工况可能差异很大。评估磨损时应计入样机调试、生产测试及现场维护。应使用正确工具或操作方法，检查接点与外壳损伤。寿命循环通常属于计划内样品试验，不应让每件出货接头先耗尽额定插拔寿命。

caption.en: Miniature board connector beside a match head shows the scale of careful handling.
caption.zh: 微型板端连接器与火柴头对照，提示小尺寸接口的操作要求。

copy.en: Terminal retention in a housing, crimp tensile strength and the force needed to release a connector lock are separate properties. The test fixture must apply load in the specified direction without masking the weak point. Cable clamps and supports should keep operating loads out of small contacts and PCB solder joints. Pull testing can be destructive, so define sampling and disposition of tested pieces. A firm hand pull or audible latch click is useful assembly feedback, not a measured validation result.
copy.zh: 端子在壳体内的保持力、压接拉脱力及接头解锁力是不同性能。夹具须按指定方向加载，不能掩盖薄弱处。线夹和支撑应避免工作拉力传入小型接点或板上焊点。拉力测试可能具有破坏性，应定义抽样及被测件处置。手拉感觉牢固或听见锁扣声可作为装配反馈，但不能替代测量验证。

caption.en: An internal cable clamp illustrates strain relief independently of contact retention.
caption.zh: 内部线缆夹持结构，用于说明与端子保持力不同的应力释放。

copy.en: An IP claim belongs to a defined configuration and test condition. Confirm whether the connector is tested mated, capped or unmated, and whether the cable entry and panel interface are included. HR30's published waterproof conditions, for example, do not automatically describe a complete enclosure with a custom cable. Bending near a seal, cable diameter variation and missing blanking plugs can change performance. Condensation and capillary migration through a cable also need attention; external sealing alone may not control every moisture path.
copy.zh: IP 声明对应明确配置及试验条件。须确认是在对插、加盖还是未插合状态下测试，以及是否包括入线口和面板界面。例如 HR30 公布的防水条件，不能自动代表装入定制电缆后的完整外壳。密封附近弯折、线径变化或遗漏堵头均可能改变表现；冷凝及沿线缆毛细迁移也需关注，外部密封并不一定能阻断所有水汽路径。

caption.en: Rain seen through a windshield represents a wet environment, not an IP certification result.
caption.zh: 透过挡风玻璃看到的雨景，说明湿润环境，并非 IP 认证结果。

copy.en: The inspection plan should separate routine production checks from qualification and destructive sampling. Agree circuit continuity, short-circuit detection, visual criteria, dimensional checks and any additional electrical requirements. Record the approved drawing revision and the fixture or program used. A passed harness test does not establish RF bandwidth, environmental life or equipment safety unless those are specifically covered. Traceable results make a later failure investigation more useful than a generic '100% tested' label.
copy.zh: 检验计划应区分常规生产检查、鉴定试验及破坏性抽样。须约定导通、短路检测、外观、尺寸及附加电气要求，并记录认可图纸版本和所用夹具、程序。线束测试通过不代表射频带宽、环境寿命或设备安全也已验证，除非这些项目明确包含在测试范围。可追溯结果比笼统的“全检”标签更有助于后续故障调查。

caption.en: Super Smile workshop photograph: harness and test equipment at the inspection station.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔车间实拍：检查工位的线束与测试设备。

title.en: Match the Series to the Circuit
title.zh: 让系列与回路需求对应

copy.en: For internal discrete wiring, compare complete DF configurations rather than pitch alone. For vehicle interfaces, separate an internal ZE05 connection from the selected external sealed system. For antenna links, match the exact U.FL or W.FL2 cable assembly and board receptacle. Mixed-function harnesses can combine separate signal, power and RF branches, but they still require clear electrical boundaries, shielding and mechanical support. Start with the circuit and installation, then select the interface; do not force the project around an available connector photograph.
copy.zh: 机内离散线应比较完整 DF 配置，而非仅比较间距。车载接口须区分内部 ZE05 连接与选定外部密封系统；天线连接则须匹配具体 U.FL 或 W.FL2 组件和板端插座。混合功能线束可组合独立信号、供电及射频分支，但仍需明确电气边界、屏蔽和机械支撑。应从回路及安装需求出发选择接口，不能围绕一张现成接头照片硬套项目。

caption.en: MHF4-to-U.FL adapter leads demonstrate distinct interface ends rather than universal compatibility.
caption.zh: MHF4 转 U.FL 引线，展示两端不同接口，而非通用互配关系。

copy.en: Provide the schematic, pinout, mating references, length datum and enclosure constraints. Mark unresolved functions rather than guessing from a sample's colour code. We review the proposed assembly against the supplied information and identify questions that affect materials, tooling or inspection. A photograph can start the discussion, but it cannot reveal hidden splices, shielding bonds or component ratings. Resolve those uncertainties before committing the production configuration.
copy.zh: 提供原理图、针脚表、对插料号、长度基准及外壳限制，对未明确功能做好标记，不凭样品线色猜测。我们依据客户资料审核组件，识别影响物料、工装和检验的问题。照片可以启动沟通，却无法揭示隐藏接点、屏蔽连接及零件额定值；这些不确定项应在确定生产配置前解决。

caption.en: Super Smile workshop desk and harness references used as an engineering-context photograph.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔车间工作台及线束资料，工程作业场景实拍。

copy.en: The bill of materials should identify housings, contacts, seals, retainers, cable and protective accessories individually. Specify whether original Hirose parts are mandatory and whether alternatives may be considered. Check compatibility, availability and tooling for the complete set, not just the most visible housing. Purchasing descriptions should retain manufacturer references and approved revisions so a later reorder does not silently become a different assembly.
copy.zh: 物料表应逐项列出壳体、端子、密封、保持件、线缆和防护附件，并说明是否必须使用 Hirose 原装零件及能否评估替代。兼容性、供货和工装应覆盖整套物料，而非只看最显眼壳体。采购描述须保留制造商料号与认可版本，避免后续补单无意间变成不同组件。

caption.en: Super Smile wire preparation close-up: conductor and insulation details enter the material review.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔线材准备近照：导体与绝缘细节须纳入物料审核。

copy.en: The first article translates the approved documents into a physical assembly. Record cutting, stripping, termination, insertion and protection details that affect repeatability. Keep the sample's part and wire references linked to its inspection record. If a bend or branch must move to fit the enclosure, revise the drawing instead of leaving the adjustment as undocumented workshop knowledge. A prototype is a controlled learning step, not automatic production approval.
copy.zh: 首件将认可文件转化为实物组件。影响重复性的裁线、剥线、端接、插装及防护细节应记录下来，样品零件与线材信息也须关联检验记录。若为适配外壳需要移动弯曲或分支位置，应修订图纸，不能只靠车间口头经验。打样是受控确认过程，不等同于自动批准量产。

caption.en: Electronics workbench with microscope and soldering equipment; prototype-work reference.
caption.zh: 配有显微镜及焊接设备的电子工作台，样品作业参考。

copy.en: Check the sample with the real mating equipment or an agreed representative fixture. Confirm latch access, connector direction, branch reach and enclosure closure. Exercise moving covers or adjustable modules through their intended travel. Electrical function should follow the approved circuit definition and safe test procedure, not trial-and-error pin swapping. Record any difference between the sample fixture and the final installation so the remaining equipment-level checks are clear.
copy.zh: 使用真实对插设备或约定的代表性夹具核查样品，确认锁扣操作、接头方向、分支长度及外壳闭合。活动盖板和可调模块须走完预定行程。电气功能按认可回路及安全测试程序确认，不能用随意换针方式试错。应记录样品夹具与最终安装的差异，明确仍需完成的整机检查。

caption.en: Cable routing and retention inside a keyboard illustrate enclosure-level fit checks.
caption.zh: 键盘内部的走线与固定结构，说明整机装配适配检查。

copy.en: Select tests by circuit function. Continuity and short-circuit checks suit wire mapping; insulation or withstand testing requires agreed limits and protection for any connected electronics. RF assemblies may need insertion loss or return loss across the required band with suitable adapters and calibration. Compare like-for-like configurations and retain the method with the result. We confirm the required test scope, equipment and responsibilities before accepting specialized measurement commitments.
copy.zh: 按回路功能选择测试。导通、短路检查用于核对线序；绝缘或耐压测试须约定限值，并保护连接的电子元件。射频组件可能需要使用合适转接件与校准，在指定频段测量插入损耗或回波损耗。比较时应保持配置一致，并将方法与结果一起保存。专用测量承诺应在确认测试范围、设备及职责后作出。

caption.en: Portable vector network analyzer: RF checks require the appropriate instrument and calibration.
caption.zh: 便携式矢量网络分析仪，射频检查须配合适用仪器与校准。

copy.en: Approval should cover the drawing, BOM, sample deviations, inspection requirements and packaging, not just the sample's appearance. Name the revision that becomes the production reference. Later changes to a connector, wire compound or cable length may require renewed review, especially for sealed or RF assemblies. Keeping a clear change record allows purchasing, engineering and production to discuss the same configuration when an order is repeated.
copy.zh: 确认范围应覆盖图纸、物料表、样品偏差、检验及包装，而非只认可外观。应明确作为生产依据的版本。后续更换接头、线材配方或长度可能需要重新审核，密封或射频组件尤其如此。清晰变更记录能让采购、工程和生产在复购时讨论同一配置。

caption.en: Super Smile harness bundles; photographs support identification but do not replace approved drawings.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔线束实拍；照片可辅助识别，不能代替批准图纸。

copy.en: Repeat production follows the released material and process definition. Establish the relevant setup checks, identification rules and inspection points, and keep nonconforming material separate from accepted product. Tooling maintenance and operator instructions influence consistency as much as the initial sample. Any shortage-driven substitution must return to the approval process. Batch quantity and delivery timing are confirmed against the actual component set and manufacturing requirements.
copy.zh: 重复生产按已放行物料和工艺定义执行，设置相关开机确认、标识规则及检验点，并将不合格物料与合格品分开。工装维护及作业指导对一致性的影响并不低于最初样品。因缺料提出的替代须重新进入批准流程。批量与交期依据实际零件组合和制造要求确认。

caption.en: Super Smile production workstation; the released process defines each order's build.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔生产工位，具体订单须依据已放行工艺制作。

copy.en: Review the inspection record against the order's acceptance criteria and check that labels identify the correct version. Routine checks and sampled destructive tests should not be confused in the release statement. Where a customer requires certificates or test reports, agree their content and batch linkage before manufacture. A report should describe what was actually checked; unperformed environmental, medical or RF tests must not appear as passed results.
copy.zh: 依据订单验收标准复核检验记录，核查标签是否对应正确版本。放行说明不能混淆常规检查与破坏性抽样。客户要求证书或报告时，应在制造前约定其内容和批次关联方式。报告只能描述实际执行的检查，未开展的环境、医疗或射频试验不能写成通过。

caption.en: Microscope-assisted electronics work illustrates close visual access, not a completed inspection record.
caption.zh: 显微镜辅助电子作业，展示细节观察方式，并非已完成的检验记录。

copy.en: Protect small connector faces from impact and contamination, and avoid bending a cable sharply at its termination. Bundle labels should remain readable without repeatedly unpacking sensitive micro-coax leads. Apply ESD protection where the supplied assembly requires it, rather than assuming every passive cable needs identical packaging. Confirm pack quantity, traceability labels and delivery documents with the order. Shipping protection preserves the approved sample condition; it does not replace incoming inspection at the customer's site.
copy.zh: 保护小型对插面免受撞击与污染，避免端接处急弯。整束标签应便于读取，不必反复拆开敏感微型同轴线。根据实际组件需求采用静电防护，不能假定所有无源电缆都需要相同包装。订单中应确认包装数量、追溯标签及交付文件。运输防护用于保持认可样品状态，不能替代客户到货检查。

caption.en: Circuit board in an antistatic bag illustrates protection during storage and handling.
caption.zh: 防静电袋内的电路板，展示储存与搬运中的保护方式。

copy.en: Send the complete Hirose part references or clear mating samples, circuit mapping, dimensions, cable requirements, use environment and quantity range. Tell us which items are fixed and which can be reviewed as alternatives. Include special test or document requirements before comparing prices. Super Smile reviews custom cable and harness projects against these inputs; this page does not claim Hirose authorization, universal stock or pre-qualified supply for every application described.
copy.zh: 请提供完整 Hirose 料号或清晰对插样品、回路映射、尺寸、线缆要求、使用环境及数量范围，说明哪些项目不可变更、哪些允许评估替代。比较报价前应列出特殊试验或文件需求。超斯迈尔依据这些资料审核定制电缆及线束项目；本页不声明 Hirose 授权、所有型号库存或对所述所有应用已经完成鉴定。

caption.en: Technician identifying connector wiring; application reference, not Super Smile staff or a Hirose claim.
caption.zh: 技术人员处理连接器布线，作业参考，非超斯迈尔员工或 Hirose 型号证明。

q.en: What does “Hirose compatible” mean?
q.zh: “Hirose 兼容”是什么意思？

a.en: It identifies an interface to be confirmed, not a promise that different series interchange. The approved BOM states whether original Hirose parts or separately reviewed alternatives are supplied.
a.zh: 表示需要确认的接口方向，并非不同系列可互换的承诺。认可物料表应注明使用 Hirose 原装件还是另行审核的替代件。

q.en: Can wire length and pin assignments be customized?
q.zh: 能定制线长与针脚吗？

a.en: Yes, subject to the selected connector's available configurations and an approved circuit drawing. Custom wiring does not change the connector's moulded mating geometry.
a.zh: 可以依据所选接头现有配置及认可回路图定制。定制布线不改变接头已成型的配合结构。

q.en: Are all automotive Hirose connectors waterproof?
q.zh: 所有 Hirose 车载接头都防水吗？

a.en: No. Internal wiring, shielded data and external sealed interfaces have different specifications. Identify the complete series and assembled sealing conditions.
a.zh: 不是。内部布线、屏蔽数据及外部密封接口各有规范，必须明确完整系列及组装密封条件。

q.en: Are U.FL and W.FL2 interchangeable?
q.zh: U.FL 与 W.FL2 可以互换吗？

a.en: Do not assume so. Match the exact plug, receptacle, cable and tooling from the manufacturer's mating information.
a.zh: 不能如此假定。须按制造商对插资料匹配具体插头、插座、线缆与工具。

q.en: Which catalogue should I provide?
q.zh: 应提供哪份目录资料？

a.en: The current series catalogue plus the complete part's drawing, mating reference and application instructions. A series name alone is insufficient for a controlled build.
a.zh: 提供现行系列目录、完整型号图纸、对插料号及应用说明。只有系列名称不足以支持受控制作。

q.en: What testing is included?
q.zh: 包含哪些测试？

a.en: The order defines routine checks and any additional qualification or sampling. RF, ingress, life and regulated-equipment tests require an agreed method and scope.
a.zh: 订单明确常规检查及附加鉴定、抽样项目。射频、防水、寿命及法规相关设备试验需另行约定方法和范围。

q.en: Can medical equipment projects be reviewed?
q.zh: 可以审核医疗设备项目吗？

a.en: Yes, with intended use, safety and validation requirements supplied for review. No blanket patient-contact, sterility or biocompatibility claim is made.
a.zh: 可以提交用途、安全及验证要求进行审核，但不作通用患者接触、无菌或生物相容性声明。

intro.en: Project-defined Amphenol-interface cables and harnesses, with documented connector selection, materials, routing and inspection.
intro.zh: 按项目定义 Amphenol 接口电缆与线束，明确连接器选型、材料、布线及检验。

knowledge.en: Choose the exact family, mating references and cable construction; a brand name does not define the assembly.
knowledge.zh: 明确系列、对插料号及电缆结构，品牌名不能定义完整组件。

notes.en: Provide circuit mapping, dimensions, environment, quantities and required evidence.
notes.zh: 提供回路、尺寸、环境、数量及所需证据。

delivery.en: Review parts and tooling, confirm the first article and release repeat production.
delivery.zh: 审核零件与工装，确认首件后放行重复生产。

subtitle.en: Connectors, materials and the installation as one system
subtitle.zh: 连接器、材料与安装共同构成系统

lead.en: Amphenol describes a broad group of interconnection technologies, not one standard cable. A project may involve a circular industrial connector, a sealed vehicle branch, a battery power link or a specialized communication channel. Super Smile develops defined assemblies from drawings, samples and confirmed mating references. This guide follows the selection from connector families through materials, application environments and manufacturing controls. It explains what the assembly needs to do and what evidence must be agreed before supply, rather than treating every catalogue option as an already qualified company product.
lead.zh: Amphenol 涵盖广泛互连技术，并非一种标准电缆。项目可能涉及圆形工业接头、密封车辆分支、电池供电连接或专用通信通道。超斯迈尔依据图纸、样品和明确对插料号开发指定组件。以下从连接系列讲到材料、应用环境及制造控制，说明组件需要完成的功能和供货前应约定的证据，而不将所有目录选项视作本公司已鉴定产品。

openingCaption.en: Amphenol circular connectors before and after wire termination.
openingCaption.zh: Amphenol 圆形接头端接前后实拍。

copy.en: Circular is a shape, not a universal interface. C091 signalmate, ecomate C16, ecomate RM and MIL-DTL-38999 families differ in coupling, inserts, contact systems and intended qualification. Specify the shell size, insert arrangement, contact gender and key orientation before selecting a backshell. The cable exit, panel thickness and space needed to rotate a coupling ring also matter. An assembly that mates on the bench can still be impossible to install behind a crowded panel. Identify both ends with manufacturer drawings; never infer interchangeability from diameter or pin count.
copy.zh: 圆形只是外形，不是统一接口。C091 signalmate、ecomate C16、ecomate RM 与 MIL-DTL-38999 系列在锁紧、绝缘体排列、接点系统及适用鉴定要求上各不相同。选择尾壳前，应明确壳号、排列、接点公母和键位方向。出线方向、面板厚度及旋转锁环的空间同样重要：工作台上能对插的组件，不一定能装进拥挤面板后方。两端应依据制造商图纸识别，不能根据直径或针数推断互换。

caption.en: An Amphenol cable connector used on Elinchrom equipment; identify the exact family before mating.
caption.zh: Elinchrom 设备上的 Amphenol 电缆接头；对插前须识别确切系列。

copy.en: Battery links are selected as a power path, including the cable, compression joint, connector and equipment terminal. SurLok and SurLok Plus are useful Amphenol search terms, but they are not the same environmental configuration. The selected variant determines sealing, contact size, cable acceptance and accessory options. Continuous current, pulse duration, enclosure temperature and cooling affect the thermal review. Provide polarity, mechanical keying and an installation drawing with the enquiry. High-voltage work also requires an approved safety and validation plan; colour alone is not evidence of electrical capability.
copy.zh: 电池连接应作为完整供电路径选择，包含电缆、压接部位、连接器及设备端子。SurLok 与 SurLok Plus 是有用的 Amphenol 检索词，但环境配置并不相同。密封、接点尺寸、适用电缆及附件取决于所选变体。持续电流、脉冲时间、箱体温度和散热条件影响热审核。询价应提供极性、防错键位和安装图；涉及高压时，还需认可的安全及验证计划，颜色本身不能证明电气能力。

caption.en: Battery storage installation: power connections are reviewed within their enclosure and thermal environment.
caption.zh: 储能设备实景：供电连接需要结合箱体和热环境审核。

title.en: Why Use an Amphenol Connection System?
title.zh: 为什么选择 Amphenol 连接系统？

copy.en: A broad catalogue can make it easier to find a documented interface for a particular job. Reliability still comes from matching that interface to the environment and manufacturing it correctly. Compare quotations on a complete BOM basis: contacts, seals, locks, backshells, tooling, inspection and minimum purchasing quantities can change the total cost. A cheaper housing can become an expensive assembly if its contacts are unavailable or installation needs extra labour. We explain the selected family and proposed alternatives, without claiming that one brand is always cheaper, more reliable or suitable for every application.
copy.zh: 较广的产品目录有助于找到适合特定任务、资料明确的接口，但可靠性仍来自正确选型和制造。报价比较应基于完整物料表：端子、密封、锁件、尾壳、工装、检验及最低采购量都会影响总成本。更便宜的胶壳，如果配套端子缺货或安装需要额外工时，成品成本反而可能更高。我们说明所选系列及拟议替代方案，不宣称某一品牌永远更便宜、更可靠或适合全部应用。

caption.en: A legacy nine-pin Amphenol equipment interface illustrates why the mating reference matters.
caption.zh: 旧式九针 Amphenol 设备接口，说明对插料号的重要性。

copy.en: Material control begins with identifiable part references and purchasing records. The wire specification should describe conductor construction, insulation, outer diameter and required markings, not just a colour and nominal area. Record housing and contact revisions where they affect fit or processing. Material declarations, certificates of conformity and inspection records answer different questions. Agree which documents are needed and how they relate to the supplied batch before ordering. A familiar supplier name is not a substitute for checking the actual material delivered to the line.
copy.zh: 材料控制从可识别料号与采购记录开始。线材规格应描述导体结构、绝缘、外径及必要标识，而不只是颜色和标称截面。胶壳及端子的版本如果影响装配或加工，也应记录。材料声明、符合性文件与检验记录解决不同问题，应在下单前约定所需文件及其与供货批次的对应关系。供应商名称熟悉，并不能替代对实际投入生产材料的检查。

caption.en: Cable stock and reels: construction, batch and material records must stay identifiable.
caption.zh: 电缆库存与线盘：结构、批次及材料记录需要清晰对应。

title.en: Silicone Seals and Complete Sealing Paths
title.zh: 硅胶密封与完整密封路径

copy.en: Rear wire seals, interface seals, cavity plugs and panel seals protect different entry paths. Their dimensions and compression must match the specified housing and cable. A seal selected by conductor gauge alone can be wrong because two wires with the same copper area may have different insulation diameters. Chemical exposure also depends on the particular elastomer compound and fluid. Amphenol's ecomate RSSM guidance, for example, requires RSSM plugs and receptacles together for its stated IP69K performance. Do not transfer that rating to a mixed pair or a finished harness without the relevant evidence.
copy.zh: 后部线封、对插界面密封、空腔堵头与面板密封分别防护不同进水路径，其尺寸和压缩量必须匹配指定壳体及电缆。只按导体线规选线封可能出错，因为相同铜截面的线材可有不同绝缘外径。耐化学性也取决于具体弹性体配方和介质。例如 Amphenol 的 ecomate RSSM 说明要求 RSSM 插头与插座配套，才能满足其规定的 IP69K 性能；不能将该额定值移用到混配接头或缺少验证的成品线束。

caption.en: NBR O-rings shown as sealing-material examples, not the seals specified for every connector.
caption.zh: NBR O 形圈作为密封材料示例，并非所有接头的指定密封件。

copy.en: Thermoplastic and metal shells solve different packaging problems. A lightweight polymer housing can integrate latches and colour coding; a metal shell may support a defined shielding and mechanical interface. Neither material is automatically the better choice. Review impact, vibration, temperature, cleaning fluids, UV exposure and panel mounting together. Resin type, reinforcement and flame classification belong to the exact component specification. A UL94 classification for a plastic specimen is not a fire-survival claim for the entire cable assembly. Preserve the manufacturer's approved accessories and installation conditions.
copy.zh: 热塑性塑料与金属外壳解决不同布置问题。轻质聚合物壳体可集成锁扣与颜色标识，金属壳体则可能承担明确的屏蔽及机械接口功能，两者没有绝对优劣。应共同审核冲击、振动、温度、清洗介质、紫外线和面板安装。树脂、增强材料与阻燃分类属于准确零件规格；塑料试样的 UL94 分类不是整条组件的耐火运行承诺。应保留制造商认可的附件与安装条件。

caption.en: Polymer granules: the specified resin grade matters more than appearance.
caption.zh: 聚合物粒料：指定树脂牌号比外观更重要。

title.en: Terminals: Conductor Crimp and Insulation Support
title.zh: 端子：导体压接与绝缘支撑

copy.en: Stamped-and-formed contacts and machined contacts need their own tooling and acceptance instructions. In an open-barrel contact, the conductor crimp establishes the electrical and mechanical joint while a separate support feature may grip the insulation or seal. That support must not be confused with the conductor crimp. A machined contact may use an indentation process and a different locator. Strip length, strand damage, contact position and pull-test requirements are therefore contact-specific. There is no single universal crimp setting for all Amphenol families or wire sizes.
copy.zh: 冲压成形端子与车制端子需要各自的工装和判定说明。开口端子的导体压接建立电气与机械连接，独立支撑结构可能夹持绝缘或密封件，不能将它与导体压接混为一谈。车制端子则可能采用压痕工艺及不同定位器。因此，剥皮长度、线股损伤、端子位置与拉力要求均应针对具体端子确定，不存在适用于全部 Amphenol 系列和线径的统一压接设置。

caption.en: Blade crimp terminals illustrate conductor and terminal matching; each contact needs its own tooling instruction.
caption.zh: 插片压接端子展示导体与端子的配合；每种接点均需对应工装说明。

title.zh: 镀金接点：明确镀层配置

copy.en: Contact plating is a controlled material stack, not merely a visible colour. Gold, tin and other finishes must match the selected contact design and mating partner. The approved drawing establishes thickness and underplate where applicable; a catalogue value from one family does not apply to every Amphenol pin. Low-level signals can be sensitive to unstable contact resistance, while power contacts need a thermal review at their actual load. Keep contact finish in the BOM and avoid unapproved mixing during a supply substitution. Mating-cycle capability is also configuration-dependent.
copy.zh: 接点镀层是受控材料组合，不只是可见颜色。金、锡及其他镀层必须匹配所选端子设计和对插件；厚度及适用底镀层以认可图纸为准，某一系列目录中的数值不能套用到所有 Amphenol 插针。低电平信号可能对接触电阻波动敏感，功率接点则需按实际负载审核温升。物料表应保留镀层配置，缺料替代时避免未经认可的混配；插拔寿命同样取决于具体配置。

caption.en: Metal contact surfaces on a pin header; colour alone cannot establish the plating specification.
caption.zh: 排针金属接触表面；仅凭颜色不能确认镀层规格。

copy.en: A high-voltage connection can combine power contacts, touch protection, shielding and an interlock circuit, depending on the selected series. HVIL reports a connection state to the equipment's control system; it does not independently make every exposed conductor safe. The project must define voltage, current, creepage and clearance, shield termination, cable retention and the isolation procedure. High-voltage cable assemblies enter engineering and process review before a supply commitment. Any dielectric or insulation-resistance test must use approved limits and account for fitted electronics, rather than applying an arbitrary test voltage to every assembly.
copy.zh: 高压连接可依据所选系列组合功率接点、触碰防护、屏蔽及互锁回路。HVIL 将连接状态传给设备控制系统，并不会独立保证所有暴露导体安全。项目必须定义电压、电流、爬电与电气间隙、屏蔽端接、电缆保持及隔离程序。高压组件在承诺供货前进入工程与工艺审核；耐压或绝缘电阻试验须采用认可限值，并考虑已装电子元件，不能对所有组件任意施加同一种试验电压。

caption.en: Battery-pack warning labels highlight the need for defined high-voltage handling and validation.
caption.zh: 电池包警示标识提示高压操作及验证必须明确。

title.zh: 汽车接口与 Deutsch 对照

copy.en: AT, ATM, ATP and AHD are distinct Amphenol Sine product families. Cross-reference information can help identify a candidate, but approval needs the exact original and proposed part numbers, including suffixes. Check keying, seal range, contact system, accessories and mating dimensions. ATM uses a smaller contact system than AT or ATP; the names are not synonyms. A diagnostic AHD connector also needs the agreed vehicle pin map and mechanical coding. Treat a cross-reference as the beginning of a comparison, not proof that every colour, cavity count or special variant is interchangeable.
copy.zh: AT、ATM、ATP 与 AHD 是 Amphenol Sine 的不同产品系列。对照资料有助于筛选候选件，但认可必须依据原件及拟替代件的准确料号，包括后缀，并检查键位、线封范围、接点系统、附件和对插尺寸。ATM 使用比 AT 或 ATP 更小的接点系统，名称不能互换。AHD 诊断接口还需要约定车辆针脚表与机械编码。对照关系只是比较起点，不证明所有颜色、孔位和特殊变体都可互换。

caption.en: A vehicle ECU and its interface: confirm the equipment reference, not only connector appearance.
caption.zh: 车辆 ECU 及其接口：确认设备料号，不只比较接头外观。

title.zh: 通信连接器与电缆架构

copy.en: The expression 'Amphenol cable' can refer to very different products: a multipair telecom loom, an RF coaxial assembly or a high-speed copper interconnect. Clarify the interface and signal standard before discussing length. A 25-pair telecom lead needs pair mapping and termination identification; a coaxial channel needs the impedance and connector/cable combination; a high-speed link needs the defined channel and performance limits. Physical continuity cannot establish bandwidth, return loss or crosstalk. Fibre-optic and advanced high-speed work require a separate capability and measurement review rather than a generic harness quotation.
copy.zh: “Amphenol 电缆”可能指差异很大的产品：多对通信线束、RF 同轴组件或高速铜互连。讨论长度前，应先明确接口及信号标准。25 对通信线需要线对映射和端接标识，同轴通道需要阻抗及连接器与电缆组合，高速链路则需要定义通道和性能限值。物理导通不能证明带宽、回波损耗或串扰表现。光纤及先进高速项目需单独审核能力和测量条件，不能直接按普通线束报价。

caption.en: An Amphenol RF antenna assembly; communication links differ from ordinary continuity circuits.
caption.zh: Amphenol 射频天线组件；通信链路不同于普通导通回路。

copy.en: Component approvals, factory quality systems and finished-assembly acceptance are separate subjects. Specify which standards and revisions apply to the order, which documents must accompany it and which tests need a dedicated plan. RoHS or REACH declarations are not electrical test reports. IPC/WHMA-A-620 addresses cable and harness workmanship where contractually adopted; it does not automatically qualify a harness for a vehicle, aircraft or space mission. Super Smile confirms the available records for the approved BOM and manufacturing scope. Brand names and reference standards on this page do not imply authorization or certification.
copy.zh: 零件认可、工厂质量体系与成品验收属于不同事项。订单应规定适用标准及版本、随货文件和需要专项计划的试验。RoHS 或 REACH 声明不是电气测试报告。合同采用 IPC/WHMA-A-620 时，它用于线缆及线束工艺验收，不会自动使线束具备车辆、航空或航天项目资格。超斯迈尔按认可物料表及制造范围确认可提供记录，本页出现品牌和参考标准不代表授权或认证。

caption.en: Dimensional inspection is one part of the agreed acceptance plan, not proof of every qualification.
caption.zh: 尺寸检验属于约定验收项目之一，不能证明所有鉴定要求。

title.zh: 行业应用：汽车与电动车

copy.en: Vehicle assemblies may serve body controls, sensors, charging auxiliaries, thermal management or high-voltage power. These circuits have different electrical and safety boundaries even when they occupy the same compartment. Capture the mating device, trim or platform version, local heat, fluid exposure and attachment points. The installed route must allow service without loading terminals or bypassing protective features. A prototype should be reviewed on the target equipment, including moving parts and access for locking. Safety-related and high-voltage circuits remain subject to the customer's approved design and qualification process.
copy.zh: 车辆组件可服务车身控制、传感器、充电辅助、热管理或高压供电。即使位于同一舱室，这些回路的电气与安全边界也不同。应记录对插设备、配置或平台版本、局部热量、介质暴露及固定点。安装路线需允许检修，同时不向端子施加载荷或绕过防护结构。样品应在目标设备上审核，包含运动部件和锁扣操作空间；安全相关及高压回路仍须遵循客户认可设计与鉴定流程。

caption.en: An electric delivery truck represents a vehicle installation environment, not a claimed supplied project.
caption.zh: 电动配送卡车展示车辆应用环境，不代表本公司供货项目。

copy.en: MIL-DTL-38999 identifies a connector specification family, not an automatic approval for any cable built around a circular shell. A project can require exact shell finish, insert arrangement, contact specification, shielding, identification and material traceability. The drawing may also control routing, lacing and inspection records. We first review the proposed assembly and evidence requirements; regulated or mission-critical work is not offered solely because a commercial connector appears similar. Where an application requires a qualified source or a specific manufacturing approval, that requirement must be resolved before accepting the work.
copy.zh: MIL-DTL-38999 指一种连接器规范体系，不会自动认可围绕圆形壳体制作的任何电缆。项目可能要求准确壳体镀层、排列、端子规范、屏蔽、标识及材料追溯，图纸还可能控制布线、绑扎与检验记录。我们先审核拟制组件及证据要求，不因商业接头外观相近就承接受监管或关键任务用途。应用要求合格供方或特定制造认可时，必须在接受任务前解决该条件。

caption.en: Historical aircraft wiring integration reference from the Convair archive.
caption.zh: Convair 档案中的飞机布线集成实拍参考。

copy.en: Space hardware adds concerns that ordinary outdoor ratings do not cover: vacuum outgassing, contamination of sensitive surfaces, thermal cycling and radiation exposure. NASA's materials database reports outgassing measurements such as total mass loss and collected volatile condensable material; it is a material-selection resource, not approval of a complete harness. Adhesives, sleeves, marking materials and potting can matter as much as the wire insulation. Space-related enquiries require a project-specific qualification and sourcing review. No flight heritage or space manufacturing qualification is implied by the examples discussed here.
copy.zh: 航天硬件还涉及一般户外等级未覆盖的问题：真空放气、敏感表面污染、热循环与辐射暴露。NASA 材料数据库提供总质量损失和可凝结挥发物等放气测量，是材料选择资源，不是整条线束的认可。胶黏剂、套管、标识材料与灌封材料可能和线材绝缘同样重要。航天相关需求必须进行专项鉴定及采购审核，本页示例不表示本公司拥有飞行履历或航天制造资质。

caption.en: NPP satellite in a cleanroom: cleanliness and qualification are mission-specific.
caption.zh: 洁净室中的 NPP 卫星：清洁度与鉴定要求取决于任务。

copy.en: Equipment rooms and outdoor cabinets can need power distribution, copper data links, coaxial feeders and optical connections in the same system. Preserve the distinction between those channels. Cable routing, bend limits, shielding and connector cleanliness affect different performance measures. Amphenol's high-speed catalogue includes specialized cable architectures that cannot be replicated by simply changing plugs on general-purpose wire. For a project enquiry, provide the interface standard, channel length, topology and required test evidence. We identify which assembly operations are within scope and which need specialist supply or validation.
copy.zh: 机房与户外机柜可能在同一系统内使用配电、铜数据链路、同轴馈线及光纤连接，应保持这些通道的区别。布线路径、弯曲限制、屏蔽与接口清洁影响不同性能指标。Amphenol 高速目录中的专用电缆架构，不能靠给普通线材更换插头来复制。项目询价应提供接口标准、通道长度、拓扑及所需测试证据；我们明确哪些装配操作在范围内，哪些需要专业采购或验证。

caption.en: A network equipment rack with different cable routes and interfaces.
caption.zh: 网络设备机架中的不同电缆路径及接口。

title.zh: 行业应用：工业设备与机器人

copy.en: An industrial harness can connect a stationary controller to moving sensors, valves, drives or an end effector. Separate fixed routing from repeated bending and torsion before selecting cable construction. Protect the connector from becoming the mechanical stop at the end of travel. Coolant, welding debris and cleaning chemicals require their own exposure review. On-machine circular connectors can make maintenance more modular, but an accessible coupling and a replaceable branch must be planned into the equipment. Movement life belongs to the tested cable-and-installation combination, not to the connector brand alone.
copy.zh: 工业线束可连接固定控制器与运动传感器、阀组、驱动器或末端执行器。选择电缆结构前，应区分固定布线、反复弯曲与扭转，避免接头成为行程终点的机械限位。冷却液、焊接碎屑和清洗介质需分别审核。机载圆形接口有助于模块化维护，但可操作锁环与可更换分支必须在设备内提前规划。运动寿命属于经过试验的电缆与安装组合，不只取决于连接器品牌。

caption.en: A welding robot installation illustrates motion, heat and cable-support constraints.
caption.zh: 焊接机器人现场展示运动、热环境及电缆支撑约束。

copy.en: Solar, storage and wind equipment combine long service intervals with different electrical environments. A photovoltaic string connector, a battery-rack power link and a turbine control harness are not interchangeable products. Review voltage, loading, temperature rise, UV exposure, water paths and maintenance access for the actual circuit. Preserve approved mating pairs and cable dimensions, particularly where a connector's seal depends on cable diameter. We can review defined power and control assemblies; field installation and system-level electrical protection remain part of the equipment's engineering and approval process.
copy.zh: 光伏、储能与风电设备具有较长维护间隔，但电气环境不同。光伏组串接头、电池柜供电连接与风机控制线束不是可互换产品。应针对实际回路审核电压、负载、温升、紫外线、水分路径及检修空间，保留认可对插组合和电缆尺寸，尤其是密封依赖电缆外径时。我们可审核明确的供电与控制组件；现场安装及系统电气保护仍属于设备工程与认可流程。

caption.en: Solar-farm installation: equipment layout and outdoor exposure shape the connection specification.
caption.zh: 光伏场站安装现场：设备布局及户外暴露影响连接规格。

copy.en: A hybrid insert places defined power and signal contacts in one housing. Families such as ecomate C16 offer mixed arrangements, but the exact insert determines the supported circuits. Combining functions can reduce separate connection points and simplify a modular machine interface; it also concentrates more requirements in one assembly. Allocate each contact by function, then review voltage separation, current loading, shielding and the consequences of a shared disconnect. A power contact and a low-level signal contact need different cable and termination choices. Preserve pair geometry where required and document how shields are connected to the shell or equipment. Built-in shielding is not a promise of zero interference. Mechanical routing, return paths and the equipment's EMC design still matter. Compare the combined layout with separate connectors for installation time, service access and replacement cost. Any weight or time saving should be measured against the actual alternative, not quoted as a universal percentage.
copy.zh: 混合绝缘体在一个壳体内布置明确的供电与信号接点。ecomate C16 等系列提供混合排列，但具体可承载回路由准确绝缘体配置决定。功能合并可能减少独立连接点，简化模块化机器接口，同时也将更多要求集中到一条组件。应先按功能分配接点，再审核电压隔离、电流负载、屏蔽及共同断开带来的影响。功率接点和低电平信号接点需要不同线材及端接选择，必要时保留线对几何关系，并记录屏蔽如何连接壳体或设备。内置屏蔽不等于零干扰，机械布线、回流路径与设备 EMC 设计仍然重要。应将合并方案与分离接头比较，考虑安装工时、维修空间和替换成本；减重或节时收益需对实际方案测量，不能引用统一百分比。

caption.en: An escalator control cabinet shows power and control circuits sharing equipment space, not a specific hybrid connector.
caption.zh: 扶梯控制柜展示动力与控制回路共处设备空间，并非特定混合接头。

title.en: Jackets: High Temperature, XLPE and Silicone

copy.en: The hottest point is often local: near an exhaust, heater, power contact or tightly packed cable group. Review the conductor's operating temperature and the surrounding equipment separately. XLPE and silicone constructions are available for elevated-temperature duties, but their ratings depend on the complete cable specification. Insulation, jacket, connector seal and sleeve may have different limits. A heat-resistant jacket cannot compensate for an overloaded contact or a route touching a hot surface. Define continuous exposure, short excursions and abrasion protection before selecting the material.
copy.zh: 最热点往往是局部位置，例如排气附近、加热器旁、功率接点或密集电缆组内。应分别审核导体工作温度与周边设备温度。XLPE 和硅胶结构可用于相应高温工况，但额定值取决于完整线材规格。绝缘、外护套、接头密封与套管可能有不同限制，耐热护套不能补偿接点过载或直接接触高温表面的路线。选材前应定义持续暴露、短时温升及磨损防护。

caption.en: An exhaust heat shield illustrates why local radiant heat must be reviewed separately from ambient temperature.
caption.zh: 排气隔热罩说明局部辐射热应与环境温度分别审核。

title.en: Jackets: PTFE, FEP and Chemical Exposure

copy.en: PTFE and FEP are fluoropolymer options used in demanding cable constructions, but 'chemical resistant' is not a complete specification. Name the chemical, concentration, temperature and duration, and distinguish occasional splashes from immersion. The jacket, core insulation, printing, adhesive and connector seal can respond differently to the same fluid. A material selected for excellent chemical behaviour may need additional mechanical protection or different termination processing. Compare the cable manufacturer's resistance information with the actual exposure; do not infer compatibility from the polymer abbreviation alone.
copy.zh: PTFE 与 FEP 是严苛电缆结构中使用的氟聚合物选项，但“耐化学”不是完整规格。应说明介质、浓度、温度和时间，区分偶发飞溅与浸泡。同一种介质对护套、芯线绝缘、印字、胶黏剂及接头密封的影响可能不同。化学表现优良的材料可能仍需额外机械防护或不同端接工艺。应将制造商耐介质资料与实际暴露对照，不能只根据聚合物缩写判断相容性。

caption.en: PTFE-backed tapes as a fluoropolymer material example, not a specified cable jacket.
caption.zh: PTFE 背材胶带作为氟聚合物材料示例，并非指定电缆护套。

title.zh: 护套：紫外线与户外老化

copy.en: Outdoor exposure combines sunlight, moisture, temperature cycling and mechanical movement. Black colour by itself does not establish UV resistance, and an indoor flame-retardant cable is not automatically suitable outside. Specify a cable grade with the required weathering evidence and review markings, boots and ties as part of the same installation. Avoid layouts that hold water at cable entries or abrade the jacket against a bracket. Protective conduit can help with mechanical exposure, but it does not remove the need to consider heat build-up and drainage.
copy.zh: 户外暴露同时包含日晒、水分、温度循环与机械运动。黑色本身不能证明耐紫外线，室内阻燃线也不自动适合户外。应选用具有所需耐候证据的线材牌号，并将标识、护套靴和扎带作为同一安装系统审核。避免在电缆入口积水，或让护套与支架持续摩擦。保护管有助于机械防护，但仍需考虑内部积热与排水。

caption.en: An accelerated UV-weathering chamber used to evaluate sunlight and moisture exposure.
caption.zh: 用于评估日照与湿气暴露的紫外加速老化试验箱。

title.en: Jackets: Low Smoke and Halogen-Free Requirements

copy.en: Low smoke, halogen content and flame propagation describe different properties and may require different test methods. IEC 61034 addresses smoke-density measurement under defined burning conditions; a result there is not a complete fire-performance classification. An LSZH or LSOH designation must be tied to the specified cable and supporting documentation. It does not mean the cable is fireproof, emits no harmful gases or keeps a circuit operating during a fire. Where such behaviour matters, identify the installation standard, test scope and acceptance evidence before choosing the jacket and other assembly materials.
copy.zh: 低烟、卤素含量和火焰蔓延描述不同性质，可能需要不同试验方法。IEC 61034 涉及规定燃烧条件下的烟密度测量，该结果不是完整防火性能分类。LSZH 或 LSOH 标识必须关联指定线材及支持文件，并不意味着电缆不燃、完全不产生有害气体或火中仍能维持回路。需要相关表现时，应先明确安装标准、试验范围与验收证据，再选择护套及其他组件材料。

caption.en: A cable-tray fire test illustrates fire exposure; it is not evidence of this assembly's LSZH performance.
caption.zh: 电缆桥架燃烧试验展示火灾暴露，并非本组件低烟无卤性能的证据。

copy.en: Storage temperature, fixed-installation temperature and permitted movement temperature can be different. A cable that survives a cold night while stationary may be damaged if bent immediately at that temperature. Review the actual grade's minimum installation and moving limits, not just its lowest published number. Cable stiffness also changes the force applied to an entry seal or clamp. Provide the start-up temperature, motion profile and bend radius for refrigerated equipment or outdoor winter service. TPE and other low-temperature constructions must be assessed as complete cables, not selected by material name alone.
copy.zh: 储存温度、固定安装温度与允许运动温度可能不同。线材静止度过寒冷夜晚后，如果立即在相同温度弯折，仍可能受损。应审核准确牌号的最低安装和运动限制，而不只看资料中的最低数值。刚度变化还会改变入口密封或夹具承受的力。冷库设备及冬季户外项目应提供启动温度、运动方式与弯曲半径；TPE 等低温结构需按完整电缆评估，不能只凭材料名选择。

caption.en: Snow-covered surroundings illustrate outdoor cold-weather installation conditions.
caption.zh: 积雪环境展示户外低温安装工况。

title.zh: 护套：高柔性与机器人运动

copy.en: A flexible jacket does not by itself create a continuous-flex cable. Stranding, conductor lay, fillers, shield construction and the jacket work together. Repeated linear bending and torsion impose different loads, so a drag-chain cable should not automatically be assigned to a rotating robot joint. Use the cable's specified bend factor with its actual outer diameter, and review travel, acceleration and the support arrangement. Keep termination transitions outside uncontrolled bending where possible. Any cycle-life statement must include the relevant test conditions and installation limits.
copy.zh: 柔软护套本身不能造就连续弯曲电缆。绞股、芯线节距、填充、屏蔽结构与护套共同作用；反复直线弯曲和扭转施加载荷不同，拖链电缆不能自动用于旋转机器人关节。应将规定弯曲倍数与实际外径结合，并审核行程、加速度及支撑布置，尽可能让端接过渡处避开不受控弯曲。任何循环寿命说明都应包含相关试验条件和安装限制。

caption.en: A cable carrier guides repeated movement; bend radius and cable construction remain separate checks.
caption.zh: 拖链引导重复运动；弯曲半径与电缆结构仍需分别确认。

title.en: Technical Support: Design Review and Parts
title.zh: 技术支持：设计审核与零件

copy.en: Start with the mating references and electrical schematic, then work outward to the installed route. We review cavity assignment, current paths, cable construction, protective accessories and assembly access. A clear bill of materials distinguishes original branded parts from alternatives offered for approval. It also identifies items that are not supplied with the housing, such as contacts or backshell accessories. Open questions are resolved before tooling or material commitments. The review's scope and any associated engineering work are agreed for the project rather than advertised as an unlimited free service.
copy.zh: 从对插料号和电气图开始，再扩展到实际安装路线。我们审核腔位分配、电流路径、电缆结构、防护附件及装配空间。清楚的物料表区分原厂品牌件与供认可的替代件，并列明未随壳体附带的端子、尾壳附件等项目。工装或材料投入前先解决待确认问题；审核范围与相关工程工作按项目约定，不宣传无限范围的免费服务。

caption.en: Coordination on the Super Smile factory floor.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔车间现场沟通。

title.en: Technical Support: Length, Layout and Prototypes
title.zh: 技术支持：长度、布局与样品

copy.en: Overall length needs a measurement datum: connector face, backshell exit, branch junction or another defined feature. A loose cable laid on a table can give a different result from the installed path. Record branch lengths, breakout angles, labels and connector orientation on the drawing. A first article checks fit, routing and electrical function before repeat production. Timing depends on part availability, tooling, engineering questions and the agreed validation. We confirm a realistic sample plan instead of promising every Amphenol configuration within a fixed number of days.
copy.zh: 总长必须有测量基准，例如接头端面、尾壳出口、分支点或其他规定特征。松放桌面的电缆与实际安装路径可能得到不同结果。应在图纸记录分支长度、出线角度、标识和接头方向。首件在重复生产前检查装配、布线与电气功能；时间取决于零件可得性、工装、工程问题及约定验证。我们确认实际样品计划，不承诺所有 Amphenol 配置都能在固定天数完成。

caption.en: Wire processing at Super Smile; project samples follow the approved drawing and work instructions.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔线材加工现场；项目样品依据认可图纸及作业文件制作。

title.en: Technical Support: Tooling and Electrical Tests
title.zh: 技术支持：工装与电气检查

copy.en: The contact's application instruction determines the tool, locator and settings. Process checks and equipment calibration support repeatability, while final inspection checks the agreed assembly. A continuity fixture can verify mapped circuits and detect specified open, short or crossed connections. Insulation resistance, dielectric testing, shield continuity and signal performance are separate requirements with their own methods and limits. Fitted resistors, diodes or electronics can change the permitted test. The quotation and inspection plan should state which checks are included and which need additional equipment or external validation.
copy.zh: 端子应用说明决定工具、定位器和设置。过程检查及设备校准支持重复一致性，最终检查则针对约定组件。导通治具可核对映射回路并检测规定的断路、短路或错接。绝缘电阻、耐压、屏蔽连续性和信号性能是独立要求，各有方法与限值。已装电阻、二极管或电子元件可能改变允许试验条件。报价与检验计划应写明包含哪些检查，哪些需要附加设备或外部验证。

caption.en: Network cable test instruments illustrate channel-specific verification beyond continuity.
caption.zh: 网络电缆测试仪说明链路验证不止导通检查。

copy.en: A useful service enquiry identifies the drawing revision, affected batch, mating equipment and observed symptom. Photographs of the installed route, locking features and cable entries can distinguish a geometry problem from an electrical one. Avoid modifying a returned sample before the agreed inspection, because the original condition may be important evidence. If the design changes, update the BOM, drawing and inspection criteria together. The aim is a traceable correction that can be repeated in later production, not an undocumented adjustment made only to one replacement lead.
copy.zh: 有用的售后反馈应标明图纸版本、涉及批次、对插设备和故障表现。安装路线、锁止结构及电缆入口照片有助于区分几何问题和电气问题。按约定检查前，避免自行改变退回样品，因为原始状态可能是重要证据。设计更改时，应同步更新物料表、图纸和检验标准。目标是可追溯且能用于后续生产的修正，而不只对单条替换线进行无记录调整。

caption.en: An electrician locating a fault with a multimeter; public maintenance reference.
caption.zh: 电工使用万用表定位故障，公开维护实拍参考。

title.zh: 选择准确的 Amphenol 组件

copy.en: For an accurate enquiry, provide connector references at both ends, circuit mapping, wire or cable requirements, branch dimensions, installation conditions and quantities. State whether original branded components are mandatory and whether alternatives may be reviewed. Identify required documentation and any special tests before comparing prices. Availability must be checked for the complete set of housings, contacts, seals and accessories. Super Smile offers project-defined cable and harness assembly; this page is not a claim of Amphenol distributorship, universal stock or approval for every regulated application.
copy.zh: 准确询价请提供两端连接器料号、回路映射、线材要求、分支尺寸、安装条件及数量。明确是否必须使用原厂品牌件，以及是否可以审核替代方案。比较价格前，应说明文件和特殊试验要求。可采购性必须针对完整壳体、端子、密封与附件组合确认。超斯迈尔提供按项目定义的电缆及线束装配，本页不表示 Amphenol 分销授权、全系列现货或全部受监管应用资格。

caption.en: Parts protected and documented for storage; archival logistics reference, not company inventory.
caption.zh: 零件储存时的保护与文件，物流档案参考，并非本公司库存。

q.en: Are all Amphenol circular connectors interchangeable?
q.zh: 所有 Amphenol 圆形接头都能互换吗？

a.en: No. Match the complete series, shell and insert arrangement, contact system, keying and accessories using the approved mating references.
a.zh: 不能。应依据认可对插料号，匹配完整系列、壳体与排列、接点系统、键位及附件。

q.en: Does a connector rating establish the finished harness rating?
q.zh: 接头额定值等于成品线束额定值吗？

a.en: No. Cable construction, seals, termination, installation and test conditions must also be reviewed. Project evidence determines what may be claimed for the assembly.
a.zh: 不等于。还需审核电缆结构、密封、端接、安装与试验条件，成品可宣称性能由项目证据确定。

q.en: Can one enquiry cover power, signal and hybrid options?
q.zh: 能否在同一询价中比较供电、信号及混合方案？

a.en: Yes. Provide circuit requirements and the installation layout so the options can be compared on a complete BOM, routing and validation basis.
a.zh: 可以。请提供回路要求与安装布局，以便基于完整物料表、布线及验证范围比较方案。

q.en: What determines lead time and documentation?
q.zh: 交期与文件范围由什么决定？

a.en: The approved BOM, component availability, tooling, engineering questions, quantities and test plan. These are confirmed for the order rather than promised universally.
a.zh: 由认可物料表、零件可得性、工装、工程问题、数量及试验计划决定，应按订单确认，而非统一承诺。
