intro.en: Custom Aptiv-interface harnesses for vehicle and equipment projects, with defined circuits, materials, routing and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向车辆与设备项目的 Aptiv 接口定制线束，明确回路、材料、布线与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Weather-Pack, Metri-Pack and GT are distinct systems; match the complete mating references.
knowledge.zh: Weather-Pack、Metri-Pack 与 GT 是不同系统，需匹配完整对插型号。

notes.en: Confirm part references, pin mapping, wire dimensions, environment and quantities.
notes.zh: 确认零件料号、针脚映射、线材尺寸、环境与数量。

delivery.en: Approve the BOM, tooling and first article before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 认可物料表、工装和首件后，再开展重复生产。

subtitle.en: A connection family is the starting point, not the whole specification
subtitle.zh: 连接系列是起点，不是完整规格

lead.en: Aptiv-interface cable assemblies connect power, sensing and control functions across vehicle and equipment architectures. This category includes sealed branches, powertrain looms, extension leads and project-reviewed high-voltage assemblies. Super Smile develops the requested harness from drawings, samples or confirmed mating references. The approved BOM identifies original branded components and any separately proposed alternatives. The following guide moves from connector families to manufacturing, applications and platform routing so an enquiry can describe the complete assembly rather than a connector photograph alone.
lead.zh: Aptiv 接口电缆组件在车辆与设备架构中连接供电、感知和控制功能，本类包含密封分支、动力总成线束、延长线，以及经项目审核的高压组件。超斯迈尔依据图纸、样品或明确对插型号开发所需线束，认可物料表区分原厂品牌件与另行提出的替代方案。以下从接口系列讲到制造、应用及平台布线，使询价能够描述完整组件，而不只提供一张接头照片。

openingCaption.en: A vehicle instrument-cluster harness illustrates branch and connector diversity; not an Aptiv part identification.
openingCaption.zh: 车辆仪表线束展示分支与接头差异，不作为 Aptiv 料号识别依据。

copy.en: Aptiv is not a single mating interface. Weather-Pack, Metri-Pack and GT describe different connection systems. Metri-Pack includes sealed and unsealed arrangements; an unsealed M/P 150 housing must not inherit a waterproof claim from another family member. GT 150 and GT 280 are useful catalogue search terms, not permission to substitute terminals or housings. Identify the complete male and female references, cavity layout, keying, contact finish and lock accessories. Keep a photograph for recognition, but release production against a controlled drawing and bill of materials.
copy.zh: Aptiv 不是一种统一对插接口。Weather-Pack、Metri-Pack 和 GT 分别描述不同连接系统。Metri-Pack 包含密封与非密封配置，非密封 M/P 150 胶壳不能沿用其他系列成员的防水宣称。GT 150、GT 280 是有用的目录检索词，并不意味着端子或胶壳可以互换。应识别完整公母料号、腔位排列、键位、接点镀层与锁止附件。照片用于识别，生产放行则依据受控图纸和物料表。

caption.en: Super Smile terminated leads: identify housings and contacts by the approved BOM, not appearance alone.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔端接线实拍：依据认可物料表识别胶壳与端子，不只看外观。

copy.en: A sealed branch is a system of matched housing, interface seal, wire seals, contacts and unused-cavity treatment. The seal grips the insulation outside diameter, while the crimp grips the conductor; specifying AWG alone does not settle both requirements. Weather-Pack or a specified sealed Metri-Pack arrangement may suit an exposed branch when its approved application conditions match the project. Define the mated state, rear support, fluid exposure and required test method. A dust cap or rubber boot does not by itself convert an unsealed connector into a qualified sealed assembly.
copy.zh: 密封分支由匹配胶壳、界面密封、线封、端子及空腔处理共同构成。线封贴合绝缘外径，压接部位连接导体，仅指定 AWG 不能同时解决两个要求。Weather-Pack 或指定密封 Metri-Pack 配置，在认可应用条件与项目相符时可用于暴露分支。需明确对插状态、后部支撑、油液暴露和所需试验方法。单独加防尘盖或橡胶护套，不能把非密封接头变成经过鉴定的密封组件。

caption.en: Heavy rain illustrates exposure; it is not a waterproof test or a rating for an assembly.
caption.zh: 暴雨展示使用环境，不代表组件已完成防水试验或取得防护等级。

title.zh: 产品系列：动力总成线束

copy.en: An engine and transmission loom combines circuits with very different jobs: temperature and pressure sensing, ignition control, solenoid actuation and auxiliary loads. Define each connection from the approved equipment interface rather than treating all branches alike. Routing near exhaust surfaces, moving pulleys or service covers requires local protection and deliberate support. Heat sleeve selection must consider the cable beneath it and the duration of exposure. Document breakout locations, connector orientation and permitted movement so the replacement assembly can be installed without pulling on contacts or obstructing maintenance.
copy.zh: 发动机与变速箱线束集成温压检测、点火控制、电磁阀驱动和辅助负载等不同任务。每个连接均应从设备认可接口出发定义，不能把所有分支同等处理。靠近排气热表面、运动皮带轮或检修盖的位置需要局部防护与合理支撑。隔热套选型应考虑内部电缆及暴露持续时间。记录分支位置、接头朝向和允许运动，使组件安装时不牵拉端子，也不妨碍维护。

caption.en: An installed engine-control module shows the crowded routing around powertrain electronics.
caption.zh: 实车发动机控制模块周边的紧凑布线空间。

copy.en: High-voltage work starts with a project review, not an orange cable. Aptiv ShieldPack references such as HV280 identify systems with specific contact, sealing, shielding and interlock options. The selected connector must be checked against voltage, current, conductor size, clearance, creepage and installation constraints. HVIL routing and shield termination belong in the drawing when required. Component literature does not certify the finished harness. High-voltage manufacture and verification are accepted only after the material specification, tooling, safety process and inspection scope have been confirmed for the project.
copy.zh: 高压项目从能力审核开始，而不是从一根橙色电缆开始。Aptiv ShieldPack HV280 等名称描述具有特定接点、密封、屏蔽与互锁选项的系统。所选接头需结合电压、电流、导体截面、电气间隙、爬电距离及安装限制核对；需要时，将 HVIL 布线和屏蔽端接纳入图纸。零件资料不等于成品线束认证。高压制造与验证须在材料规范、工装、安全流程及检验范围得到项目确认后开展。

caption.en: A traction-battery pack illustrates the scale of the high-voltage system review.
caption.zh: 动力电池包展示高压系统需要整体审核的范围。

title.zh: 产品系列：定制延长线束

copy.en: Extending a cable changes more than its length. Additional conductor resistance affects voltage drop and heating; an added signal segment can also change capacitance, shielding continuity or communication behaviour. Define the original and new mating interfaces, pin-to-pin map, installed route and maximum load before choosing wire construction. Place service loops where they are supported, not where they can snag or chafe. For data circuits, obtain the protocol and channel requirements. A successful continuity test alone does not prove that an extended sensor or communications link will perform correctly in the equipment.
copy.zh: 延长电缆改变的不只是长度。增加的导体电阻影响压降与发热，信号段延长还可能改变电容、屏蔽连续性或通信表现。选线前应明确原有与新增接口、逐针映射、安装路线及最大负载。维修余量应布置在有支撑的位置，避免挂碰或磨损。数据回路需取得协议和链路要求，仅通过导通测试不能证明延长后的传感器或通信连接在设备中正常运行。

caption.en: A wired inverter assembly illustrates defined branch lengths and termination positions.
caption.zh: 已布线的逆变器组件展示分支长度与端接位置的定义。

copy.en: Passenger, commercial and special vehicles can share some connector families while requiring different harness designs. Start with the platform drawing, mounting points, variant list and service strategy. Separate common trunk wiring from optional branches so a missing feature does not leave an uncontrolled open circuit. Confirm the polarity and pin assignment even when two housings mate mechanically. Super Smile can review a defined assembly or replacement sub-harness against customer data; compatibility is tied to the approved configuration, not to a broad claim covering every vehicle carrying an Aptiv component.
copy.zh: 乘用车、商用车和专用车辆可能使用相同接头系列，却需要不同线束设计。应从平台图纸、安装点、配置清单与维修策略出发，区分共用主干与选装分支，避免缺少某项功能时留下未定义的开路。即使两个胶壳机械上能够对插，也要核对极性和针位。超斯迈尔可依据客户资料审核明确组件或替换子线束，兼容性对应认可配置，不笼统覆盖所有使用 Aptiv 零件的车型。

caption.en: Dashboard assembly shows why service access and installation sequence matter.
caption.zh: 仪表台装配场景说明检修空间与安装顺序的重要性。

copy.en: An electric platform contains low-voltage sensing and control as well as high-voltage power distribution. Keep these systems distinct in drawings, identification and verification. A battery-temperature branch, coolant-pump lead and traction-power connection do not use the same qualification assumptions. Specify grounding, shielding, interlock functions and the required connector coding where applicable. Assembly review should include the service disconnect sequence and the space needed to operate locks. We assess the requested cable assembly within the supplied vehicle architecture; battery safety or whole-vehicle certification cannot be inferred from one connector selection.
copy.zh: 电动平台既有低压感知与控制，也有高压配电，图纸、标识和验证中应将两类系统清楚区分。电池温度分支、冷却泵线与牵引供电连接不能采用相同的鉴定假设。按需要规定接地、屏蔽、互锁功能及接头编码，装配审核也应考虑维修断开顺序和锁扣操作空间。我们在客户提供的车辆架构内评估所需电缆组件，不从单个接头选型推导电池安全或整车认证。

caption.en: Electric-drive power electronics: a reference for interface and shielding discussions.
caption.zh: 电驱动功率电子装置，用于理解接口与屏蔽需求。

copy.en: A machine harness may join valve manifolds, limit switches, pumps, motor controllers and operator controls. Record which connections move and which remain fixed. The connector supports a serviceable interface, while clamps and cable construction manage mechanical loads along the route. Oil, cleaning agents, dust and repeated bending should be considered independently. For a replacement assembly, inspect the mating device and the installed branch geometry rather than copying a loose cable's relaxed shape. Drawings should identify the reference point for each length so installation and inspection use the same dimensions.
copy.zh: 设备线束可连接阀岛、限位开关、泵、电机控制器和操作部件，应记录哪些连接运动、哪些固定。接头提供便于维护的接口，沿线机械载荷则由卡箍和电缆结构管理。油液、清洁剂、粉尘与反复弯曲需分别评估。替换组件应检查对插设备与安装后的分支几何，而不是照抄散线自然松弛形状。图纸应指出每个长度的测量基准，使安装与检验使用同一尺寸定义。

caption.en: ESO safety-PLC technology demonstrator, shown as an industrial-control reference.
caption.zh: ESO 安全 PLC 技术演示装置，作为工业控制应用参考。

title.en: Aptiv and the Former Delphi Name
title.zh: Aptiv 与原 Delphi 名称

copy.en: Delphi Automotive announced the Aptiv name for its mobility business in 2017 as part of the separation from Delphi Technologies. Legacy drawings, moulded markings and purchasing records may therefore use different names. A historical brand name is helpful for searching, but it is not a substitute for the complete part reference and current drawing revision. Cross-check superseded numbers, mating parts and terminal requirements in the manufacturer's catalogue. Keep the approved original part and any proposed alternative separate on the BOM. This page describes interface options and does not imply that Super Smile is an authorized Aptiv distributor.
copy.zh: Delphi Automotive 在 2017 年的业务分拆安排中宣布，其移动业务采用 Aptiv 名称，与 Delphi Technologies 区分。因此旧图纸、模压标记和采购记录可能使用不同名称。历史品牌名有助于检索，但不能替代完整料号与当前图纸版本。应在制造商目录核对替代料号、对插件及端子要求，在物料表中区分认可原件与拟议替代件。本页描述接口选项，不表示超斯迈尔是 Aptiv 授权分销商。

caption.en: Delphi power-converter demonstration, 2012; historical context, not a current product offer.
caption.zh: 2012 年 Delphi 功率转换器演示，仅作历史背景，不代表当前供货产品。

title.en: Core Advantages: A Defined Connection System
title.zh: 核心优势：完整定义连接系统

copy.en: The practical value of a custom harness is controlled fit and repeatability. Matched interfaces reduce assembly ambiguity; suitable seals and protection address the actual environment; correct conductor and contact choices support the electrical duty. Weight can be reduced through route planning rather than by removing necessary copper or protection. These benefits depend on engineering decisions and process control, not on a brand name alone. We document the mating system, circuit map, dimensions and inspection criteria so purchasing, assembly and maintenance teams work from the same agreed configuration.
copy.zh: 定制线束的实际价值在于装配匹配与重复一致性。匹配接口减少装配歧义，合适密封和防护针对实际环境，正确导体与接点选择支持电气工况。减重可通过路线规划实现，而不是删减必要铜材或防护。这些收益来自工程决策与过程控制，不只来自品牌名称。我们记录对插系统、回路图、尺寸与检验标准，让采购、装配和维护团队使用同一认可配置。

caption.en: Cable-entry bend protection illustrates the mechanical side of a defined connection system.
caption.zh: 电缆引入处的弯曲防护，展示连接系统的机械防护环节。

copy.en: Release wire cutting and stripping only after the conductor, insulation and terminal specification is settled. Use the contact-specific application instruction to set strip length, crimp tooling and the acceptance criteria. Inspect strands for damage and verify conductor capture and insulation support where the terminal design provides it. After insertion, confirm cavity assignment and terminal retention before closing secondary locks. A similar-looking terminal can need a different applicator or setting. Keep tooling and drawing revisions linked to the job so repeat batches do not inherit an undocumented adjustment.
copy.zh: 导体、绝缘与端子规格明确后，再放行裁线和剥皮。依据端子专用应用说明确定剥皮长度、压接工具和判定标准，检查线股损伤、导体包覆，以及端子设计提供的绝缘支撑。插入后先确认腔位分配和端子保持，再闭合二次锁。外观相近的端子可能需要不同模具或设置。将工装与图纸版本关联到工单，防止后续批次沿用未记录的调整。

caption.en: Super Smile production workstation; tooling is confirmed for the specified terminal.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔生产工位实拍，工装按指定端子确认。

copy.en: Incoming checks identify the specified housings, terminals, seals and wire construction. In-process checks address strip quality, termination, cavity position and branch dimensions. Final electrical verification follows the agreed circuit map, including intended splices, blank cavities and any fitted components. Continuity is not a measurement of insulation resistance, sealing or communication performance. Additional tests must be specified with conditions and acceptance limits. Record the first-article results and agree how repeat production will be sampled or checked, rather than presenting a generic test list as evidence that every test has already been performed.
copy.zh: 来料检查识别指定胶壳、端子、密封件与线材结构；过程检查覆盖剥皮、端接、腔位和分支尺寸；最终电气验证依据约定回路图，包括设计并线、空腔及装入元件。导通检查不是绝缘电阻、密封或通信性能测量。附加试验须明确条件和判定限值，记录首件结果并约定重复生产的抽样或检查方式，不把通用测试清单当作所有试验已完成的证据。

caption.en: Super Smile assembly workbench; inspection scope follows the approved job requirements.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔装配工作台实拍，检验范围依据认可工单要求。

copy.en: Separate component qualification, workmanship criteria and the finished assembly's project requirements. A manufacturer's rating applies to its stated configuration and test conditions, not automatically to a modified harness. Where a customer specifies standards such as IPC/WHMA-A-620 or an automotive connector test specification, agree the applicable revision, class, scope and evidence required before quoting. Material declarations and test records are different documents and should not be substituted for each other. We confirm which records are included with an order and which validation activities require a separately approved plan.
copy.zh: 应区分零件鉴定、工艺验收标准与成品组件的项目要求。制造商额定值对应其规定配置和试验条件，不自动适用于修改后的线束。客户指定 IPC/WHMA-A-620 或汽车连接器试验规范时，应在报价前约定适用版本、等级、范围与所需证据。材料声明与试验记录属于不同文件，不能互相替代。我们确认订单包含哪些记录，以及哪些验证活动需要另行认可的计划。

caption.en: A milliohmmeter illustrates a specific measurement, not a complete qualification record.
caption.zh: 毫欧计对应特定测量，并不等于完整鉴定记录。

copy.en: Cabin, body and engine-area branches have different exposure and packaging requirements. Lighting, seat functions, climate controls and sensors may use related connection technologies but require distinct pin maps and wire construction. Review the specific trim level and mating device before making a replacement. Secure the loom against trim edges and moving mechanisms, and preserve the intended service access. Airbag and other safety-related circuits require the customer's explicit approved design and verification route; a visually compatible connector is not sufficient authorization to alter them.
copy.zh: 座舱、车身与机舱分支具有不同暴露和布置要求。灯光、座椅、空调控制及传感器可能采用相关连接技术，但针脚表和线材结构不同。制作替换件前应审核准确配置与对插设备，固定线束以避开饰板锐边和运动机构，并保留检修通道。气囊及其他安全相关回路必须遵循客户明确认可的设计与验证路径，外观可匹配不足以作为更改依据。

caption.en: Passenger-cabin controls and displays form one installation zone, not the whole vehicle environment.
caption.zh: 乘用车座舱控制与显示装置属于一种安装区域，不能代表整车环境。

title.zh: 行业应用：商用卡车与车队

copy.en: Long routes, cab movement, frame flex and frequent maintenance influence commercial-vehicle harnesses. Define the articulation points and avoid carrying cable weight through a connector latch. Distinguish power, lighting and communication branches even when they run in the same corridor. Labels should identify circuit function and revision so workshop replacement is controlled. Fleet commonality is useful only when vehicle variants have been checked. Keep a traceable record of the assembly version fitted to each application rather than promising one harness for every truck in a fleet.
copy.zh: 长距离路线、驾驶室运动、车架挠曲及频繁维护都会影响商用车线束。应明确相对运动点，避免让接头锁扣承载电缆重量；即使共用布线路径，也要区分供电、灯光和通信分支。标签应标明回路功能与版本，便于受控维修更换。车队共用设计须以车型配置核对为前提，记录每种应用装入的组件版本，而不是承诺一根线束适配所有车辆。

caption.en: A commercial-vehicle chassis shows long routes and moving-system clearances.
caption.zh: 商用车底盘展示较长布线路径及运动系统间隙。

copy.en: Electric vehicles need accurate low-voltage interfaces for battery sensing, thermal management and control modules alongside their traction-power architecture. State whether the requested assembly carries measurement signals, auxiliary power or high voltage. Shielding, isolation and interlock requirements follow that classification. A low-voltage sealed plug is not a high-voltage substitute. For prototype programmes, freeze the mating references and pin map before comparing sample feedback, so a wiring revision is not mistaken for a component performance change.
copy.zh: 新能源汽车在牵引供电架构之外，还需要准确低压接口用于电池检测、热管理与控制模块。应说明所需组件承载测量信号、辅助供电还是高压，并据此确定屏蔽、隔离和互锁要求。低压密封插头不能替代高压接口。样机项目应先固定对插型号与针脚表再比较样品反馈，避免把接线版本变化误认为零件性能变化。

caption.en: An electric vehicle's charging and motor bay illustrates distinct HV and auxiliary interfaces.
caption.zh: 电动车充电口与电机舱，展示高压及辅助接口的区分。

title.zh: 行业应用：机械与机器人

copy.en: A fixed connection and a moving robot dress pack face different mechanical demands. Record bend radius, travel, torsion, cycle expectation and the space around each axis. The cable construction and support method must manage movement; the connector should not become the flex point. Keep electrical noise sources and sensitive measurement circuits in view when selecting routing and shielding. The applicable Aptiv interface is specified from the controller or device drawing. Dynamic suitability requires evaluation of the complete installed system, not only a terminal catalogue entry.
copy.zh: 固定连接与机器人随动线束具有不同机械要求，应记录弯曲半径、行程、扭转、循环预期及各轴周边空间。电缆结构和支撑方式负责管理运动，接头不应成为弯折点。选择路线和屏蔽时需考虑电气噪声源与敏感测量回路。Aptiv 接口依据控制器或设备图纸规定，动态适用性要评估完整安装系统，不能只看端子目录条目。

caption.en: Robotic welding illustrates heat, motion and electromagnetic exposure around equipment wiring.
caption.zh: 机器人焊接展示设备布线周边的热、运动与电磁暴露。

title.zh: 行业应用：船舶与越野设备

copy.en: Salt, spray, mud and washdown are different exposures. A marine sensor lead may also face ultraviolet light and dissimilar-metal corrosion at mounting hardware. Match the chosen connection system, cable jacket and protective accessories to the specific installation and required validation. Locate service connectors above persistent water traps when the design allows it, and provide strain relief that does not damage the seal. A generic IP description does not establish salt-spray resistance or suitability for permanent immersion; those requirements need their own documented review.
copy.zh: 盐雾、飞溅、泥水与冲洗属于不同暴露条件。船用传感器线还可能受到紫外线及安装件异种金属腐蚀影响。所选连接系统、电缆护套和附件应匹配具体安装与验证要求。设计允许时，将维修接头避开持续积水位置，并提供不损坏密封的应力防护。一般 IP 描述不能证明耐盐雾或永久浸水适用性，这些要求需单独记录审核。

caption.en: An outboard engine illustrates the spray and corrosion environment around marine equipment.
caption.zh: 舷外机展示船用设备周边的飞溅与腐蚀环境。

copy.en: Sprayers, irrigation equipment, harvesters and tractors can expose harnesses to dust, fertiliser, crop debris and relative movement between attachments. Define implement disconnect points, branch supports and the route through folding or lifting mechanisms. Chemical compatibility should be checked against the actual substance and concentration, not simply described as oil resistance. Clear cavity mapping and accessible locks make seasonal attachment changes more controlled. Specify the approved interface at both ends and any sensing or control requirements before treating two agricultural leads as interchangeable.
copy.zh: 喷洒机、灌溉设备、收割机和拖拉机线束可能暴露于粉尘、肥料、作物残屑及属具相对运动。应定义农具断开点、分支支撑及折叠或举升机构中的路线。化学相容性需针对实际物质与浓度检查，不能只用耐油概括。清楚针位映射与可操作锁扣有助于受控更换季节性属具。应先规定两端认可接口以及感知、控制要求，再判断两条农业设备线是否可互换。

caption.en: Field irrigation equipment illustrates exposed outdoor machinery and distributed control points.
caption.zh: 田间灌溉设备展示露天机械及分布式控制位置。

title.zh: 通过路线规划减轻线束重量

copy.en: Reducing unnecessary length can lower material use without reducing conductor size below the required electrical duty. Review branch topology, connector location and service allowance together. A shorter route is not better if it crosses a heat source or removes access needed for maintenance. Where alternative conductor materials or thinner insulation are proposed, review termination compatibility, voltage drop, thermal behaviour and mechanical durability before approval. We compare the defined options in the BOM and drawing; no percentage weight saving or vehicle range improvement is claimed without a measured baseline.
copy.zh: 减少不必要长度可降低材料用量，而不必把导体削减到电气要求以下。应共同审核分支拓扑、接头位置与维修余量。更短路线若跨越热源或取消必要检修空间，并不更好。拟采用替代导体材料或更薄绝缘时，需在认可前审核端接相容性、压降、热表现与机械耐久。我们在物料表和图纸中比较明确方案，没有实测基准时不宣称减重百分比或整车续航提升。

caption.en: AWG diameter comparison diagram; conductor selection still requires electrical and thermal review.
caption.zh: AWG 直径对比示意；导体选型仍需电气与热审核。

title.en: Tailored Routing for Each Vehicle Zone

copy.en: Design review begins with the installation envelope. Chassis routes need clearance from suspension and steering movement; powertrain routes need local heat and vibration assessment. Interior branches must avoid seat tracks, trim fasteners and service panels. Underbody routes need protection against road debris and retained moisture. Mark clips, grommets, pass-throughs and inspection datums on the drawing rather than leaving them to assembly judgement. The same connector family can appear in several zones, but the cable, protection and verification requirements may be different in each one.
copy.zh: 设计审核从安装空间开始。底盘路线需避开悬架及转向运动，动力总成路线需评估局部热量与振动；内饰分支要避开座椅滑轨、饰板紧固件和检修面板；车底路线则需防护道路碎屑与残留水分。图纸应标明卡扣、护线圈、穿板点和检验基准，不将它们留给现场自行判断。同一接头系列可出现在多个区域，但电缆、防护及验证要求各不相同。

caption.en: Chassis-mounted equipment and lines illustrate clearance and support planning.
caption.zh: 底盘安装件与管线展示间隙及支撑规划需求。

title.zh: 面向平台扩展的模块化系统

copy.en: A modular harness separates a shared trunk from defined optional branches. That can simplify servicing and variant management, provided the interfaces, pin assignments and protection remain controlled. An unused option needs a specified termination or cavity treatment. Adding a sensor or module also requires confirmation of the circuit capacity and communication architecture; an available connector position is not automatically a spare functional circuit. Use revision-controlled labels and a compatibility matrix in the engineering package so upgrades and replacement assemblies can be matched to the correct platform version.
copy.zh: 模块化线束将共用主干与明确选装分支分开，在接口、针位和防护受控时，有助于维护及配置管理。未使用选项需要规定端接或空腔处理。新增传感器或模块还需确认回路容量与通信架构，空余接头腔位不自动等于可用功能回路。工程资料应使用受控版本标签与适配清单，使升级件和替换组件能够匹配正确平台版本。

caption.en: Vehicle assembly-line modules illustrate platform and variant management.
caption.zh: 车辆装配线的模块化装配场景，辅助理解平台与配置管理。

copy.en: Send the full mating references, pin map, wire requirements, installed dimensions, environment and sample and production quantities. Identify whether original branded components are mandatory and whether alternatives may be proposed for approval. A quotation should separate assembly scope, tooling, documentation and any specialised validation. Availability of the housing alone does not establish availability of terminals, seals and locks. We confirm the sourcing and delivery plan for the approved BOM rather than advertising universal stock. The final release should connect the agreed drawing revision to the supplied assembly and inspection record.
copy.zh: 请提供完整对插型号、针脚表、线材要求、安装尺寸、环境，以及样品和生产数量。明确是否必须使用原厂品牌件，是否允许提出替代方案供认可。报价应区分装配范围、工装、文件与特殊验证。胶壳可采购不代表端子、密封和锁件同时可得。我们针对认可物料表确认采购及交付计划，不宣传全系列现货；最终放行需将约定图纸版本与供货组件及检验记录关联。

caption.en: Super Smile wire-handling area; material readiness is checked against the approved BOM.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔线材周转区实拍，物料准备按认可物料表核对。

q.en: Does an Aptiv label establish compatibility?
q.zh: Aptiv 标记能证明兼容吗？

a.en: No. Confirm the complete mating references, cavity arrangement, keying, contacts and pin map. A shared brand or shell colour is not sufficient.
a.zh: 不能。需确认完整对插料号、腔位排列、键位、端子与针脚表，相同品牌或壳体颜色不足以证明兼容。

q.en: Are all Metri-Pack connectors sealed?
q.zh: 所有 Metri-Pack 接头都密封吗？

a.en: No. The portfolio contains sealed and unsealed configurations. Specify the exact version and its application conditions.
a.zh: 不是。产品范围包含密封与非密封配置，应指定准确版本及应用条件。

q.en: Can an extension use the original wire size?
q.zh: 延长线可以沿用原来线径吗？

a.en: It requires review. Length affects resistance and voltage drop, while signal circuits can also have channel constraints. Confirm load and protocol requirements.
a.zh: 需要审核。长度影响电阻和压降，信号回路还可能具有链路约束，应确认负载及协议要求。

q.en: What is included in a production quotation?
q.zh: 生产报价包含哪些内容？

a.en: The quote should identify the approved BOM, assembly quantity, tooling, included inspections and documentation. Special validation and unapproved alternatives are separately scoped.
a.zh: 报价应明确认可物料表、装配数量、工装、包含的检查和文件，特殊验证及未认可替代方案另行规定。

mediaCredits.author: Tony Webster from Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States
William Matheson from Bedford, Nova Scotia, Canada
Robert T Bell from Oshawa, Canada

intro.en: Application-specific DEUTSCH-interface harnesses for equipment and vehicle wiring, with matched housings, contacts, seals, branch layouts and inspection requirements.
intro.zh: 面向设备与车辆配线的 DEUTSCH 接口定制线束，成套匹配胶壳、端子、密封件、分支布局与检验要求。

knowledge.en: DT, DTM and DTP use different contact sizes. Circular HDP20/HD30 and single-pole DTHD also require exact identification.
knowledge.zh: DT、DTM 与 DTP 使用不同接点规格，圆形 HDP20／HD30 和单极 DTHD 同样需要准确识别。

notes.en: Provide full mating references, wire sizes and insulation diameters, pin map, dimensions, operating conditions and quantities.
notes.zh: 请提供完整对插型号、线径与绝缘外径、针脚表、尺寸、运行条件和数量。

delivery.en: Approve the component combination, tooling and first article before releasing repeat assembly and agreed verification.
delivery.zh: 认可零件组合、工装与首件后，再放行重复装配和约定验证。

introduction.zh: 什么是 DEUTSCH 接口线束？

subtitle.en: Separate the family, the circuit and the environment
subtitle.zh: 区分系列、回路与环境

lead.en: DEUTSCH, a TE Connectivity brand, covers multiple connection systems rather than a single waterproof plug. A harness may combine compact sensor branches, auxiliary power leads, panel interfaces and service disconnects, each with a different duty. Super Smile can review the cable assembly from your drawing, sample or confirmed mating references. We specify the requested component combination and distinguish original branded parts from any proposed alternative on the approved BOM. Brand names describe interfaces and do not imply authorization or endorsement. The guide below follows the series, application, lead-time and pricing topics, with additional assembly and sealing checks for practical procurement.
lead.zh: DEUTSCH 是 TE Connectivity 旗下品牌，涵盖多种连接系统，并不是一种通用防水插头。一套线束可同时包含紧凑传感器分支、辅助供电线、面板接口和维修断开点，各自工况不同。超斯迈尔可依据图纸、样品或明确对插型号审核电缆组件，规定所需零件组合，并在认可物料表中区分原厂品牌件与任何拟议替代件。品牌名称用于描述接口，不代表授权或背书。以下围绕系列、应用、交期与报价展开，并加入实际采购所需的装配和密封检查。

openingCaption.en: AI illustration of sealed-connector components, not an exact DEUTSCH part or dimensional reference.
openingCaption.zh: 密封连接器零件 AI 示意，不代表准确 DEUTSCH 料号或尺寸依据。

title.zh: DT 系列 · 通用设备连接

copy.en: DEUTSCH DT is a sealed connection family used for cable-to-cable, cable-to-board and cable-to-device arrangements. The familiar DT range uses size 16 contacts, with common 2-, 3-, 4-, 6-, 8- and 12-cavity layouts. These numbers describe different things: contact size is not the wire's AWG and cavity count does not define the electrical pinout. A complete specification includes both housing references, keying, seal option, contacts and wedgelocks. DT04 and DT06 are useful search prefixes, but their remaining characters matter. Confirm the full part number and mating drawing rather than ordering by gray color or a two-pin photograph.
copy.zh: DEUTSCH DT 是用于线对线、线对板和线对设备的密封连接系列。常见 DT 系列使用 16 号接点，常见腔位配置有 2、3、4、6、8 和 12 位。这些数字含义不同：接点规格不是导线 AWG，腔位数量也不定义电气针序。完整规格包含两侧胶壳型号、键位、密封选项、端子和楔形锁。DT04、DT06 是实用的检索前缀，但后续字符同样重要。应确认完整料号与对插图纸，而不是按灰色外观或两针照片采购。

caption.en: Equipment context: crane drive motor; the photograph does not identify its connector family.
caption.zh: 设备场景：起重机驱动电机，照片不用于确认其接头系列。

title.zh: DTM 系列 · 紧凑信号分支

copy.en: DTM uses the smaller size 20 contact system and is intended for lower-current multi-circuit connections. It can be relevant to sensors, switches and compact control branches where the approved equipment interface calls for it. It is not a miniature DT that can accept DT terminals or mate to a DT housing. Review conductor size and insulation diameter separately: the rear seal must fit the insulation while the contact barrel must fit the conductor. Choose the required cavity count and locking accessories, then define branch length, cable restraint and service access. A smaller housing should not be used to reduce space without checking the complete electrical and mechanical duty.
copy.zh: DTM 使用较小的 20 号接点系统，面向较低电流的多回路连接；在设备认可接口要求下，可用于传感器、开关及紧凑控制分支。它不是能够装入 DT 端子或对插 DT 胶壳的缩小版 DT。导体线径与绝缘外径应分别审核：后部线封需匹配绝缘，压接筒需匹配导体。选定腔位数和锁止附件后，再定义分支长度、电缆固定与检修通道。不能只为节省空间就选更小胶壳，而忽略完整电气和机械工况。

caption.en: Sensor reference: throttle-position sensing requires an accurately defined signal connection.
caption.zh: 传感器参考：节气门位置检测需要准确的信号连接定义。

title.zh: DTP 系列 · 供电分支

copy.en: DTP supports size 12 contacts in two- and four-cavity arrangements. TE lists a 25 A contact capability for this system, but that figure is not a blanket rating for any assembled cable. Wire size, ambient temperature, simultaneously loaded circuits, termination quality and the installation route still require review. A fan, pump or auxiliary actuator may have a starting current above its steady load; record both before defining the harness. Specify the mating pair and protection strategy, not only a larger conductor. Keep unsupported cable weight and sharp bends away from the rear seal. A power connection also needs an agreed method for safe isolation during servicing.
copy.zh: DTP 支持 12 号接点，具有两位和四位配置。TE 为该系统列出 25 A 接点能力，但这不是任意成品电缆的统一额定值；线径、环境温度、同时带载回路、端接质量与安装路线仍需审核。风扇、泵或辅助执行器的启动电流可能高于稳态负载，定义线束前应记录两者。规格要包含对插组合和保护策略，而不只是加粗导体。悬空电缆重量与急弯应远离后部线封，供电连接还需要约定安全检修隔离方式。

caption.en: Load reference: cooling fan assembly; check starting current as well as steady load.
caption.zh: 负载参考：冷却风扇总成，需同时核对启动电流与稳态负载。

title.zh: DTHD 系列 · 单回路断开接口

copy.en: DTHD is a single-terminal, circular thermoplastic connector family that can provide a serviceable alternative to a permanent splice. TE identifies versions for contact sizes 12, 8 and 4; those versions do not share one universal current or cable range. Begin with the selected mating parts and contact specification, then determine conductor cross-section, insulation diameter, cable support and available installation space. A single pole is only one circuit conductor: the return path and circuit protection must still be defined elsewhere in the system. DTHD is not automatically a high-voltage connector simply because it is used for a higher-current branch.
copy.zh: DTHD 是单端子圆形热塑性连接器系列，可为永久接点提供便于维修的可断开方案。TE 列有适配 12、8、4 号接点的不同版本，它们不共享统一电流或电缆范围。应先选择对插零件与接点规格，再确定导体截面、绝缘外径、电缆支撑及安装空间。单极接口只连接一根回路导体，回流路径和保护仍需在系统其他位置明确。DTHD 用于较大电流分支，并不意味着它自动属于高压连接器。

caption.en: Circuit context: fused vehicle power distribution; this is not a DTHD connector.
caption.zh: 回路参考：车辆熔断保护配电部件，图中不是 DTHD 接头。

copy.en: HDP20 uses a thermoplastic shell, while HD30 uses an aluminum shell. The family name is only the start of an identification process: shell size, insert arrangement, contact sizes, key position, pin or socket configuration and mounting details must be matched. These interfaces can consolidate several circuits in equipment or vehicle harnesses, sometimes with more than one contact size within the selected arrangement. Do not confuse every round Deutsch connector with the nine-pin J1939 diagnostic interface. A bulkhead version also requires the panel opening, gasket, fasteners and cable exit to be considered. The complete insert drawing is more useful than a front photograph alone.
copy.zh: HDP20 使用热塑性外壳，HD30 使用铝合金外壳。系列名称只是识别起点，壳号、插芯排列、接点规格、键位、针孔配置与安装细节都须匹配。这些接口可整合设备或车辆线束中的多路回路，选定排列中也可能包含不同接点规格。不能把所有圆形 Deutsch 接头都当成九针 J1939 诊断接口。穿板版本还需要考虑面板开孔、垫圈、紧固件与出线方式；完整插芯图比单张正面照片更有用。

caption.en: Material context: injection-molding pellets, not a specified HDP20 resin grade.
caption.zh: 材料参考：注塑粒料，不代表指定 HDP20 树脂牌号。

title.zh: 汽车应用 · 发动机舱

copy.en: Engine-bay wiring can encounter localized heat, vibration, oil exposure and restricted maintenance access. Measure the intended route relative to hot surfaces, pulleys and service points instead of assigning one temperature to the whole bay. A sealed connector does not protect cable insulation from an unsuitable heat source or continuous abrasion. Define clamps, sleeves, breakout locations and connector orientation as part of the harness. Sensors and actuators may require different conductor sizes and shielding arrangements. Any customer-required environmental validation should specify the actual assembly, exposure, test sequence and acceptance criteria; a connector catalog alone is not the test report for a new engine loom.
copy.zh: 发动机舱配线可能受到局部热量、振动、油液和维修空间限制的影响。应结合热表面、皮带轮及检修点确定路线，而不是给整个机舱分配一个温度。密封接头不能保护不适合热源或持续磨损的电缆绝缘。卡箍、套管、分支位置及接头朝向都属于线束定义，传感器与执行器还可能需要不同线径和屏蔽结构。客户要求的环境验证应明确实际组件、暴露条件、试验顺序及判定标准；接头目录不是新发动机线束的试验报告。

caption.en: Engine-bay reference: localized heat and service access affect cable routing.
caption.zh: 机舱参考：局部热量和维修空间影响电缆布线。

title.zh: 汽车应用 · 底盘系统

copy.en: Underbody and off-highway harnesses face stone impact, mud, standing water and movement between supported structures. Locate disconnect points where the latch can be reached and the cable will not collect damaging loads. A branch to a suspension sensor needs enough travel for the full mechanical range, without rubbing against tires or sharp brackets. Design the connector and cable protection together: boots, conduit and clips have different functions from the interfacial seal. For braking or other safety-related circuits, use the customer-approved configuration and validation requirements. Neither a rugged photograph nor a familiar housing shape establishes safety-system suitability.
copy.zh: 车底及非道路线束可能面对碎石冲击、泥水、积水和支撑结构之间的相对运动。断开点应便于操作锁扣，又不会让电缆承受有害载荷。悬架传感器分支需要覆盖完整机械行程，同时避开轮胎与支架锐边。接头和电缆防护应共同设计，护套、波纹管及卡扣与界面密封承担不同功能。制动或其他安全相关回路必须采用客户认可配置和验证要求，坚固场景照片或熟悉的胶壳形状都不能证明其适用于安全系统。

caption.en: Rolling truck chassis: branches must accommodate movement and installation clearances.
caption.zh: 卡车底盘实拍：分支需考虑相对运动与安装间隙。

title.zh: 汽车应用 · 外部照明

copy.en: Work lamps, marker lights and auxiliary lighting can use detachable sealed branches where specified by the equipment design. Confirm voltage, polarity, current, connector key and cavity assignment at each lamp. A two-way lighting lead may carry only supply and return, while a larger interface can include dimming or control lines. Check cable voltage drop over the installed length and keep the harness away from hot lamp bodies or sharp mounting plates. Lens condensation and connector water entry are different failure paths. A watertight plug will not correct an unsealed lamp enclosure or poor cable entry elsewhere in the lighting assembly.
copy.zh: 工作灯、示廓灯及辅助照明可按设备设计使用可拆密封分支。每盏灯的电压、极性、电流、接头键位和腔位分配都应明确。两路线可能仅承载供电与回流，多位接口则可包括调光或控制线。应按安装长度检查压降，并让线束避开高温灯体或安装板锐边。灯罩凝露与接头进水属于不同失效路径，密封插头不能修复灯具壳体或其他进线位置的密封问题。

caption.en: Exterior lamp detail: lamp sealing and connector sealing are separate requirements.
caption.zh: 外部灯具细节：灯体密封与接头密封是不同要求。

title.zh: 密封件、楔形锁与空腔处理

copy.en: The rear wire seal works over a defined insulation-diameter range; choosing the correct AWG alone does not guarantee sealing. N and E seal options, where offered, must be checked against the actual wire. Wedgelocks support contact alignment and retention but do not replace the primary contact engagement. Unused positions need the manufacturer-specified cavity treatment, not an improvised short wire. Dust caps, backshells and heat-shrink boots are accessories with distinct functions and approval conditions. Confirm any IP rating on the exact connector version, mated condition and required rear protection. Immersion, road spray and pressure washing are different exposures and should not be treated as equivalent claims.
copy.zh: 后部线封在规定绝缘外径范围内工作，仅选对 AWG 不保证密封。提供 N、E 等密封选项时，应按实际线材核对。楔形锁支持端子对准与保持，但不能替代端子自身的到位锁止。空置位置应采用制造商规定的封堵方式，而不是随意插一段短线。防尘盖、后壳和热缩护套各有作用及适用条件。任何 IP 等级都应对应准确版本、对插状态与所需后部防护；浸水、道路飞溅与高压冲洗是不同暴露条件，不能混为相同承诺。

caption.en: Seal material reference: generic O-rings illustrate dimensional control, not DT wire seals.
caption.zh: 密封材料参考：通用 O 形圈说明尺寸匹配的重要性，并非 DT 线封。

copy.en: Solid and stamped-and-formed contacts use different crimp geometries and tooling. Match the contact part number to the approved conductor range, strip length, tool and positioner or die before production. Inspect conductor capture, insulation clearance and contact damage against the relevant application instruction; do not transplant a crimp setting from a similar-looking terminal. After insertion, confirm cavity position and retention before closing the secondary lock. The electrical check should use the agreed pin map, including intentional splices or blank positions. Record dimensional and inspection results for the first article, then preserve that approved configuration for repeat batches.
copy.zh: 实心接点与冲压成形接点采用不同压接几何和工具。生产前，应将端子料号与认可导体范围、剥皮长度、工具及定位器或模具匹配，按对应应用说明检查导体包覆、绝缘间隙和端子损伤，不移用外观相近端子的压接设置。插入后先确认腔位与保持，再闭合二次锁。电气检查应依据约定针脚表，包括有意设置的并线或空位。首件需记录尺寸及检验结果，后续批次维持已认可配置。

caption.en: Wire-preparation tool reference; select the actual crimp tool from the contact instruction.
caption.zh: 导线预处理工具参考，实际压接工具须按端子应用说明选定。

copy.en: Availability depends on the complete bill of materials, including small accessories that are easy to omit from an initial enquiry. Housings may be obtainable while the required contact, seal version or mounting clip has a different lead time. Separate material confirmation, tooling preparation, sample assembly, customer approval and repeat production when planning a schedule. Supplying both mating references, circuit tables and clear dimensional datums helps reduce clarification cycles. We confirm a project-specific delivery plan after reviewing quantities and sourcing; this page does not promise that every DEUTSCH variation is stocked or available within a fixed number of days.
copy.zh: 可用性取决于完整物料表，包括初次询价容易遗漏的小附件。胶壳可能可采购，而所需端子、密封版本或安装卡扣具有不同交期。计划中应区分物料确认、工装准备、样品装配、客户认可与重复生产阶段。提供两侧对插型号、回路表和清楚尺寸基准，有助于减少澄清往返。我们在审核数量与采购条件后确认项目交付计划，本页不承诺所有 DEUTSCH 变型都有库存或能在固定天数内交付。

caption.en: Archive material-storage photograph: delivery planning starts with the complete BOM, not one housing.
caption.zh: 历史物料存储照片：交付计划从完整物料表出发，不只看一只胶壳。

copy.en: A useful quotation describes the exact assembly, not just a price per connector. Cost drivers include the specified brand and part references, contact type and finish, wire construction, branch count, labeling, protection, tooling, order quantity and verification scope. Distinguish original specified parts from an approved alternative so prices are compared on equal terms. Simplifying a branch or selecting a serviceable disconnect can reduce assembly effort, but any change needs interface and performance review. Supply annual demand and initial sample quantity separately. The quotation should identify included inspection records and any separately scoped environmental or specialized electrical testing.
copy.zh: 有效报价应描述准确组件，而不只是每只接头的价格。成本因素包括指定品牌与料号、接点类型和镀层、线材结构、分支数量、标签、防护、工装、订购数量及验证范围。指定原厂件与认可替代方案需分开，才能在相同条件下比较价格。简化分支或选用便于维护的断开点可能减少装配工时，但任何变更都需接口与性能审核。请分别提供年度需求与初始样品数量，报价也应明确包含的检验记录，以及另行规定的环境或特殊电气试验。

caption.en: Harness-construction example: branch organization and protection affect assembly work.
caption.zh: 线束构造示例：分支组织与防护结构影响装配工时。

q.en: Can DT, DTM and DTP mate with each other?
q.zh: DT、DTM 与 DTP 可以互相对插吗？

a.en: No general interchangeability should be assumed. They use different contact systems and housing geometries. Match the exact mating references, keying and contact requirements.
a.zh: 不能假定通用。它们使用不同接点系统与胶壳几何，应匹配准确对插型号、键位及端子要求。

q.en: Does a contact size of 16 mean 16 AWG wire?
q.zh: 16 号接点就是适用 16 AWG 导线吗？

a.en: No. Contact size identifies the interface system. Each contact part has its own conductor range, while the rear seal has an insulation-diameter range. Confirm all three together.
a.zh: 不是。接点号描述接口系统，每个端子料号有自己的导体范围，后部线封则有绝缘外径范围，三者需一起确认。

q.en: Are all Deutsch harnesses rated for pressure washing?
q.zh: 所有 Deutsch 线束都耐高压冲洗吗？

a.en: No blanket claim is appropriate. Verify the exact connector version, mating state, rear protection and the required test conditions. A general waterproof description is not a pressure-wash qualification.
a.zh: 不能统一承诺。应确认准确版本、对插状态、后部防护及所需试验条件，笼统的防水描述不是高压冲洗鉴定。

q.en: What information helps identify an existing connector?
q.zh: 识别现有接头需要什么资料？

a.en: Clear front and rear photos, molded markings, cavity count, key orientation, wire dimensions and the mating component are useful. A confirmed drawing or full part number is preferable to color alone.
a.zh: 清晰正反面照片、模压标记、腔位数、键位朝向、导线尺寸与对插件都有帮助，已确认图纸或完整料号比单靠颜色更可靠。

intro.en: Custom JST-interface wiring for compact electronics, sensors, equipment and lighting, with series identification, defined pinouts and application-specific materials.
intro.zh: 面向紧凑电子、传感器、设备与照明的 JST 接口定制配线，明确系列、针脚定义及适用材料。

knowledge.en: JST identifies a manufacturer, not a universal plug. PH, XH, SH, GH, SM and JWPF differ in pitch, mating geometry and application limits.
knowledge.zh: JST 是制造商名称，不是通用插头。PH、XH、SH、GH、SM 和 JWPF 的间距、对插几何及应用限制各不相同。

notes.en: Send the mating part number, cavity view, circuit list, wire size, lengths, environmental conditions and required verification.
notes.zh: 请提供对插件型号、腔位视图、回路表、线径、长度、环境条件和所需验证。

delivery.en: Review the interface and BOM, confirm the first article, then manufacture and inspect against the approved documents.
delivery.zh: 审核接口及物料，确认首件后按认可文件制造与检验。

introduction.en: JST Harnesses · Brand and Product Overview
introduction.zh: JST 线束 · 品牌与产品概览

subtitle.en: Small interfaces, complete assembly definition
subtitle.zh: 小型接口，完整装配定义

lead.en: A JST-interface harness can be a single pre-crimped lead, a board connection, an inline extension or a multi-branch equipment assembly. Super Smile can review these configurations from your drawing, approved sample and confirmed mating references. The connector family, wire and circuit definition come before the product nickname. We distinguish specified original parts from any proposed alternative in the approved BOM; brand references do not imply endorsement or authorized distribution. The following guide explains product choices, customization, applications and the evidence needed to release a repeatable assembly.
lead.zh: JST 接口线束可以是单根预压接线、板端连接线、直连延长线，也可以是多分支设备组件。超斯迈尔可依据图纸、认可样品及明确对插型号审核这些配置。接头系列、线材与回路定义应先于产品俗称，在认可物料表中区分指定原厂件与任何拟议替代件；品牌引用不代表背书或授权经销。以下介绍产品选择、定制方案、应用，以及实现可重复装配所需的证据。

openingCaption.en: Compact interconnect reference; exact series and circuit order must be confirmed.
openingCaption.zh: 紧凑互连参考，准确系列与回路顺序需另行确认。

copy.en: PH uses a 2.0 mm pitch, XH 2.5 mm, SH 1.0 mm, ZH 1.5 mm, GH 1.25 mm and VH 3.96 mm. These are separate systems, not size options for one interchangeable plug. Pitch is the center-to-center distance between adjacent contacts; measure several positions where possible and check the housing drawing. Identify the mating header, terminal, number of circuits and entry direction together. GH has a positive locking arrangement, while other families use different retention structures. A photograph of a white housing alone cannot confirm its manufacturer or series. Supply markings and dimensions before requesting a replacement.
copy.zh: PH 间距为 2.0 mm，XH 为 2.5 mm，SH 为 1.0 mm，ZH 为 1.5 mm，GH 为 1.25 mm，VH 为 3.96 mm。它们是不同接口系统，不是同一种通用插头的尺寸选项。间距指相邻接点中心距，建议跨多位测量，并对照胶壳图纸。对插针座、端子、回路数和插入朝向应一起识别。GH 具有明确锁止结构，其他系列采用不同保持方式。仅凭白色胶壳照片无法确认制造商或系列；替换询价前，请提供标记与尺寸。

caption.en: XH balance-interface example: verify pitch, cavity count and pin numbering rather than the housing color.
caption.zh: XH 平衡接口实例：核对间距、腔位数与针脚编号，不靠胶壳颜色识别。

title.zh: 产品范围 · 对接线束

copy.en: A detachable inline lead needs two compatible cable-side halves, not merely a plug described as male and another described as female. Specify housing gender separately from the pin or socket contact. JST SM is a 2.5 mm wire-to-wire system with an arm lock; its components should not be confused with PH or XH board headers. Define both ends, polarity, total length, free branch lengths and the mating view used for numbering. If a connector must pass through a panel, review the cutout and cable-installation sequence before selecting the locking arrangement. A click confirms mechanical engagement, not correct electrical polarity.
copy.zh: 可拆卸直连线需要两套互相匹配的电缆端零件，不只是一个所谓公头加一个母头。胶壳性别与针、孔端子的性别应分别注明。JST SM 是带臂式锁扣的 2.5 mm 线对线系统，不应与 PH、XH 板端针座混淆。需定义两端型号、极性、总长、分支自由长度及编号所依据的对插视图。接头需要穿过面板时，应在选锁止方式前审核开孔与安装顺序。听到卡扣声只能说明机械接合，不能证明电气极性正确。

caption.en: JST RCY mating leads illustrate a detachable inline pair; RCY is a different family from SM.
caption.zh: JST RCY 对接线展示可拆直连结构，RCY 与 SM 是不同系列。

copy.en: A single-ended lead has one prepared connector or contact end and a second end defined for the next assembly operation. A double-ended lead connects two specified interfaces; it does not mean that the harness has only two circuits. Options include individual pre-crimped wires, multi-position housings, stripped tails, ferrules or a second connector family. Record the cut length and its measurement datum, strip length, conductor construction and insulation diameter. Pre-crimped contacts must remain protected during packing. Unhoused terminals require an insertion plan so the next operator can populate cavities without reversing the circuit order.
copy.zh: 单端连接线的一端完成接头或端子加工，另一端按后续装配要求定义；双端连接线连接两种已指定接口，并不表示线束只有两路回路。可讨论单根预压接线、多位胶壳、剥皮尾端、管形端头或另一系列接头。需记录切线长度及测量基准、剥皮长度、导体结构和绝缘外径。预压接端子在包装中应受到保护；未装壳端子还需要清楚的插位方案，避免下一工序倒置回路顺序。

caption.en: A two-wire prepared lead illustrates one-ended termination; its polarity comes from the equipment drawing.
caption.zh: 两线预制连接线说明单端加工，极性应以设备图纸为准。

copy.en: Sealed and heat-resistant are different requirements. The JWPF wire-to-wire catalog describes an IPX7 configuration under IEC 60529 / JIS C 0920; this is not evidence that every JST connector is waterproof, pressure-wash resistant or suitable for permanent immersion. Its stated temperature limit also includes current-related temperature rise. Review seals, wire insulation diameter, unused cavities, mating condition and the route by which water could travel along the cable. For hot equipment, select the exact connector and wire specification against the local temperature profile. An environmental image illustrates the exposure being discussed, not a passed test on our product.
copy.zh: 密封与耐热是两个不同要求。JWPF 线对线目录介绍了按 IEC 60529／JIS C 0920 定义的 IPX7 配置，这不能证明所有 JST 接头都防水、耐高压冲洗或适合长期浸没，其温度范围也包含通电温升。应审核密封件、绝缘外径、空腔处理、对插状态及水沿电缆进入的路径。热环境设备需按局部温度分布选择准确接头和线材规格。环境照片用于说明讨论的暴露条件，不代表我们的产品已通过相应试验。

caption.en: Rainwater is the exposure to consider; this environmental photo is not a connector ingress-test result.
caption.zh: 雨水是需要考虑的环境暴露，本图不是接头防护试验结果。

copy.en: A multi-pin assembly can combine switches, sensors, indicators and supply branches in one defined loom. More positions make cavity identification and breakout control more important, not less. Mark connector references, pin-one orientation, branch datums and any intentionally unpopulated positions in the drawing. Define whether grounds are separate, joined at a splice or returned to the board. Do not increase an interface current rating simply by paralleling contacts: load sharing and protection require an engineering review. A controlled wire list and first-article check turn a complex harness into a repeatable assembly rather than a bundle matched by color.
copy.zh: 多针组件可以把开关、传感器、指示器和供电分支整合为一套明确线束。位数越多，腔位识别和分支控制越重要。图纸应标明接头代号、第一针方向、分支基准及有意留空的腔位，同时定义地线是独立返回、在接点汇合，还是回到板端。不能简单通过并联接点提高接口额定电流，分流和保护需工程审核。受控线表与首件确认，才能把复杂线束变成可重复装配的产品，而不是依靠颜色匹配的一束线。

caption.en: Multi-position board interface reference; every occupied and unused cavity needs a defined assignment.
caption.zh: 多位板端接口参考：已用与空置腔位都需要明确分配。

title.en: Customization · Smart Home and Precision Electronics
title.zh: 定制方案 · 智能家居与精密电子

copy.en: A sensor hub, smart lock or compact instrument has limited space for both the connector and the operator's fingers. Begin with the board interface and the actual enclosure, then define cable exit, slack and service access. PH, SH, ZH or GH may be candidates only when their mating parts and operating limits match the design. Small connectors do not define a communication protocol: supply voltage, ground, clock and data order still come from the equipment circuit. Separate sensitive analog routes from noisy switching paths where the system design requires it. Review wire length and shielding as electrical decisions rather than decorative cable options.
copy.zh: 传感器网关、智能锁与紧凑仪器不仅接头空间有限，操作人员手指的空间也有限。先核对板端接口和真实机壳，再定义出线、余量与维护通道。PH、SH、ZH、GH 只有在对插件及工作限制匹配时才是候选方案。小型接头并不定义通信协议，供电、地、时钟和数据的顺序仍由设备电路规定。按系统设计需要，让敏感模拟路径远离开关噪声路径；线长和屏蔽属于电气选择，而不是装饰性配置。

caption.en: Compact Qwiic / JST connector reference: a small interface still needs a defined electrical pinout.
caption.zh: 紧凑 Qwiic／JST 接头参考：接口虽小，电气针序仍需明确。

title.zh: 定制方案 · 工业设备

copy.en: Internal control wiring may connect a controller to fans, sensors, small drives or an operator panel. The required connector is determined by the approved equipment interface, not by the word industrial. VH is a 3.96 mm wire-to-board family, but its published current conditions differ with wire and header selection. A current value for one combination cannot be transferred to every VH assembly. Review continuous and transient load, enclosure temperature, bend space and restraint near the connector. Service loops should permit maintenance without rubbing against sharp sheet metal. External exposed wiring may need a different sealed system from the protected internal board connection.
copy.zh: 设备内部控制配线可连接控制器、风扇、传感器、小型驱动器或操作面板。所需接头由认可设备接口决定，不能只凭“工业”两字选择。VH 是 3.96 mm 线对板系列，但其公布电流条件随线材和针座选择变化，某种组合的电流值不能套用到所有 VH 组件。应审核持续与瞬态负载、机壳温度、弯曲空间和接头附近固定。检修余量应允许维护，又不接触钣金锐边；外露线束可能需要不同于受保护板端连接的密封系统。

caption.en: Drive cabinet application reference; internal control wiring and high-power circuits have separate requirements.
caption.zh: 驱动柜应用参考：内部控制配线与大功率回路的要求需要区分。

title.zh: 定制方案 · 汽车电子

copy.en: Vehicle electronics introduce vibration, temperature cycling, supply transients and service constraints that are not resolved by choosing a familiar connector name. Establish whether the assembly is inside a protected module, in the cabin or exposed outside the vehicle. Confirm the exact approved interface, conductor insulation and retention requirements for that location. If the customer specifies a vehicle test standard, identify the required clauses, samples, fixtures and acceptance limits before quotation. We do not infer automotive qualification from a JST brand marking or promise a universal drop-in replacement. An approved pin map remains essential even where two housings mate mechanically.
copy.zh: 汽车电子涉及振动、温度循环、供电瞬态和维修限制，选择熟悉的接头名称并不能解决这些问题。应明确组件位于受保护模块内部、乘员舱内，还是车外暴露位置，再确认该位置认可的接口、导线绝缘与保持要求。客户指定整车试验标准时，应在报价前确认条款、样品、治具及判定限值。我们不会凭 JST 标记推定汽车认证，也不承诺通用直接替换；即使两个胶壳机械上可插合，认可针脚表仍不可缺少。

caption.en: Vehicle control-module interior illustrates the equipment context, not a claim that this module uses JST parts.
caption.zh: 车辆控制模块内部用于说明应用环境，不表示该模块使用 JST 零件。

copy.en: The useful advantage of a kit is a consistent assembly definition: approved components, known wire preparation, readable identification and an agreed inspection plan. Genuine specified JST parts and any proposed substitute must be distinguished on the BOM and quotation. Material choices include conductor size and strand construction, insulation thickness and the terminal's permitted wire range. Flexible customization covers circuit count, lengths, branch arrangements and labels, subject to the chosen interface. Cost control starts by resolving ambiguous ends and unnecessary operations before production. Small pilot quantities can confirm fit and assembly sequence without turning an unverified prototype into a claim of proven field durability.
copy.zh: 套件真正的优势是装配定义一致：认可零件、明确线端加工、可读标识及约定检验计划。指定 JST 原厂件与任何拟议替代件，必须在物料表和报价中区分。材料选择涵盖导体线径与绞合结构、绝缘厚度及端子允许线材范围；在已选接口条件下，可定制回路数、长度、分支和标签。成本控制从生产前澄清模糊接口、消除不必要工序开始。小批试制可确认适配与装配顺序，但不能把未经充分验证的样品说成已证明长期现场耐用。

caption.en: JST CZH crimp-tool reference: tooling is terminal-specific, not universal across all JST families.
caption.zh: JST CZH 压接工具参考：工具对应具体端子，不通用于所有 JST 系列。

title.zh: 行业与应用 · 消费电子

copy.en: Speakers, appliances, cameras and handheld devices use compact internal leads for different combinations of power and signal. The design must allow assembly without pulling on the terminal or bending the PCB header. Check polarity at battery and charging connections against the actual board: wire color and a two-position housing are not enough to establish a standard pinout. Where a enclosure can be opened for service, include a repeatable unplugging method and accessible slack. Product electrical safety and thermal behavior are assessed at equipment level; a small connector's catalog entry does not certify the complete device.
copy.zh: 音箱、电器、摄像设备与手持设备通过紧凑内部连接线传输不同供电与信号组合。设计应允许装配时不拉扯端子、不弯折板端针座。电池和充电接口极性必须对照实际电路板，不能凭线色和两位胶壳认定统一针序。机壳可拆维修时，应提供可重复的拔插方式及可触及余量。产品电气安全与热表现需在设备层面评估，小型接头的目录参数不能认证整台设备。

caption.en: An instrument cooling-fan connection illustrates internal routing and access for maintenance.
caption.zh: 仪器散热风扇连接展示内部布线及检修操作空间。

title.zh: 行业与应用 · 航模与无人机

copy.en: Lightweight sensor and flight-controller leads require exact pin order, secure routing and clearance from propellers or moving mechanisms. GH and other compact families may appear in controller ecosystems, but a shared connector family does not ensure identical voltage or signal assignment. Document each endpoint and its circuit function before making an adapter. Keep strain away from soldered board headers, and avoid unsupported cable mass at small contacts. The harness may carry telemetry, positioning or control signals; the aircraft's electromagnetic, vibration and flight validation remain system responsibilities. Do not treat a connector photograph as proof of compatibility with a particular flight controller.
copy.zh: 轻量化传感器及飞控连接线需要准确针序、可靠布线，并避开螺旋桨或运动机构。GH 等紧凑系列可用于控制器系统，但相同接头系列并不保证电压或信号分配一致。制作转接线前，应记录每一端点及回路功能，让应力远离焊接在板上的针座，避免小接点承受悬空电缆重量。线束可传输遥测、定位或控制信号，航空器的电磁、振动与飞行验证仍属于系统责任。接头照片不能作为适配某飞控型号的证明。

caption.en: MindPX controller reference: verify endpoint mapping and cable restraint in the complete aircraft.
caption.zh: MindPX 控制器参考：在完整飞行器中确认端点映射与电缆固定。

title.zh: 行业与应用 · 医疗设备

copy.en: Medical-device projects can include internal display, control and sensor harnesses, but the intended use defines the risk and evidence required. Distinguish wiring inside an enclosure from patient-connected circuits, disposable accessories or parts exposed to cleaning and sterilization. Confirm approved materials, leakage-related requirements, traceability and any customer-mandated verification before accepting the design. A JST interface name is not medical-device approval. Where the customer controls the device design, our harness documentation should clearly identify supplied boundaries and agreed tests. Changes in wire insulation, terminal finish or component source require the appropriate review rather than an informal substitution.
copy.zh: 医疗设备项目可包括内部显示、控制和传感器线束，但预期用途决定风险与证据要求。需区分机壳内部配线、患者连接回路、一次性附件及暴露于清洁或灭菌过程的部件。接受设计前，应确认认可材料、相关漏电要求、追溯范围和客户指定验证。JST 接口名称不是医疗设备批准。在客户控制整机设计的项目中，线束文件应明确供货边界与约定测试；绝缘、端子镀层或零件来源改变，都需要相应审核，而不是随意替代。

caption.en: Wearable oximeter application reference; medical suitability is assessed for the specified device and circuit.
caption.zh: 腕式血氧仪应用参考：医疗适用性需按指定设备与回路评估。

title.zh: 行业与应用 · LED 照明

copy.en: LED modules can need supply leads, dimming wires or separate data connections. Identify voltage, current direction and pin assignment before selecting a familiar two-, three- or four-wire connector. An SM-style locking inline connection is not automatically waterproof, and a sealed assembly still needs suitable cable entries and strain relief. Longer supply runs need a voltage-drop review at the intended load. For addressable lighting, preserve the specified signal reference and routing rather than assuming that every connector can carry any data scheme. Separate replaceable light modules at practical service points while keeping the wiring protected from heat around the driver or LED board.
copy.zh: LED 模组可能需要供电线、调光线或独立数据连接。选择常见两线、三线或四线接头前，应确认电压、电流方向及针脚定义。SM 式锁止直连接头并不自动防水，即使使用密封组件，仍需要合适的进线和应力释放。较长供电线路应按实际负载审核压降；可寻址灯光需保持指定信号参考与布线，不能假设任何接头都适用于任意数据方案。可替换灯模组应在合理检修点断开，同时保护线材免受驱动器或灯板附近热量影响。

caption.en: LED strip and supply illustrate the distinction between supply wiring, control and module connections.
caption.zh: LED 灯带与电源用于说明供电、控制及模组连接的区别。

title.zh: 生产前的可制造性审核

copy.en: Early review connects the circuit drawing to the real assembly sequence. First resolve the mating interface and cavity view, then check fit, latch access and cable bending within the enclosure. Match insulation diameter and conductor size to the terminal rather than choosing a tool solely by wire gauge. Review whether seals, sleeves, ferrules or labels must be fitted before a connector is populated. A first article should check dimensions and routing in the actual mating equipment where available. Record approved deviations on the drawing, not only in an email. These checks help prevent a correctly crimped harness from becoming impossible to install.
copy.zh: 前期审核把电路图与真实装配顺序连接起来。先澄清对插接口和腔位视图，再检查机壳中的配合、锁扣操作和电缆弯曲。绝缘外径与导体线径应匹配端子，不能仅凭线规选工具。还需审核密封件、套管、管形端头或标签是否必须在装壳前安装。条件允许时，首件应在实际对插设备中检查尺寸和布线路径。认可偏差应记录在图纸上，而不只留在邮件中。这些检查可避免线束虽然压接正确，却无法装入设备。

caption.en: Dimensional inspection supports fit review; pitch alone does not establish connector compatibility.
caption.zh: 尺寸检查支持配合审核，单凭间距不能确认接头兼容。

title.zh: 接触电阻与使用可靠性

copy.en: Contact resistance depends on the selected contact system and the condition of both mating surfaces. A continuity tester can identify an open circuit, but it cannot by itself characterize a low-resistance joint or long-term stability. Where required, specify a suitable low-resistance measurement method, test current, sampling and acceptance criteria. Review crimp height, conductor capture and insulation support against the terminal's application specification. Insertion cycles, temperature exposure and vibration are separate test conditions; do not assume a universal 500-cycle rating across JST families. Any durability statement for the supplied harness needs evidence tied to its actual materials, construction and agreed test configuration.
copy.zh: 接触电阻取决于选定接点系统及两侧接触面的状态。导通仪可以发现断路，却不能单独表征低电阻接头或长期稳定性。有要求时，应规定合适的低电阻测量方法、测试电流、抽样及判定标准，并按端子应用规范审核压接高度、导体包覆与绝缘支撑。插拔次数、温度暴露与振动是不同试验条件，不能假设所有 JST 系列都具有统一的 500 次寿命。供货线束的任何耐久性说明，都需要与实际材料、结构及约定试验配置相关的证据。

caption.en: Low-resistance measurement equipment reference; select the method and test conditions for the actual joint.
caption.zh: 低电阻测量设备参考，测量方法及条件需按实际接头确定。

copy.en: Define the required record package when the order is reviewed. It may link the assembly revision, approved BOM, component labels, wire lots, production date and inspection results to a shipment batch. Keep original specified components distinguishable from approved alternatives so later investigation can reconstruct what was supplied. A build history should include approved changes and first-article feedback, not just a final packing list. Customer audits and regulated applications may need additional retention periods or records; agree these before production. Traceability supports investigation and change control, but it is not a substitute for correct design or the tests required by the application.
copy.zh: 订单审核时应定义所需记录包，可将组件版本、认可物料表、零件标签、线材批次、生产日期和检验结果关联到出货批次。指定原厂零件与认可替代件需清楚区分，使后续调查能够还原实际供货配置。制造履历应包含认可变更及首件反馈，而不只是最终装箱单。客户审核或受监管应用可能需要额外保存期限和记录，应在生产前约定。追溯支持问题调查与变更控制，但不能代替正确设计或应用所需测试。

caption.en: Equipment identification example illustrates linking records to a physical unit; it is not our production label.
caption.zh: 设备编号实例说明记录与实物的关联，不是我司生产标签。

q.en: Are JST XH and a 2.54 mm connector interchangeable?
q.zh: JST XH 与 2.54 mm 接头能通用吗？

a.en: Do not assume so. JST specifies XH at 2.5 mm. Pitch, contact geometry, keying and housing dimensions must all match; a similar-looking 2.54 mm product is not automatically compatible.
a.zh: 不能这样假设。JST 将 XH 定义为 2.5 mm 间距；间距、接点几何、键位及胶壳尺寸都须匹配，外观相似的 2.54 mm 产品不自动兼容。

q.en: Does a two-pin PH cable have a standard battery polarity?
q.zh: 两针 PH 电缆具有统一电池极性吗？

a.en: The connector geometry does not establish the equipment's polarity. Confirm the board pinout, mating view and wire assignment before building or connecting the cable.
a.zh: 接头几何不决定设备极性。制造或连接前，必须确认板端针脚、对插视图及导线分配。

q.en: Can you provide wire-to-wire and waterproof versions?
q.zh: 能否制作线对线与防水版本？

a.en: We can review specified inline and sealed interfaces, including SM or JWPF where appropriate. Their geometry and environmental limits differ; a seal or locking latch alone does not qualify the whole harness.
a.zh: 可审核指定直连与密封接口，在适用时包括 SM 或 JWPF。它们的几何与环境限制不同，仅有密封件或锁扣不能证明整套线束的性能。

q.en: What is needed for a quotation and prototype?
q.zh: 报价和打样需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both mating references, circuit list, wire specification, dimensions, operating environment and quantities. Identify original-part requirements, approved substitutions, inspection records and any special validation before the prototype is released.
a.zh: 请提供两端对插型号、回路表、线材规格、尺寸、运行环境和数量，打样前明确原厂件要求、认可替代、检验记录及特殊验证。
