intro.en: Custom wire-to-board, wire-to-wire and equipment cable assemblies built around specified Molex interfaces, with defined circuits, materials and inspection requirements.
intro.zh: 围绕指定 Molex 接口开发线对板、线对线及设备电缆组件，明确回路、材料与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Molex is a manufacturer, not one plug size. Family, mating geometry, terminal and electrical duty must be identified together.
knowledge.zh: Molex 是制造商名称，不是一种插头尺寸。系列、对插几何、端子及电气工况需要一起识别。

notes.en: Provide full mating references, cavity views, circuit table, wire specification, dimensions, routing conditions and order quantities.
notes.zh: 请提供完整对插型号、腔位视图、接线表、线材规格、尺寸、布线条件与订购数量。

delivery.en: Confirm the BOM and interface, approve the sample and test plan, then release controlled assembly and agreed verification.
delivery.zh: 确认物料与接口，认可样品及测试计划后，执行受控装配与约定验证。

introduction.zh: 什么是 Molex 接口组件？

subtitle.en: From board interfaces to serviceable equipment wiring
subtitle.zh: 从板端接口到可维护设备配线

lead.en: A “Molex cable” can mean a compact sensor lead, an appliance power loom, an inline extension, an RF jumper or a cable linked to a board interface. These products share a supplier name, not a universal contact geometry. Super Smile can develop the harness portion from your drawing, approved sample or confirmed mating references. The connector overview below explains the surrounding interface choices; it does not claim that we manufacture every Molex board connector or every complete electronic subsystem. Genuine specified parts and proposed alternatives must be distinguished in the quotation and approved BOM. Brand names identify the requested interface and do not imply authorization or endorsement.
lead.zh: “Molex 电缆”可能指紧凑传感器连接线、电器供电线束、直连延长线、射频跳线，或与板端接口连接的组件。它们共享的是供应商品牌名称，不是通用接点几何。超斯迈尔可依据图纸、认可样品或已确认对插型号开发线束部分。下文连接器概览用于解释相关接口选择，不表示我们制造所有 Molex 板端连接器或完整电子系统。指定原厂零件与提出的替代方案，应在报价和认可清单中区分。品牌名称用于识别所需接口，不代表授权或背书。

openingCaption.en: Connector and cable reference: identify the exact system before defining the assembly.
openingCaption.zh: 连接器与电缆参考：先识别准确系统，再定义组件。

copy.en: Select the connection around its job: power delivery, low-level signals, high-speed data, repeated servicing or installation in a confined enclosure. A larger connector is not automatically the better choice, and a smaller pitch does not describe the whole electrical capability. Appliance, automation, communications and instrument harnesses have different routing and maintenance needs. Record the number of loaded circuits, ambient conditions, wire length and allowable movement before choosing the family. Then consider locking, polarization and access for insertion or release. This application-first approach keeps a procurement name such as “Molex plug” from hiding the details that determine whether the harness actually fits the equipment.
copy.zh: 应围绕连接任务选型：供电、低电平信号、高速数据、重复维护，或狭小机壳内安装。接头更大不代表一定更合适，间距更小也不能概括全部电气能力。电器、自动化、通信和仪器线束的布线与维护需求不同。选择系列前，应记录带载回路数量、环境条件、线长及允许运动，再考虑锁止、防误插和插拔操作空间。这样可以避免“Molex 插头”之类采购名称，掩盖真正决定线束是否适配设备的细节。

caption.en: Equipment electronics illustrate differing power, signal and service requirements; the connector brand is not inferred from the scene.
caption.zh: 设备电子系统用于说明供电、信号与维护需求差异，不据场景推定连接器品牌。

copy.en: A backplane connects several boards within a chassis. Molex families such as Impel and Impulse address defined high-density interconnect architectures, including different board and cable arrangements. For a cable project, first separate the board connector, cable connector and complete channel requirements. Pin assignment, differential-pair mapping, return paths and mechanical alignment belong in the interface definition. A simple continuity check cannot establish high-speed channel performance. Where a project uses proprietary high-speed assemblies or licensed components, sourcing and validation must be reviewed before making a manufacturing commitment. Our enquiry can cover the applicable harness or auxiliary wiring without implying that a generic lead replaces the complete backplane system.
copy.zh: 背板在机箱内部连接多块板卡。Molex 的 Impel、Impulse 等系列面向规定的高密度互连架构，包含不同板端与电缆布置。进入电缆项目时，应先区分板端连接器、电缆端连接器和完整通道要求；针脚分配、差分对映射、回流路径及机械对准都属于接口定义。简单导通不能证明高速通道性能。涉及专用高速组件或受限零件的项目，需要先审核采购与验证条件，再承诺制造范围。我们可讨论适用线束或辅助配线，但不把普通连接线说成完整背板系统的替代品。

caption.en: Backplane reference: the board interface and cable channel are separate engineering boundaries.
caption.zh: 背板结构参考：板端接口与电缆通道是需要分别定义的工程边界。

copy.en: SlimStack is one example of a Molex board-to-board and board-to-FPC family. Mated height, pitch, circuit count, mounting orientation and alignment features vary by series. If an equipment redesign replaces a rigid board link with a flexible connection, the new assembly needs more than a matching position count. Check the required mating interface, mechanical support, bend location and signal assignment. Avoid allowing cable pull to become a load on a small surface-mount connector. The PCB layout and soldering process remain part of the board design; a harness quotation should define where our supplied assembly starts and where the customer’s board assembly ends.
copy.zh: SlimStack 是 Molex 板对板及板对 FPC 系列的一个例子。对接高度、间距、回路数量、安装朝向与对准结构因系列而异。设备改型若把刚性板间连接改成柔性连接，需要考虑的不只是相同位数，还包括对插界面、机械支撑、弯折位置与信号分配。应避免电缆拉力直接作用于小型表贴接头。PCB 布局与焊接过程仍属于板级设计；线束报价应明确我们供货组件从哪里开始、客户板级装配在哪里结束。

caption.en: Small board interconnect detail illustrates alignment and mounting constraints, not a verified SlimStack part.
caption.zh: 小型板间互连细节用于说明对准与安装限制，不将其认定为 SlimStack 料号。

copy.en: Card-edge sockets connect to conductive fingers on a PCB rather than to individually crimped wire contacts. EdgeLine is a Molex family within this field. Board thickness, contact placement, keying and insertion geometry are therefore central specifications. A cable adapter or test extension requires the correct card interface plus a defined electrical mapping; it is not an ordinary wire-to-wire conversion. Consider whether repeated insertion, fixture support or restricted access changes the mechanical arrangement. For high-speed paths, the added adapter length and transitions must be included in the validation plan rather than assumed harmless because all circuits show continuity.
copy.zh: 卡边插座连接 PCB 边缘的导电金手指，而不是逐根压接的导线接点。EdgeLine 是 Molex 在这一领域的系列之一，因此板厚、接点位置、键位与插入几何是核心规格。电缆转接件或测试延长件需要正确卡边界面和明确电气映射，并不是普通线对线转换。还需考虑重复插拔、治具支撑或操作空间是否改变机械安排。高速路径增加的转接长度与过渡应纳入验证，不能因为各回路导通，就认为对信号没有影响。

caption.en: PCB edge contacts show the mating principle; board thickness and contact pattern must match the specified socket.
caption.zh: PCB 金手指展示对接原理，板厚和接点排列须匹配指定插座。

copy.en: Easy-On connectors and Premo-Flex cables are names used in Molex flat-flex interconnect solutions. A reliable specification includes pitch, circuit count, cable thickness, exposed-contact side, insertion depth and actuator type. FFC and FPC are related forms of flexible interconnect, but they are not interchangeable names for every construction. A top-contact socket and a bottom-contact socket may require different cable-end orientation. Also check stiffener dimensions and the space needed to open a latch. A display or sensor flex extension should preserve the intended pin order and strain relief; forcing a cable into a nearly matching socket risks damage to both the contact surface and the actuator.
copy.zh: Easy-On 连接器与 Premo-Flex 电缆是 Molex 柔性扁平互连方案中的系列名称。完整规格包含间距、回路数、电缆厚度、露铜面、插入深度和操作机构类型。FFC 与 FPC 属于相关柔性互连形式，但不能对所有结构混用名称。上接点与下接点插座可能需要不同的线端朝向，还应检查补强板尺寸与打开锁扣所需空间。显示或传感器柔性延长件应保持规定针序和应力释放；把电缆强行插入“差不多”的插座，可能损伤接触面和锁扣。

caption.en: Flexible interconnect reference: contact-side orientation and reinforcement matter as much as pitch.
caption.zh: 柔性互连参考：接触面朝向与补强结构和间距同样重要。

copy.en: Heavy-duty rectangular systems can bring many circuits through a machine panel in one serviceable connection. Molex HMC documentation describes this class of rugged, high-position-count interface. The insert, hood, base, cable entry, retention and sealing details form a complete system. Select them with the installation route and operating environment rather than treating the outer metal shell as the entire specification. A machine harness may need separate power and control branches, panel labels and accessible disconnect points. Any stated environmental or electrical capability must correspond to the selected configuration and approved installation, not to the general appearance of an industrial connector.
copy.zh: 重载矩形系统可以通过一个便于维护的连接点，让多路回路穿过机械面板。Molex HMC 文件介绍了这类坚固、多位接口。插芯、上壳、底座、进线口、保持与密封细节共同组成系统，应结合安装路线和运行环境选择，而不是把外部金属壳当成全部规格。机械线束可能需要分开的供电与控制分支、面板标签及方便断开的检修位置。任何环境或电气能力，都应对应选定配置与认可安装条件，不能依据工业接头的外观推定。

caption.en: Hirschmann industrial connector reference illustrates a detachable equipment interface; it is not a Molex HMC product.
caption.zh: Hirschmann 工业接头用于说明可拆设备接口，并非 Molex HMC 产品。

copy.en: External I/O links connect the equipment to users, peripherals or other machines. Molex offers USB and other I/O connector families, but the shape of a receptacle does not establish the finished cable’s data rate, power capability or environmental rating. A USB Type-C interface, for example, needs a configuration-specific cable definition rather than a blanket “USB4” label. Describe host and device roles, supported functions, length, shield termination and panel mounting. If an adapter is required, identify whether it is passive wiring or includes electronics. Compliance or certification should only be claimed for the exact tested product and authorized scope.
copy.zh: 外部 I/O 将设备连接到用户、外设或其他机器。Molex 提供 USB 等 I/O 系列，但插座外形不能确定成品电缆的数据速率、功率能力或防护等级。例如 USB Type-C 接口需要具体电缆配置定义，不能一概标注为“USB4”。应描述主机与设备角色、支持功能、长度、屏蔽端接和面板安装。需要转接时，还应确认它是无源配线还是包含电子电路。符合性或认证声明，只能针对确实经过测试的产品及获准范围。

caption.en: External-port reference: connector shape alone cannot define the completed cable’s supported functions.
caption.zh: 外部接口参考：连接器外形本身不能定义成品电缆支持的功能。

title.zh: 存储卡 / SIM 卡连接器

copy.en: Memory and SIM sockets are board-mounted interfaces with their own card format, contact arrangement and insertion or ejection mechanism. Molex lists push-push, push-pull, hinge, tray and pin-eject configurations across its portfolio. These differences affect enclosure access and servicing. A remote card extension or service fixture needs the exact host-side interface and a controlled signal path; it cannot be specified by the word “SIM” alone. The socket is not itself a wire harness. For enquiries that include such an interface, we first confirm whether the requested deliverable is a cable assembly, a customer-defined adapter or a separate board-level item.
copy.zh: 存储卡与 SIM 插座是具有独立卡片格式、接点排列及插入或弹出机构的板端接口。Molex 产品范围包含推推式、推拉式、翻盖式、卡托式和顶针弹出式等配置，这些差异会影响机壳开口与维护方式。远置卡片延长件或服务治具需要准确主机侧界面和受控信号路径，不能只用“SIM”一词定义。插座本身不是线束；遇到这类接口咨询时，我们先确认交付对象是电缆组件、客户定义转接件，还是独立板级零件。

caption.en: Card-socket reference: access and retention mechanisms are part of the interface requirement.
caption.zh: 卡座参考：操作空间与保持机构同样属于接口要求。

title.zh: 同轴连接器与射频跳线

copy.en: Molex RF offerings span multiple connector series, impedances and frequency requirements. A coaxial jumper needs the connector pair, cable type, length, routing and performance limits defined as one channel. SMA, MCX and MMCX identify different interface families, not interchangeable ends. Compact antenna leads also need care with mating direction and cable pull. For a proposed assembly, specify whether insertion loss, return loss or other RF measurements are required and at which frequencies. DC continuity is useful but does not demonstrate RF performance. Keep shield termination and bend constraints in the drawing so that production handling does not undermine the intended channel.
copy.zh: Molex 射频产品覆盖多个接口系列、阻抗和频率要求。同轴跳线应把两端连接器、电缆类型、长度、布线及性能限值作为完整通道定义。SMA、MCX 与 MMCX 表示不同接口系列，并非可互换端部。紧凑天线连接还需注意对插方向与电缆拉力。组件方案应明确是否需要插入损耗、回波损耗等射频测量，以及对应频率。直流导通有用，但不能证明射频性能。屏蔽端接与弯曲限制应写入图纸，避免生产操作破坏预期通道。

caption.en: Coaxial connector detail illustrates the centre-contact and outer-conductor interface, not a universal RF rating.
caption.zh: 同轴接头细节用于说明中心接点与外导体接口，不代表通用射频等级。

copy.en: Wire-to-board systems join a terminated cable to a PCB header. Mini-Fit’s 4.20 mm platform, Micro-Fit 3.0 and PicoBlade’s 1.25 mm interface are useful identification starting points, but pitch is only the first filter. Each family has its own housings, terminals and mating options. As an example, PicoBlade documentation for the 51021 family must be read with the corresponding terminal and header information. Check wire gauge, insulation diameter, plating, circuit count and latch access. The published maximum for a family is not an automatic allowable load for every fully populated harness. The approved component configuration and actual operating conditions determine the engineering decision.
copy.zh: 线对板系统把已端接电缆连接至 PCB 针座。Mini-Fit 的 4.20 mm 平台、Micro-Fit 3.0 与 PicoBlade 的 1.25 mm 接口，可以作为初步识别线索，但间距只是第一道筛选。各系列都有独立壳体、端子与对插选项。例如 PicoBlade 51021 系列文件应结合对应端子和针座资料一起阅读，并检查线径、绝缘外径、镀层、回路数量及锁扣操作空间。系列公布的最高值，不是每条满位线束都可直接采用的允许负载；工程决定应依据认可零件配置和实际运行条件。

caption.en: ATX cable-end reference illustrates keyed cavities and terminated wires; exact family and origin require part identification.
caption.zh: ATX 电缆端参考用于说明键位腔形与已端接导线，准确系列和来源仍需料号识别。

copy.en: Inline connections are useful for detachable modules, repair sections and serviceable branches. Molex’s wire-to-wire portfolio includes multiple systems with different retention, sealing and contact arrangements. A matching circuit count or familiar white housing is not proof that two parts belong together. Identify both cable halves, terminal genders, latch direction and the approved wire range. If a branch combines power and signals, preserve the intended circuit allocation and marking. The harness drawing should show the assembled length and the reference points used to measure it, not just the cut length of each wire. This avoids unexpected short leads after terminals, seals and protective parts have been fitted.
copy.zh: 直连连接适用于可拆模块、维修段和便于检修的分支。Molex 线对线产品包含保持、密封与接点安排不同的多个系统。相同回路数或熟悉的白色壳体，不能证明两个零件配套。应识别两侧电缆端、端子公母、卡扣方向及认可线径；分支组合供电与信号时，还应保持规定回路分配和标识。线束图应标明装配后长度及测量基准，而不只是每根导线的裁切长度，避免端子、密封及防护零件装上后，连接线实际长度不足。

caption.en: Inline power-connector reference: both mating halves and terminal systems require identification.
caption.zh: 直连供电接头参考：两侧对插件与端子系统均需识别。

copy.en: A small terminal still needs a complete material and process definition. Conductor size, strand construction, insulation diameter, contact plating and the crimp support zone must agree with the selected terminal documents. Housing resin and any glow-wire requirement are part-specific decisions, not properties that can be inferred from colour. Sleeving, heat shrink, labels and branch protection should have defined positions and functions. Do not add solder to a crimp or substitute a contact finish unless the approved specification permits it. For alternatives, compare the mating system and application requirements first, then obtain written approval of the proposed BOM and verification scope.
copy.zh: 小型端子同样需要完整材料与过程定义。导体截面积、绞线结构、绝缘外径、接点镀层及压接支撑区域，应与所选端子文件一致。壳体树脂与灼热丝要求属于具体料号层面的决定，不能从颜色推断。套管、热缩管、标签及分支防护应有明确位置和功能。未经认可规格允许，不应在压接处额外加焊锡或更换接点表面处理。替代方案应先比较对插系统与应用要求，再取得对物料清单和验证范围的书面批准。

caption.en: Copper wire-rod production reference: the final conductor and insulation specifications still require definition.
caption.zh: 铜线坯生产参考：最终导体与绝缘规格仍需单独定义。

title.zh: 超斯迈尔可以开发哪些组件？

copy.en: Our assembly work can include specified connector leads, branch harnesses, equipment looms, panel connections and approved adapter configurations. The starting point can be a drawing, an authorized sample or a confirmed set of mating parts. We help turn those inputs into a BOM, circuit definition, dimensions, protection details and an inspection plan. Scope and sourcing are confirmed for the actual project; the Molex name does not imply a stock commitment or distributor relationship. Pricing depends on the approved materials, contact count, preparation and assembly work, tooling, validation and order quantity. Sample and production schedules are agreed after the necessary inputs and approval steps are understood.
copy.zh: 我们可开发指定接口连接线、分支线束、设备整机配线、面板连接及已认可转接配置。起点可以是图纸、获准使用的样品或已确认对插件，再将这些输入整理为物料清单、回路定义、尺寸、防护细节及检验计划。具体范围与采购条件按项目确认，Molex 名称不表示现货承诺或经销关系。价格取决于认可材料、接点数量、准备与装配工作、工装、验证和订单数量；样品与量产安排需在明确必要资料和认可步骤后约定。

caption.en: Historical Molex packaging label illustrates part-number and lot identification, not current Super Smile stock or pricing.
caption.zh: 历史 Molex 包装标签用于说明料号与批次识别，不代表超斯迈尔当前库存或价格。

title.en: From First Article to Repeat Production

copy.en: First-article review connects the drawing to the physical assembly. Confirm cavity numbering from the stated viewing direction, terminal seating, latch operation, insulation support, branch length and the test map. A fixture should test the agreed circuits rather than rely on wire colours. Continuity and appearance checks do not replace a specific requirement for contact retention, sealing or signal performance; those checks need their own method and acceptance criteria. After approval, control the BOM, tooling setup and work instructions. Record any material or process change and evaluate whether it requires renewed sample approval. This is how a one-off prototype becomes a repeatable equipment connection.
copy.zh: 首件审核把图纸与实物对应起来，需要按规定观察方向核对腔位编号、端子就位、卡扣操作、绝缘支撑、分支长度及测试网络。治具应检测约定回路，而不是依靠线色判断。导通和外观检查不能替代明确要求的接点保持、密封或信号性能，这些检查需要各自方法和接收准则。认可后应控制物料清单、工装设置及作业说明，记录材料或过程变化，并判断是否需要重新送样认可，使一次性样件转化为可重复的设备连接。

caption.en: Multimeter reference: continuity is one check, not proof of sealing, retention or high-speed performance.
caption.zh: 万用表参考：导通是一项检查，不能证明密封、保持力或高速性能。

q.en: Is “Molex” enough information to identify a connector?
q.zh: 只提供“Molex”就能识别接头吗？

a.en: No. Provide the full family and part number, mating reference, cavity views and wire requirements. Similar housings can belong to different systems.
a.zh: 不能。请提供完整系列与料号、对插型号、腔位视图和导线要求。相似壳体可能属于不同系统。

q.en: Can any connector with the same pitch be substituted?
q.zh: 间距相同的连接器可以直接替换吗？

a.en: No. Pitch does not define the contact shape, housing keying, retention or electrical duty. Substitution needs a documented comparison and explicit approval.
a.zh: 不能。间距不能定义接点形状、壳体键位、保持结构和电气工况。替代需要文件比较和明确批准。

q.en: Do all configurations use genuine Molex parts?
q.zh: 所有配置都采用 Molex 原厂零件吗？

a.en: The quotation and approved BOM define component origin. Genuine specified parts and any approved alternatives are identified separately; no unstated substitution is assumed.
a.zh: 物料来源由报价与认可清单定义。指定原厂零件和认可替代物料分别列明，不默认存在未说明的替代。

q.en: What is needed for a custom cable quotation?
q.zh: 定制电缆报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send both mating references, circuit table, dimensions, wire and protection requirements, environment, quantities and required inspection or validation.
a.zh: 请提供两端对插型号、回路表、尺寸、线材与防护要求、环境、数量及所需检验或验证。

intro.en: Custom connector leads and harness assemblies defined around specified TE / AMP interfaces, terminal systems, wire, sealing and installation requirements.
intro.zh: 围绕指定 TE / AMP 接口、端子系统、线材、密封与安装要求，开发定制连接线和线束组件。

knowledge.en: A brand or housing shape is not an interchangeability specification. Confirm the complete mating system and approved bill of materials.
knowledge.zh: 品牌名称或壳体外形不是互换规格，需要确认完整对插系统及认可物料清单。

notes.en: Send full part numbers, mating drawings, cavity assignment, wire size and insulation diameter, environment, quantity and inspection requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供完整料号、对插图纸、腔位定义、线径与绝缘外径、使用环境、数量及检验要求。

delivery.en: Review parts and tooling, approve first articles, then produce against controlled drawings and the agreed inspection plan.
delivery.zh: 审核物料与工装，完成首件认可后，按受控图纸和约定检验计划生产。

faq.zh: TE / AMP 线束常见问题

subtitle.en: One brand, many interfaces — identify the complete system
subtitle.zh: 同一品牌，多种接口——识别完整连接系统

lead.en: This category covers sealed automotive pigtails, multiway equipment looms, panel connections, appliance power leads, industrial control wiring and project-specific high-voltage assemblies. Super Smile develops the cable assembly around the interface specified for your equipment; it is not one universal “AMP plug”. TE Connectivity, AMP and the product-family names on this page identify the requested interface, not an affiliation or authorization. A quotation should distinguish genuine specified components from any separately proposed alternative. Substitution requires explicit approval of the mating geometry, electrical duty and verification plan before production.
lead.zh: 本小类覆盖密封汽车尾线、多芯设备线束、面板连接、电器供电线、工业控制配线及按项目审核的高压组件。超斯迈尔围绕设备指定接口开发电缆组件，并不是提供一种通用“AMP 插头”。本页 TE Connectivity、AMP 及各系列名称用于识别所需接口，不代表品牌隶属或授权关系。报价应区分指定原厂物料与另行提出的替代方案；替代前必须明确对插几何、电气工况和验证计划，并取得认可。

openingCaption.en: An equipment wiring loom illustrates the assembly scope; the approved BOM defines the connector brand and series.
openingCaption.zh: 设备内部配线展示组件范围，实际连接器品牌与系列由认可物料清单确定。

copy.en: Start with the complete housing and mating-half part numbers, including suffixes. Then record the contact system, position count, cavity view, polarization, latch and terminal retention. A shell that slides over another shell is not proof of a sound electrical interface. Contact engagement, retention, seal compression and service access all need to work together. For repair pigtails and adapter leads, identify each end independently and keep the connection table with the drawing. This turns a visual match into a traceable specification. When the original part is unknown, provide sharp front, rear and side photographs with dimensions rather than a brand name alone.
copy.zh: 先确认壳体与对插件的完整料号，包括后缀，再记录接触件系统、位数、腔位视图、防误插结构、卡扣及端子保持方式。两个壳体能够套在一起，并不能证明电气连接可靠；接点啮合、保持力、密封压缩与检修空间需要共同满足要求。维修尾线或转接线的两端应分别识别，并把接线表纳入图纸，使外观匹配转化为可追溯规格。原型号未知时，请提供清晰的正面、背面、侧面照片与尺寸，而不只是一个品牌名称。

caption.en: AMP-marked connector detail: markings and mechanical features help identify an interface, but do not establish interchangeability.
caption.zh: 带 AMP 标识的连接器细节：标记与机械特征有助于识别，但不能单独证明可互换。

copy.en: AMP SUPERSEAL 1.5 includes one- to six-position inline configurations for compact sealed wiring. The 1.5 designation identifies the contact family; it is not the cable cross-section or a universal cavity pitch. A sealed assembly combines the correct housing, contacts, wire seals, secondary locks and any required cavity plugs. Match each seal to the specified insulation diameter, not just the copper size. The family’s stated IP67 performance relates to the defined assembly and test conditions; an open, damaged or incorrectly populated connector does not inherit it. For a waterproof harness enquiry, describe splash direction, immersion exposure, chemicals and the condition in which protection is required.
copy.zh: AMP SUPERSEAL 1.5 包含一至六位直连配置，适用于紧凑密封配线。“1.5”指接触件系列，不是导线截面积，也不是通用腔位间距。密封组件由正确的壳体、端子、线封、二次锁及必要的盲堵共同构成。线封应匹配规定绝缘外径，不能只看铜线截面积。系列标注的 IP67 性能对应限定的装配与试验条件；打开、损坏或装配错误的接头不能直接继承该等级。咨询防水线束时，还应说明飞溅方向、浸水暴露、化学介质以及需要防护的连接状态。

caption.en: Elastomer sealing detail — a material reference, not a SUPERSEAL component or an IP test result.
caption.zh: 弹性体密封细节——用于说明密封材料，不是 SUPERSEAL 零件或 IP 试验结果。

title.zh: AMPSEAL 与 AMPSEAL 16 并不相同

copy.en: AMPSEAL multiway systems and AMPSEAL 16 should not be treated as one interchangeable connector. AMPSEAL 16 provides sealed wire-to-wire and wire-to-device options, including panel installation. Its contact selection, terminal position assurance and connector position assurance must follow the specific configuration. Do not carry a temperature rating or permitted wire range from one variant to another. In a machine or off-highway harness, check whether a bulkhead flange, backshell, strain relief or service loop is required. The mating drawing should control mounting clearance as well as the connector itself, particularly where gloves, tools or nearby hoses restrict access.
copy.zh: AMPSEAL 多位系统与 AMPSEAL 16 不应被当作同一种可互换连接器。AMPSEAL 16 提供密封线对线、线对设备及面板安装等选项；接触件选择、端子位置保证结构与连接器位置保证结构，应遵循具体配置。不能把一种版本的温度等级或允许线径直接套到另一版本。机械或非道路设备线束还需确认隔板法兰、后壳、应力消除与检修余量。对插图纸除了控制接头本身，也应控制安装净空，尤其是在手套、工具或邻近软管影响操作的位置。

caption.en: Wheel-speed sensor wiring shows why routing and moving-part clearance need attention; this is not an AMPSEAL product identification.
caption.zh: 轮速传感器布线说明路线与运动部件净空的重要性，不将图中连接器认定为 AMPSEAL 产品。

copy.en: Universal MATE-N-LOK, Mini-Universal MATE-N-LOK and Micro MATE-N-LOK belong to distinct systems. Similar white housings or a matching position count are not enough to select a mate. Check the family, cavity shape, contact gender and the specified wire range. As one concrete example, TE 926869-1 is a Universal MATE-N-LOK receptacle contact with its own conductor range, material and application documents; it is not a generic terminal for every MATE-N-LOK housing. Appliance power leads and cabinet looms also need attention to loaded circuits, routing and any required panel retention. Use the exact terminal drawing and application specification when choosing crimp tooling.
copy.zh: Universal MATE-N-LOK、Mini-Universal MATE-N-LOK 与 Micro MATE-N-LOK 属于不同系统。相似的白色壳体或相同位数，不足以确定对插件，还需检查系列、腔形、接点公母和规定线径。例如 TE 926869-1 是具有独立导体范围、材料及应用文件的 Universal MATE-N-LOK 插孔端子，并不是所有 MATE-N-LOK 壳体通用的端子。电器供电线和柜内线束还需关注同时负载的回路、布线路径以及面板保持要求。压接工装应依据准确端子图纸和应用规范选择。

caption.en: AMP MATE-N-LOK and Molex .093-inch examples show why visually similar power connectors need separate identification.
caption.zh: AMP MATE-N-LOK 与 Molex .093 英寸示例，说明相似供电接头仍需分别识别。

title.en: FASTON: Width Is Only One Dimension

copy.en: FASTON quick-disconnect systems are commonly described by tab width, but tab thickness, receptacle design, material and plating are also part of the connection. Straight and flag receptacles solve different access and routing problems. A generic “6.3 mm spade” description does not identify the full interface or establish a TE origin. Record the tab drawing, wire specification, insulation support and required housing or sleeve. For appliance, relay and grounding leads, evaluate the complete assembled connection under its actual electrical and thermal duty. A loose fit should not be corrected by squeezing a receptacle by hand; it calls for the correct mating components and termination process.
copy.zh: FASTON 快接系统常用插片宽度描述，但插片厚度、插簧结构、材料和镀层同样属于连接规格。直式与旗形插簧解决的是不同操作空间和布线问题。“6.3 mm 插簧”这种泛称，既不能定义完整接口，也不能证明 TE 来源。应记录插片图纸、导线规格、绝缘支撑和所需护套。电器、继电器或接地连接应在实际电气与热工况下评价完整组件。接触松动不应通过手工挤压插簧补救，而应回到正确的配对物料与端接过程。

caption.en: Quick-disconnect terminal forms illustrate blade and receptacle geometry; the reference photo is not proof of TE manufacture.
caption.zh: 快接端子形态用于说明插片与插簧几何，参考照片不作为 TE 原厂证明。

title.en: Dynamic Series: Control Wiring by Function
title.zh: Dynamic 系列：按功能定义控制配线

copy.en: Industrial control harnesses can combine power, signal and protective connections, but their interfaces should remain clearly differentiated. In TE Dynamic Series, the selected series and keying determine the mating system. Certain D3000 configurations provide first-mate/last-break ground contacts; this is a configuration-specific feature, not a property of every Dynamic connector. Begin the harness drawing with circuit function, load and maintenance access. Separate signal identification from conductor colour, and define the point from which branch lengths are measured. A cabinet lead is easier to install and service when labels, mating references and routing instructions agree with the equipment drawing.
copy.zh: 工业控制线束可以组合供电、信号与保护连接，但接口功能需要清晰区分。TE Dynamic 系列应依据具体系列与键位确定对插系统；部分 D3000 配置提供先接后断的接地接点，这属于特定配置功能，并非所有 Dynamic 连接器均具备。线束图纸应从回路功能、负载和维护空间开始定义；不要仅靠线色识别信号，并应确定分支长度的测量基准。当标签、对插型号和布线说明与设备图纸一致时，柜内连接线才更容易装配与检修。

caption.en: Control-cabinet reference: function, labels and service access matter alongside connector selection.
caption.zh: 控制柜应用参考：除接头选型外，回路功能、标签与维护空间同样重要。

title.en: AMP+ HVA: A Separate High-Voltage Review
title.zh: AMP+ HVA：高压项目单独审核

copy.en: AMP+ HVA 280 is a high-voltage interface family with shielding and high-voltage interlock options. The interlock circuit is a system function; it should not be bridged or omitted to make a cable appear operational. Connector configuration, validated cable, shield termination, keying and mating device must be reviewed together. An orange housing alone does not define voltage capability or prove that an assembly is safe. Before quotation, establish the insulation coordination, mechanical route, approved components and required verification with the equipment owner. High-voltage production or testing requires suitable procedures and competent personnel; inclusion in this category is an invitation to engineering review, not a blanket qualification claim.
copy.zh: AMP+ HVA 280 是包含屏蔽与高压互锁选项的高压接口系列。互锁回路属于系统功能，不能为了让电缆看似可以工作而短接或省略。连接器配置、经过认可的线缆、屏蔽端接、键位和对插设备必须一起审核。橙色壳体本身不能定义耐压能力，也不能证明组件安全。报价前应与设备方明确绝缘配合、机械路线、认可物料及所需验证。高压生产或试验需要适当程序与具备能力的人员；将其列入本小类，是接受工程审核，不是宣称已具备所有项目资格。

caption.en: Electric-vehicle charging context illustrates the high-voltage application domain, not an HVA connector or an approved harness.
caption.zh: 电动车充电场景用于说明高压应用领域，并非 HVA 接头或已认可线束实物。

title.en: Materials: Contact, Wire and Insulation Together
title.zh: 用料建议：接点、导线与绝缘一起匹配

copy.en: A connector BOM extends beyond the visible housing. It can include conductor and insulation variants, contact plating, cable seals, cavity plugs, backshells, sleeving and identification. Select a terminal for both the conductor range and the insulation support it was designed to crimp. Preserve the contact material and plating specified for the mating pair; an attractive finish is not an electrical specification. For a proposed alternative, compare the relevant drawings and application documents, then define the checks needed for approval. The harness drawing should also state strip length, branch dimensions, protection transitions and any controlled material substitutions so that a repeat order remains the same engineering configuration.
copy.zh: 连接器物料清单不只包含可见壳体，还可能涉及导体与绝缘版本、接点镀层、线封、盲堵、后壳、套管及标识。端子应同时匹配导体范围及其压接结构所支持的绝缘尺寸。对插系统指定的接点材料与镀层应保持一致；表面漂亮不是电气规格。提出替代时，应比较相关图纸与应用文件，再确定认可所需检查。线束图还应标明剥线长度、分支尺寸、防护过渡和受控材料替代，使重复订单保持相同工程配置。

caption.en: Open-barrel terminal detail illustrates conductor and insulation crimp zones; it is a construction reference, not a specified TE part.
caption.zh: 开口端子细节用于说明导体与绝缘压接区域，不代表已指定的 TE 料号。

copy.en: The working sequence is part identification, BOM and drawing review, tooling confirmation, wire preparation, termination, contact insertion, secondary-lock assembly and final verification. Crimp setup follows the terminal application specification rather than a general plier setting. First-article review should reconcile cavity numbering, contact seating, seals, dimensions and the actual test map. Continuity can reveal open or incorrect circuits, but does not by itself demonstrate sealing, retention or environmental durability. Additional mechanical, electrical or environmental checks need defined acceptance criteria and an agreed scope. Keep approved samples and controlled records so that changes in materials or tooling are reviewed instead of silently entering later batches.
copy.zh: 基本过程包括物料识别、清单与图纸审核、工装确认、线材准备、端接、端子入壳、二次锁装配及最终验证。压接设置应依据端子应用规范，而不是采用通用钳口设置。首件审核需核对腔位编号、端子就位、密封件、尺寸及实际测试网络。导通可以发现断路或错接，但不能单独证明密封、保持力或环境耐久性。额外机械、电气或环境检查，应有明确接收准则和约定范围。保存认可样件及受控记录，使物料或工装变化经过审核，而不是悄悄进入后续批次。

caption.en: Indent-crimp tooling reference. Actual tooling must match the specified terminal; this tool is not prescribed for every TE / AMP series.
caption.zh: 压痕式压接工具参考。实际工装须匹配指定端子，本图工具并非所有 TE / AMP 系列的通用工装。

title.en: Automotive Applications: Exposure Changes the Brief
title.zh: 汽车应用：环境改变选型条件

copy.en: Engine-bay connections, chassis sensors, exterior lighting and cabin equipment face different combinations of water, heat, vibration and service handling. A lighting pigtail near a wet body panel may need a different seal and protection arrangement from a dry interior control lead. Document mounting location, connector orientation, drainage, harness support and likely chemical exposure. The goal is to select the right interface and protection for that location, not to apply the strongest-sounding material everywhere. A TE / AMP-based harness can connect several different families in one assembly when the equipment requires it; each end still needs its own documented mating reference and circuit definition.
copy.zh: 发动机舱连接、底盘传感器、外部照明与座舱设备面对的水、热、振动及维修操作组合各不相同。位于潮湿车身面板附近的灯具尾线，可能需要不同于干燥内饰控制线的密封与防护安排。应记录安装位置、接头朝向、排水、线束支撑及可能接触的化学介质。目标是按位置选择适当接口和防护，而不是处处使用听起来最强的材料。一条基于 TE / AMP 接口的线束可以按设备需要组合多个系列，但每个端部仍需独立的对插型号与回路定义。

caption.en: Rain around vehicle lighting illustrates environmental exposure, not a connector waterproof test.
caption.zh: 车辆照明周围的雨水用于说明环境暴露，不是连接器防水试验。

title.en: Lead Time: Begin with a Complete BOM
title.zh: 交期：从完整物料清单开始

copy.en: An assembly schedule depends on the slowest approved input, not only the time required to cut and crimp wire. Check housing colour and key, contact plating, loose-piece or reel packaging, seals, special cable and tooling before agreeing a delivery date. A prototype using available components is not necessarily evidence that the same production BOM can be replenished at volume. Super Smile can review the requested quantity, sample milestones and material options with you; a confirmed quotation records the actual sourcing and approval assumptions. If an alternative becomes necessary, treat it as a controlled change with written approval rather than replacing a part solely to preserve a promised date.
copy.zh: 组件交期取决于最慢到位的已认可条件，而不只是裁线与压接用时。约定交付日期前，应检查壳体颜色与键位、接点镀层、散件或卷盘包装、密封件、特殊线材及工装。使用现有物料做出样件，不代表相同量产清单一定能够批量补货。超斯迈尔可与你一起审核数量、样品节点与物料选项，并在确认报价中记录实际采购与认可前提。确需替代时，应作为受控变更取得书面批准，不能仅为维持承诺日期而自行更换零件。

caption.en: Automated small-parts storage illustrates material availability and picking, not Super Smile inventory.
caption.zh: 小件自动存储场景用于说明备料与拣选，不代表超斯迈尔库存。

title.en: Pricing: Define the Assembly, Not Just the Plug
title.zh: 价格：报价对象是组件，不只是插头

copy.en: A meaningful quotation separates recurring assembly cost from one-time development or tooling work. Recurring drivers include contact count, wire lengths, branch complexity, protection, labels, approved component sources, testing and packaging. One-time work may include drawing development, application tooling, test fixtures and first-article documentation. Part-number suffixes and plating choices can change the BOM even when the photograph looks identical. Send the mating references, pin table, dimensions, annual or batch quantity and delivery plan to obtain a comparable offer. We do not publish a universal TE / AMP harness price because it would hide the engineering differences between a short repair lead and a fully documented equipment loom.
copy.zh: 有意义的报价应区分重复发生的组件成本与一次性开发、工装费用。重复成本包含接点数量、线长、分支复杂度、防护、标签、认可物料来源、测试和包装；一次性工作可能包含图纸开发、应用工装、测试治具及首件文件。即使照片相同，料号后缀与镀层选择也可能改变清单。请发送对插型号、针脚表、尺寸、年度或批次数量及交付安排，以便获得可比较的报价。我们不设置一个通用 TE / AMP 线束价格，因为短维修连接线与具有完整文件的设备线束，工程内容并不相同。

caption.en: Quotation planning: material, assembly, tooling and verification costs should be defined separately.
caption.zh: 报价规划：物料、装配、工装与验证费用应分别定义。

q.en: Does “TE / AMP compatible” mean every component is made by TE?
q.zh: “TE / AMP 兼容”是否表示所有物料都是 TE 原厂？

a.en: No. The quotation and approved BOM must state genuine specified parts and any separately approved alternatives. The category name identifies the interface requirement, not brand authorization or an unstated component origin.
a.zh: 不是。报价与认可清单必须列明指定原厂零件和另行认可的替代物料。小类名称识别接口要求，不表示品牌授权，也不能代替物料来源说明。

q.en: Can a matching housing colour prove the connector will mate?
q.zh: 壳体颜色相同，是否就能对插？

a.en: No. Compare full part numbers, family, keying, contact system and mating drawings. Colour may form part of a coding system, but is not sufficient identification by itself.
a.zh: 不能。需比较完整料号、系列、键位、接触件系统和对插图纸。颜色可能属于编码的一部分，但本身不足以完成识别。

q.en: Can you develop an assembly from a sample?
q.zh: 可以根据样品开发组件吗？

a.en: An authorized sample can support dimensional and mechanical review. Circuit functions, material requirements, mating references and acceptance criteria still need confirmation before production.
a.zh: 获准使用的样品可辅助尺寸与机械审核，但回路功能、材料要求、对插型号和接收准则仍需在生产前确认。

q.en: Does an IP-rated connector make the entire harness waterproof?
q.zh: 有 IP 等级的接头，是否代表整条线束防水？

a.en: No. The rating applies to a defined configuration and test condition. Other joints, cable entries, unused cavities and installation details require their own assessment.
a.zh: 不代表。等级针对限定配置与试验条件；其他接头、线缆入口、空腔和安装细节仍需分别评价。

intro.en: Turbo actuator connector leads, repair pigtails and custom engine-side harnesses, defined by the exact actuator interface, circuit, materials and installation route.
intro.zh: 涡轮执行器连接线、维修尾线与定制发动机侧线束，依据准确的执行器接口、回路、材料和安装路线开发。

knowledge.en: The harness carries the specified power and signal paths. It does not replace actuator electronics, turbocharger diagnosis or model-specific calibration.
knowledge.zh: 线束承载规定的供电与信号路径，不能替代执行器电子系统、增压器诊断或具体型号的标定。

notes.en: Provide actuator and turbocharger part numbers, connector views, circuit definition, cable length, routing environment and quantity.
notes.zh: 请提供执行器与增压器料号、接口照片、回路定义、线长、布线环境及数量。

delivery.en: Confirm mating components and wiring, approve the sample, then release controlled production and agreed inspection records.
delivery.zh: 确认对插件及接线，完成样件认可后，按受控文件生产并提交约定检验记录。

faq.zh: 涡轮执行器线束常见问题

subtitle.en: A small connection with a specific engineering job
subtitle.zh: 小型连接，明确的工程职责

lead.en: A turbo actuator harness is the electrical connection around an actuator, not a complete turbocharger or a universal replacement actuator. The category includes short connector leads, repair pigtails, engine-side extensions, defined adapter assemblies and workshop test connections. A VGT or VNT application may share the same broad description while using a different housing, circuit assignment or control interface. Super Smile can develop these configurations from a drawing, authorized sample or confirmed mating parts. Our product photographs show connector-lead examples; the approved specification determines the version supplied. Correct identification keeps a small replacement part from becoming a larger installation problem.
lead.zh: 涡轮执行器线束是执行器周围的电气连接，并不是整台涡轮增压器，也不是通用替换执行器。本小类包含短连接线、维修尾线、发动机侧延长线、已定义转接组件与维修测试连接。VGT 或 VNT 应用可能使用相近名称，却采用不同壳体、回路分配或控制接口。超斯迈尔可依据图纸、获准使用的样品或已确认对插件开发这些结构。页面实物照片展示连接线示例，实际供货版本由已认可规格确定。准确识别，可以避免一件小型更换件引发更大的安装问题。

openingCaption.en: Super Smile actuator connector-lead examples; supplied configuration follows the approved drawing.
openingCaption.zh: 超斯迈尔执行器连接线实物示例，供货配置以认可图纸为准。

title.en: Product Advantages: A Defined Actuator-Side Interface
title.zh: 产品优势：明确执行器侧接口

copy.en: A purpose-made connector lead can preserve the existing equipment interface while placing the joint and service length where they are accessible. Check housing keying, cavity count, contact gender, latch geometry and the position of any secondary lock. Holset VGT, Garrett VNT and HELLA actuator names help identify an application family, but are not an interchangeable connector specification. Even within one turbocharger family, actuator revisions can change the required connection. Record the actual part number and both mating faces. The result is a controlled assembly, not a guess based on a similar black plug or a familiar engine name.
copy.zh: 专门定义的连接线可以保留设备原有接口，同时把连接位置与检修长度安排在便于操作的地方。需要检查壳体键位、腔数、接点公母、卡扣几何和二次锁位置。Holset VGT、Garrett VNT 与 HELLA 执行器等名称有助于识别应用系列，但不是可互换的接头规格。同一增压器系列中的执行器版本变化，也可能改变连接要求。应记录实际料号与两端对插界面，形成受控组件，而不是根据相似黑色插头或熟悉的发动机名称猜测。

caption.en: Super Smile connector-lead detail; exact mating geometry is defined by the approved part.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔连接线接口细节，准确对插几何以认可零件为准。

title.en: Pin Definition: Cavity Numbers Before Wire Colors
title.zh: 针脚定义：先看腔位，再看线色

copy.en: A pin table should state the connector view, cavity number, circuit function, conductor size and destination. Mating-face and wire-entry views can mirror one another, so a clear view arrow is as important as the numbers. Colors help production and service teams trace a released design; they do not establish a universal power or signal assignment. A sample can be mapped for continuity, but hidden electronics or an unknown interface still need equipment documentation. Do not energize an unidentified connector to discover its pinout. Controlled labeling and an independent circuit check reduce reversed connections before a sample reaches the actuator.
copy.zh: 针脚表应写明观察方向、腔位编号、回路功能、导体规格和目标端。对插面与进线面可能呈镜像，因此清晰的视向标记和编号同样重要。线色帮助生产与维修人员追踪已放行设计，并不能定义通用电源或信号分配。可以对样品测绘导通关系，但隐藏电子元件或未知接口仍需设备文件确认。不能通过给未知接头通电来试探针脚。受控标识与独立回路复核，有助于在样件接入执行器之前减少反接问题。

caption.en: Our sample lead exposes the conductor path; colors alone do not define cavity functions.
caption.zh: 本公司样品展示导体路径，线色本身不定义腔位功能。

copy.en: Select conductor cross-section for load, permissible voltage drop, length, ambient heat and the terminal's supported wire range. Insulation outside diameter also has to suit the wire seal and crimp support. Thin-wall automotive cable, cross-linked insulation and fluoropolymer options address different packaging or temperature needs; their names alone do not define a finished harness rating. ISO 19642 and SAE J1128 are relevant automotive-cable reference families when called up by the project. Specify the applicable part and revision rather than printing a standard number as an unverified certification. Sample approval should confirm the selected wire construction, not only its external color.
copy.zh: 导体截面积需要结合负载、允许压降、长度、环境温度及端子支持的线径范围选择。绝缘外径还必须适配线封与压接支撑。薄壁汽车线、交联绝缘和氟聚合物等选项满足不同的空间或温度需求，但名称本身不能定义成品线束等级。项目适用时，可采用 ISO 19642、SAE J1128 等汽车电缆标准系列作为参考。应写明适用部分和版本，而不是把标准编号当作未经验证的认证印在页面上。样件认可需确认线材结构，不能只确认外部颜色。

caption.en: Our lead construction shows separate insulated conductors and outer protection.
caption.zh: 本公司连接线结构展示独立绝缘导体与外层防护。

title.en: Automotive Connectors, Seals and Polymer Components
title.zh: 汽车连接器、密封与聚合物零件

copy.en: A sealed connection depends on a compatible housing, contacts, wire seals, cavity plugs and mating component. A cable that is too small can leave a leakage path; one that is too large can distort the seal or prevent correct assembly. The latch and secondary retention must remain operable after sleeving or molding. Resin selection affects heat behavior, chemical exposure and mechanical recovery, while seal material has its own limits. Define environmental performance for the complete mated assembly and the intended installation. Water resistance should not be inferred from a white sealing ring, a thick boot or the appearance of a sample photograph.
copy.zh: 密封连接依赖兼容的壳体、接点、线封、空腔堵头与对插件。线缆过细可能留下泄漏路径，过粗则可能使密封变形或妨碍正确装配。加套管或成型后，卡扣与二次保持结构仍需正常操作。树脂选择影响受热、化学暴露和机械回弹，密封材料也有自己的限制。环境性能应针对完整对插组件及实际安装位置规定，不能仅凭白色密封圈、较厚护套或样品照片的外观推断防水能力。

caption.en: Our connector-lead examples; sealing performance requires the complete specified assembly.
caption.zh: 本公司连接线实物示例，密封性能需针对完整指定组件验证。

copy.en: Turbocharger surroundings combine radiant heat, hot surfaces, vibration and possible oil contamination. Routing distance and a supported path come before adding more sleeve. Corrugated conduit mainly organizes and protects the bundle; a split tube is not automatically a water seal or a thermal barrier. Heat-shrink elastomers, glass-fiber sleeves and reflective protection have different duties. Raychem DR-25 is a fluid-resistant harnessing-tubing reference, not a universal solution for contact with a hot turbine housing. Review the temperature limits of the weakest component, clearance throughout engine movement, and the sleeve ends where heat or abrasion may concentrate.
copy.zh: 增压器周围同时存在辐射热、热表面、振动和可能的油污。布线距离与有支撑的路径，应先于继续叠加套管考虑。波纹管主要整理和防护线束，开口管不自动构成水密封或隔热屏障。热缩弹性体、玻纤套管与反射防护承担不同职责。Raychem DR-25 可作为耐流体线束套管参考，但不是能直接接触高温涡轮壳体的通用方案。需要审核最弱元件的温度限制、发动机运动全程的间隙，以及热或磨损可能集中的套管端部。

caption.en: A displayed turbocharged engine illustrates the proximity of exhaust hardware and heat protection.
caption.zh: 展出的增压发动机说明排气部件与热防护的空间关系。

title.en: Our Solution: Pigtails, Extensions and Defined Adapters
title.zh: 解决方案：尾线、延长与已定义转接

copy.en: A repair pigtail replaces a defined damaged connector section; an extension changes reach; an adapter changes a documented physical interface. These are different products and need different drawings. Keep repair joints away from the highest-strain location and follow the equipment maker's approved repair method. An adapter does not turn a 12-volt actuator into a 24-volt unit or translate one communication protocol into another. For workshop leads, identify the test equipment and permitted operating conditions. Prototype and small-batch requests can begin with an authorized sample, but production release still requires an agreed circuit, length, material list and inspection scope.
copy.zh: 维修尾线用于替换已定义的受损接口段，延长线改变可达距离，转接线改变已记录的物理接口。这些是不同产品，需要不同图纸。维修连接应避开最大受力位置，并遵循设备制造商认可的维修方法。转接线不会把 12 V 执行器变成 24 V 设备，也不会把一种通信协议转换成另一种。维修测试线还需明确测试设备与允许工作条件。样件和小批量需求可以从获准使用的样品开始，但生产放行仍需约定回路、长度、物料及检验范围。

caption.en: Super Smile connector-lead variants, with length and circuit defined for each request.
caption.zh: 超斯迈尔连接线结构示例，每项需求分别定义长度与回路。

title.en: Control Signals: CAN, PWM and Position Feedback
title.zh: 控制信号：CAN、PWM 与位置反馈

copy.en: Electronic actuator designs may use CAN, PWM, SENT or an analog interface, depending on the device architecture. These labels do not assign pins by themselves. Preserve the required pair arrangement, return path and shielding treatment shown in the equipment specification. Separate actuator supply requirements from low-level feedback requirements. A passive harness cannot implement a control algorithm or make a mismatched actuator compatible. On CAN-equipped systems, branch length and termination belong to the complete network design; adding a resistor to a replacement lead without the circuit definition can alter that network. Review the full connection before defining a test fixture or replacement branch.
copy.zh: 电子执行器可能采用 CAN、PWM、SENT 或模拟接口，具体取决于设备架构。这些名称本身并不分配针脚，应保持设备规格要求的线对排列、回流路径与屏蔽处理。执行器供电要求需要和低电平反馈要求分开。无源线束不能实现控制算法，也不能让不匹配的执行器变得兼容。采用 CAN 的系统中，分支长度和终端属于完整网络设计；没有回路定义就给替换线加入电阻，可能改变整个网络。定义测试夹具或替换分支之前，应审核完整连接。

caption.en: Reference waveforms illustrate distinct signal shapes, not a valid actuator test trace.
caption.zh: 参考波形说明不同信号形态，不是有效执行器测试记录。

title.en: Industries and Applications: Engines, Fleets and Equipment
title.zh: 行业与应用：发动机、车队与设备

copy.en: Applications include passenger-car turbo systems, commercial diesel engines, off-highway equipment and engine service facilities. An engine installed in a truck and a related engine used in a generator may have different harness routing, connectors or control revisions. Organize an enquiry by equipment model, engine serial or application reference, turbocharger number and actuator number. This makes supplier review more useful than a list of vehicle brands. For marine or other special environments, define the additional materials and validation requirements rather than assuming an automotive lead is suitable. The connection can be customized; the application boundary must remain explicit.
copy.zh: 应用包括乘用车增压系统、商用柴油机、非道路设备和发动机维修场所。装在卡车上的发动机与用于发电机组的相关机型，可能采用不同路线、接头或控制版本。询价时按设备型号、发动机序列号或应用参考、增压器料号和执行器料号整理资料，比单纯罗列汽车品牌更有利于供应商审核。船用等特殊环境还需规定额外材料与验证要求，不能默认汽车连接线即可适用。连接结构可以定制，但应用边界必须明确。

caption.en: A diesel rail-engine turbocharger illustrates application diversity, not a claimed actuator fitment.
caption.zh: 柴油轨道发动机增压器说明应用差异，不据此声明执行器适配。

title.en: Design and Quality: Wiring Is Not Actuator Calibration
title.zh: 设计与质量：接线不等于执行器标定

copy.en: Harness checks and actuator calibration answer different questions. The first establishes the electrical path; the second relates the actuator to the turbocharger and its control system. Cummins describes the Holset E-Tool as a diagnostic and installation/calibration tool for compatible electric actuators. Garrett also warns against changing turbo settings outside the prescribed procedure. A replacement connector lead therefore should not be advertised as eliminating calibration or correcting every boost-control fault. Confirm wiring condition, the correct component combination and the manufacturer's service procedure. Mechanical restriction or an actuator fault remains possible even when the harness passes continuity checks.
copy.zh: 线束检查与执行器标定回答的是不同问题：前者确认电气路径，后者涉及执行器与增压器及控制系统的匹配。Cummins 将 Holset E-Tool 描述为适用于相应电子执行器的诊断与安装、标定工具；Garrett 也提示不要在规定程序之外改变增压器设置。因此，替换连接线不能宣传为免除标定，也不能承诺修复所有增压控制故障。需确认接线状态、正确元件组合与制造商维修程序。即使线束导通合格，机械卡滞或执行器故障仍可能存在。

caption.en: A turbocharger and actuator assembly illustrates why mechanical and electrical matching must be considered together.
caption.zh: 增压器与执行器总成说明机械、电气匹配需要一起考虑。

copy.en: The production record starts with the approved interface drawing and bill of materials. Cutting and stripping establish the wire length without damaged strands; terminal crimping uses the contact maker's specified wire range and tooling. Insertion, retention checks, seals, sleeves and labels follow a defined sequence so that protection does not hide an incomplete assembly. A first article confirms dimensions and circuit mapping before repeat production. Any substitute wire, terminal, seal or housing requires review against the released design. Photographs and inspection records support traceability, while packaging protects the contacts, latch and cable exit from transport damage.
copy.zh: 生产记录从已认可接口图和物料表开始。下线、剥线需形成规定长度并避免损伤线股；端子压接依据接点制造商规定的线径范围与工装进行。插入、保持检查、密封、套管和标识按明确顺序完成，避免防护层遮住尚未完成的装配。首件先确认尺寸与回路映射，再进入重复生产。替代线材、端子、密封或壳体，均需对照已放行设计审核。照片和检验记录支持追溯，包装则保护接点、卡扣和出线位置免受运输损伤。

caption.en: A hand crimp tool illustrates termination work; actual tooling follows the specified contact system.
caption.zh: 手动压接工具说明端接工艺，实际工装依据指定接点系统选择。

copy.en: Continuity and short-circuit checks confirm the passive wiring map, but a low-current meter check does not prove the connection will behave correctly under load. Where required, specify contact resistance or voltage-drop verification with suitable fixtures and agreed limits. Mechanical retention, dimensions and visual condition are separate checks; environmental tests require a defined method and sample state. Diagnostic work on an installed vehicle must follow its service instructions, using appropriate probes that do not spread contacts or damage seals. Keep actual measured results distinct from planned tests. A reported fault should be linked to evidence, not automatically attributed to the harness or actuator.
copy.zh: 导通与短路检查确认无源接线映射，但小电流仪表检查不能证明连接在负载下始终正常。需要时应规定接触电阻或压降验证，并采用合适夹具与约定限值。机械保持、尺寸和外观属于其他检查；环境试验还需明确方法与样件状态。车辆上的诊断工作必须遵循维修说明，使用不会撑大接点或损伤密封的合适探针。实际测量结果应和计划试验分开，故障判断需关联证据，不能自动归因于线束或执行器。

caption.en: A test probe illustrates the measurement interface; probing must not damage contacts or seals.
caption.zh: 测试探针说明测量接口，探测操作不能损伤接点或密封。

q.en: Can the same harness fit every VGT or VNT actuator?
q.zh: 同一线束能适配所有 VGT 或 VNT 执行器吗？

a.en: No. Match the exact actuator, mating connector, circuit assignment and installation. A family name or similar housing is only a starting point.
a.zh: 不能。需要匹配准确执行器、对插件、回路分配和安装条件，系列名称或相似壳体只是识别起点。

q.en: Does replacing the lead remove the need for calibration?
q.zh: 更换连接线就不需要标定了吗？

a.en: No such assumption should be made. Wiring repair and actuator calibration are different operations; follow the equipment-specific service procedure.
a.zh: 不能这样推断。接线维修与执行器标定是不同操作，应遵循具体设备的维修程序。

q.en: Can you make a cable from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以按现有样品制作连接线吗？

a.en: Yes, subject to authorization and confirmation of the interfaces, circuit, materials, dimensions and inspection requirements. Unknown pin functions need documentation.
a.zh: 可以，但需具备使用授权，并确认接口、回路、材料、尺寸和检验要求。未知针脚功能仍需文件依据。

q.en: What helps obtain an accurate quotation?
q.zh: 哪些资料有助于准确报价？

a.en: Send the actuator and turbocharger references, both connector views, pin table, length, quantity, installation conditions and any required test specification.
a.zh: 请发送执行器与增压器型号、两端接口照片、针脚表、长度、数量、安装条件及所需试验规格。

intro.en: Custom automotive antenna, camera and display interconnects, with FAKRA coaxial and HSD differential paths specified separately for the actual equipment.
intro.zh: 面向车载天线、摄像头与显示设备定制连接组件，依据实际设备分别定义 FAKRA 同轴路径与 HSD 差分路径。

knowledge.en: Connector family, signaling method and cable impedance describe different parts of the link. A keyed housing is not proof of electrical compatibility.
knowledge.zh: 连接器系列、信号方式与线缆阻抗描述链路的不同部分，带防错键的壳体不等于电气兼容证明。

notes.en: Provide exact connector codes, cable specification, channel requirements, serializer/deserializer references and any power-over-coax conditions.
notes.zh: 请提供准确接头编码、线缆规格、通道要求、串行器与解串器型号，以及可能存在的同轴供电条件。

delivery.en: Confirm the complete channel, assembly geometry, sample checks and agreed RF or differential measurements before release.
delivery.zh: 放行前确认完整通道、装配形状、样件检查及约定的射频或差分测量。

subtitle.en: Identify the interface before defining the channel
subtitle.zh: 先识别接口，再定义通道

lead.en: This category covers several automotive signal paths: coaxial antenna extensions, camera links, display connections and equipment adapters. Conventional FAKRA is a keyed coaxial connector system, normally used in a 50-ohm channel. HSD is a different, shielded differential interconnect system commonly associated with 100-ohm channels. LVDS describes an electrical signaling method, not a connector shape. A product called an automotive LVDS cable therefore needs an actual interface drawing and equipment reference. Super Smile develops the cable assembly around those requirements; similar colors or housings alone cannot establish compatibility between a camera, head unit and display.
lead.zh: 本小类包含多种车载信号路径：同轴天线延长、摄像头连接、显示连接与设备转接。常规 FAKRA 是带防错键的同轴连接器体系，通常用于 50 Ω 通道；HSD 则是不同的屏蔽差分连接体系，常与 100 Ω 通道对应。LVDS 描述电气信号方式，并不是某种接头外形。因此，被称为车载 LVDS 线的产品仍需要实际接口图与设备型号。超斯迈尔围绕这些要求开发连接组件，仅凭相近线色或壳体外观，不能确认摄像头、主机与显示屏之间的兼容关系。

openingCaption.en: A tailgate camera is one application; its actual interface and protocol still need verification.
openingCaption.zh: 尾门摄像头是应用之一，实际接口与协议仍需核对。

title.en: Product Advantages: Click-In Fit and Mechanical Coding
title.zh: 产品优势：锁止配合与机械编码

copy.en: FAKRA combines a coaxial contact interface with a keyed plastic housing and latch. The code and the corresponding mating part belong on the drawing alongside cable length and exit direction. Color is a useful assembly aid, but it should not replace the part number or a check of the mechanical key. Straight, right-angle, sealed and unsealed versions solve different packaging problems. A positive latch does not remove the need for cable support, and service procedures must respect the permitted mating cycles. For adaptations between equipment generations, verify both sides rather than selecting a connector solely because it clicks into place.
copy.zh: FAKRA 将同轴接触界面与带键位、卡扣的塑料壳体结合。编码及对应对插件应和线长、出线方向一起标注在图纸中。颜色有助于装配识别，但不能替代料号和机械键位检查。直头、弯头、密封与非密封版本解决不同的安装问题。可靠锁止不能免除线缆支撑，维修还应遵守允许的插拔次数。连接不同代际设备时需要核对两端条件，不能只因为插入后能卡住，就认定连接器选对了。

caption.en: AI illustration of keyed coaxial housings; not a dimensional or mating reference.
caption.zh: 带键位同轴壳体的 AI 示意，不作为尺寸或对插依据。

title.en: Material Recommendation: Electronic Wire and RF Coax
title.zh: 材料建议：电子线与射频同轴线

copy.en: The center conductor, dielectric and outer conductor define a coaxial transmission structure; the jacket adds environmental and mechanical protection. RG174, RG178 and RG316 are familiar small-cable references, not identical substitutes. Their materials, diameter, flexibility and attenuation differ. Select a cable approved for the chosen contact and ferrule dimensions, then review loss across the required band and installed length. A thick jacket does not prove a low-loss channel. Separate power wires are selected for their load and environment, while coax carrying power needs explicit current and bias-network review. Do not merge these requirements under one generic wire-gauge label.
copy.zh: 中心导体、介质与外导体构成同轴传输结构，护套再提供环境和机械防护。RG174、RG178、RG316 是常见的小型线缆参考，不是完全相同的替代品，其材料、直径、柔性与衰减不同。应选用适配目标接点和压接套尺寸的线材，再审核所需频段及安装长度上的损耗。护套厚并不能证明通道低损耗。独立电源线依据负载与环境选型，而经同轴传送电源则需要明确电流与偏置网络审核，不能将这些要求合并成一个通用线规标签。

caption.en: A 3C-2V cross-section illustrates concentric layers, not a recommended 50-ohm automotive cable.
caption.zh: 3C-2V 截面用于说明同心层结构，不代表推荐采用该线材作为 50 Ω 车载线。

title.en: FAKRA Connector: Contact, Housing and Shield Transition
title.zh: FAKRA 连接器：接点、壳体与屏蔽过渡

copy.en: The full connector set includes more than the colored shell. Inner contact, dielectric support, outer contact, crimp sleeve, housing and any seal must belong to a compatible system. The transition should preserve the intended geometry with controlled strip lengths and no loose shield strands near the center conductor. TE FAKRA, Rosenberger FAKRA and Amphenol RF FAKRA are reference product families; exact parts and tooling still require review. Between-series adapters add another interface and its loss. A connector's published frequency capability is not automatically the bandwidth of an arbitrary finished cable, especially after additional adapters, bends or damaged terminations.
copy.zh: 完整接头不仅是彩色外壳，还包括内接点、介质支撑、外接点、压接套、壳体及适用密封件，这些元件必须属于兼容系统。过渡位置需要受控剥线长度与几何形状，避免屏蔽散股靠近中心导体。TE FAKRA、Rosenberger FAKRA 与 Amphenol RF FAKRA 可作为产品系列参考，具体零件和工装仍需审核。跨系列转接会增加新的界面及其损耗。连接器公开的频率能力不会自动成为任意成品线缆的带宽，尤其在增加转接、弯折或端接受损之后。

caption.en: Bare SMB interfaces show a coaxial contact arrangement, without FAKRA coding housings.
caption.zh: 裸 SMB 接口说明同轴接触排列，图中并无 FAKRA 编码壳体。

copy.en: Housing stiffness, latch recovery and seal retention depend on the specified polymer and component design. A resin name alone does not establish oil resistance, flame behavior or temperature capability. Heat shrink can support a local transition or label area, but it should not obstruct latch operation or force a tight bend at the connector. Adhesive-lined tubing requires compatible surfaces and dimensions; adding it does not certify the whole assembly as waterproof. Define the mated state, cable entry and environmental test conditions. For cabin links, packaging and service access may matter more than adding unnecessary bulk around an already protected connector.
copy.zh: 壳体刚性、卡扣回弹与密封保持取决于指定聚合物和零件设计，单凭树脂名称无法证明耐油、阻燃或温度能力。热缩材料可辅助局部过渡或标识区域，但不能挡住卡扣，也不能迫使线缆在接头根部急弯。带胶热缩管需要适配的表面与尺寸，加上一段热缩并不等于整套组件已经防水。应规定对插状态、线缆入口和环境试验条件。车内连接有时更应关注空间与维修可达性，而不是在已受保护的接头外继续增加体积。

caption.en: Uncolored resin granules: material identity and validated properties must be specified separately.
caption.zh: 未着色树脂颗粒；材料牌号与经验证性能需要另行规定。

title.zh: 解决方案：Mini-FAKRA 与多端口模块

copy.en: Multiple coaxial channels can be grouped into a compact connector block to reduce the number of separate housings and organize camera or antenna routes. Rosenberger HFM is one example of a miniaturized 50-ohm system. Mini-FAKRA is not a promise that every supplier's compact connector will mate with every other one. Specify family, cavity assignment, keying, cable references and any connector-position assurance. A four-channel block contains four defined paths; it is not an RF splitter that combines or duplicates one signal. Channel identification and branch lengths remain important when the bundle separates near individual cameras or sensors.
copy.zh: 多个同轴通道可集中到紧凑接头模块中，减少独立壳体并整理摄像头或天线路线。Rosenberger HFM 是小型化 50 Ω 系统的一个例子。Mini-FAKRA 这一名称不保证不同供应商的紧凑接头都能互插。应明确系列、腔位分配、键位、线材及连接位置保证功能。四通道模块包含四条已定义路径，并不是将一路信号合并或复制的射频分配器。当线束在不同摄像头或传感器附近分开时，通道标识与分支长度仍然重要。

caption.en: A parking-camera display illustrates a camera channel; the pictured vehicle does not establish a Mini-FAKRA fitment.
caption.zh: 泊车显示说明摄像头通道的用途，不据此认定图示车辆采用 Mini-FAKRA。

title.zh: FAKRA 转 SMB / SMA 转接组件

copy.en: An adapter cable can connect a vehicle-side interface to receiver hardware or a measurement fixture, provided both electrical and mechanical requirements are known. Specify connector gender by the actual contact interface, not only the outer nut or housing. SMA and reverse-polarity SMA need particular care because appearance can mislead. A coding option intended for flexible test use should not erase production identification rules. Keep adapters short enough for the channel budget but long enough to prevent strain. The assembly changes the physical interface; it does not convert a radio frequency, video format or camera protocol into another standard.
copy.zh: 转接线可以把车辆侧接口连接到接收硬件或测量夹具，前提是电气和机械条件都明确。接头公母应根据实际接触界面定义，不能只看外部螺帽或壳体。SMA 与反极性 SMA 尤其容易因外观判断错误。面向灵活测试使用的编码选项，不应消除生产中的识别规则。转接线既要满足通道预算，也要留出避免受力所需的长度。这类组件改变物理接口，不会将一种射频、视频格式或摄像头协议自动转换成另一种标准。

caption.en: An SMA cable termination: verify the center contact as well as the outer coupling.
caption.zh: SMA 线缆端接：除外部连接结构外，还需核对中心接点。

title.en: LVDS and HSD: A Separate Differential Path
title.zh: LVDS 与 HSD：独立的差分路径

copy.en: HSD systems use paired or star-quad conductors rather than a single coaxial center contact. The common RosenbergerHSD architecture is a shielded 100-ohm differential interconnect, with several power-contact and pair variants. Preserve pair assignment and polarity through the entire assembly; untwist, skew and an uncontrolled shield transition can affect the channel. LVDS, USB, Ethernet and automotive serialized-video interfaces have different electrical requirements even if related connector families appear in their installations. Obtain the equipment's interface specification before assigning pins. A FAKRA coax lead cannot become an HSD differential cable through a passive change of colored housing.
copy.zh: HSD 系统采用成对或星绞导体，而不是单一同轴中心接点。常见 RosenbergerHSD 架构是屏蔽的 100 Ω 差分连接，另有不同电源接点和线对变型。完整组件需要保持线对分配与极性，解绞、偏斜和失控的屏蔽过渡都可能影响通道。LVDS、USB、以太网和车载串行视频接口的电气要求不同，即使安装中出现相近的连接器系列也不能混用。分配针脚前需取得设备接口规格。FAKRA 同轴线不能通过被动更换彩色壳体就变成 HSD 差分线。

caption.en: Foil-shielded paired cable illustrates pair construction; it is not an automotive HSD assembly.
caption.zh: 箔屏蔽线对说明成对导体结构，不是车载 HSD 成品组件。

title.en: Industries and Applications: Cameras, Displays and Antennas
title.zh: 行业与应用：摄像头、显示与天线

copy.en: Automotive applications include navigation antennas, radio receivers, telematics units, rear-view cameras, surround-view systems and display connections. The cable route may pass a headliner, dashboard, door or tailgate, each with different support and motion requirements. Industrial vision and test equipment can use related interconnects only when their interface specification supports them. FPD-Link III camera designs demonstrate that video, control and power may share coax in a defined serializer/deserializer system. That does not mean every coaxial camera accepts the same power or protocol. Confirm the active devices and full channel before replacing a camera lead with a visually similar cable.
copy.zh: 车载应用包括导航天线、无线电接收器、通信终端、倒车摄像头、环视系统与显示连接。路线可能经过顶棚、仪表台、车门或尾门，各处的支撑和运动条件不同。工业视觉与测试设备只有在接口规格允许时，才能使用相关连接体系。FPD-Link III 摄像头设计说明，在规定的串行器与解串器系统中，视频、控制和电源可以共用同轴。但这不代表所有同轴摄像头接受相同电源或协议。更换外观相似的摄像头线之前，需要确认有源设备与完整通道。

caption.en: Rear-view display application; camera electronics determine the required channel.
caption.zh: 倒车显示应用；所需通道由摄像头电子系统决定。

copy.en: A useful drawing includes datum-to-datum length, connector clocking, breakout position, mounting clips and service loops. Check the route with the door or tailgate moving through its intended travel rather than measuring only a closed position. Support should prevent the connector from carrying the weight or repeated pull of the cable. Bend limits depend on cable construction and whether motion is occasional or continuous. Verify sealed variants at exposed entries and avoid unnecessary intermediate adapters. Prototype installation can reveal packaging issues before production; a successful fit check complements, but does not replace, electrical channel validation.
copy.zh: 有效图纸包含基准到基准的长度、接头转角、分支位置、固定夹与检修余量。需要检查车门或尾门在规定行程中的路线，而不是只测关闭位置。支撑应避免接头承受线缆重量或反复拉力。弯曲限制取决于线缆结构，以及运动是偶发还是持续。外露入口需确认密封版本，并避免不必要的中间转接。样件试装有助于在生产前发现空间问题；成功的装配检查可补充电气通道验证，但不能替代它。

caption.en: Moving tailgate routes need travel clearance and a supported service loop.
caption.zh: 活动尾门路线需要行程间隙与有支撑的检修余量。

title.en: From Sketch to Shipment: Manufacturing and Customization
title.zh: 从草图到交付：制造与定制

copy.en: Requirement review establishes the application, interfaces and channel limits. Engineering then confirms the bill of materials, termination dimensions and inspection plan. Prototype assemblies can be used to check fit, signal behavior and installation access. During production, controlled stripping, contact assembly, shield termination and housing insertion preserve the released design. Labels identify channels without obscuring codes or latches. Inspection and packaging follow the agreed drawing, with protection for contacts and bend-sensitive exits. Repeatability comes from stable component references and process records; changing a cable or connector variant requires review even when the outside dimensions seem unchanged.
copy.zh: 需求审核先确定应用、接口和通道限值，工程阶段再确认物料表、端接尺寸与检验计划。样件可用于检查配合、信号表现和装配操作空间。生产时通过受控剥线、接点装配、屏蔽端接及壳体插入保持已放行设计。标签识别通道，但不能遮挡编码与卡扣。检验和包装依据约定图纸执行，并保护接点及对弯折敏感的出线位置。重复一致性来自稳定的元件型号与工艺记录，即使外部尺寸没有明显变化，更换线材或接头版本也需要审核。

caption.en: A hand stripping tool illustrates cable preparation; production tooling must match the cable and termination.
caption.zh: 手动剥线工具说明线缆准备步骤，生产工装仍需适配线材与端接。

title.zh: 信号完整性与成品验证

copy.en: Basic checks establish continuity, correct mapping and absence of shorts. RF performance requires measurements appropriate to the channel, such as insertion loss and return loss over the agreed frequency range. Differential links may additionally require pair balance, skew or time-domain evaluation. Calibration and fixture effects matter: an adapter left outside the measurement reference plane can change the apparent result. A connector's maximum frequency is not a substitute for testing the assembled route. Environmental conditioning and retention checks are specified separately. Report actual results against agreed limits; neither a visible image on a screen nor a continuity beep proves every channel requirement.
copy.zh: 基础检查确认导通、正确映射与无短路。射频性能需要适合该通道的测量，例如约定频段内的插入损耗和回波损耗。差分链路还可能需要线对平衡、偏斜或时域评估。校准与夹具影响很重要，测量参考面之外留下的转接件可能改变表观结果。连接器最高频率不能替代对已装配路线的验证。环境处理与保持力检查另行规定，并按约定限值报告实际结果。屏幕能显示画面或万用表蜂鸣，均不能证明所有通道要求已经满足。

caption.en: A compact vector network analyzer illustrates RF measurement, not a certified test result.
caption.zh: 小型矢量网络分析仪用于说明射频测量，并非已认证试验结果。

q.en: Are FAKRA and automotive LVDS the same thing?
q.zh: FAKRA 和车载 LVDS 是同一个概念吗？

a.en: No. FAKRA describes a coaxial connector family, while LVDS describes signaling. Determine whether the equipment requires coax, HSD differential wiring or another interface.
a.zh: 不是。FAKRA 描述同轴接头系列，LVDS 描述信号方式。应确认设备需要同轴、HSD 差分连接还是其他接口。

q.en: Does matching color prove compatibility?
q.zh: 颜色一致就代表兼容吗？

a.en: No. Confirm coding, contact interface, cable type and the electrical function on both sides. Color is an aid, not a complete specification.
a.zh: 不代表。还需确认两端编码、接触界面、线缆类型和电气功能。颜色只是辅助识别，不是完整规格。

q.en: Can a passive adapter convert a camera protocol?
q.zh: 无源转接线可以转换摄像头协议吗？

a.en: No. Protocol conversion requires compatible electronics. A cable adapter changes a physical connection and must preserve the required channel.
a.zh: 不能。协议转换需要兼容的电子设备，线缆转接改变物理连接，并需保持所要求的通道特性。

q.en: What do you need for a custom quotation?
q.zh: 定制报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide equipment references, both mating connectors and codes, cable requirements, lengths, branch layout, environment, quantity and the required measurement plan.
a.zh: 请提供设备型号、两端对插件与编码、线缆要求、长度、分支布局、环境、数量及所需测量计划。
