knowledge.en: A vehicle tracking installation combines separate RF, power and data paths. Their cable, connector and verification requirements are not interchangeable.
knowledge.zh: 车辆定位安装同时涉及射频、供电与数据路径，这几种回路的线缆、接头和验证要求不能混用。

notes.en: Confirm exact receiver and vehicle references, pin assignments, antenna bias, RF loss, supply duty and permitted data access before selecting an adapter.
notes.zh: 选配转接组件前，确认接收器与车型资料、针脚、天线偏置供电、射频损耗、供电工况及允许的数据访问方式。

delivery.en: Release interface drawings, prototype fit checks, circuit tests and applicable RF checks before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前，确认接口图、样件装配、回路测试与适用射频检查。

subtitle.en: Three paths: satellite signal, vehicle power and system data
subtitle.zh: 三条路径：卫星信号、车辆供电与系统数据

lead.en: A GPS harness is not one universal cable. A navigation receiver may need a coaxial antenna extension; a fleet tracker may need a fused supply, ignition input and separate sensor leads; a telematics gateway may require a vehicle-specific data adapter. GNSS includes GPS and other satellite constellations, while cellular communication carries reports to a server. These functions use different interfaces. Super Smile develops the connecting assembly from drawings, samples and equipment documentation. The tracker, antenna electronics, software subscription and vehicle permissions remain distinct parts of the system unless separately included in the project scope.
lead.zh: GPS 线束不是一根通用连接线。导航接收器可能需要同轴天线延长线，车队定位器可能需要带保险保护的电源、点火输入与传感器支线，车载通信网关还可能需要车型专用数据转接。GNSS 包含 GPS 及其他卫星星座，蜂窝通信则负责将报告传送到服务器，这些功能使用不同接口。超斯迈尔依据图纸、样品和设备资料开发连接组件；除非项目范围另有约定，定位器、天线电子部分、软件订阅和车辆访问权限仍是系统中的独立部分。

openingCaption.en: Ceramic patch antennas illustrate GNSS receiving elements; the receiver and harness are separate components.
openingCaption.zh: 陶瓷贴片天线说明 GNSS 接收单元，接收器与线束仍是不同组件。

title.zh: 产品优势：车载天线延长连接

copy.en: An extension allows the antenna and receiver to occupy different locations without forcing the electronics into the antenna's best reception position. Its value depends on the entire RF path. Additional length and adapters introduce loss; a longer lead does not amplify a satellite signal. Define connector series, keying, cable type, route and the required frequency range before quoting. FAKRA, SMA, SMB and compact board-side coax interfaces are examples, not interchangeable choices. A controlled assembly keeps the bend and strain away from the contact, preserves the intended impedance and provides enough access for installation without an unnecessary coil of spare cable.
copy.zh: 延长组件让天线与接收器可以分别安装，不必把电子设备放到天线最有利的接收位置。其价值取决于完整射频路径：增加长度和转接头会引入损耗，延长线并不会放大卫星信号。报价前需明确接头系列、防错键位、线缆类型、走线路径和工作频段。FAKRA、SMA、SMB 与小型板端同轴接口只是不同选项，不能互换。受控组件将弯折与拉力移离接点，保持所需阻抗，并为装配留下适当操作余量，而不是堆积一大圈多余线缆。

caption.en: An external GNSS antenna uses a dedicated coax lead; cable length is part of its RF budget.
caption.zh: 外置 GNSS 天线使用专用同轴引线，线长属于射频预算的一部分。

title.en: Wired GPS Trackers and Compact Units
title.zh: 有线 GPS 定位器与紧凑终端

copy.en: A wired tracker can combine a GNSS receiver, cellular modem, accelerometer and backup battery, but the harness only connects the functions supported by the selected unit. Some devices use internal antennas and need no external RF lead. Others expose separate GNSS and cellular sockets that must not be swapped. Record the device revision, supply range, connector pinout and any analog or digital inputs. Teltonika FMC920 is one example of a compact tracker architecture, not a universal pin assignment. For an installation kit, identify what is supplied as cable hardware and what remains the integrator's responsibility: configuration, SIM service, mounting, consent and account access.
copy.zh: 有线定位终端可集成 GNSS 接收器、蜂窝调制解调器、加速度计与备用电池，但线束只能连接所选设备实际支持的功能。有些设备使用内置天线，不需要外部射频线；另一些设备具有独立的 GNSS 与蜂窝接口，不能对调。需记录设备版本、供电范围、连接器针脚及模拟或数字输入。Teltonika FMC920 是紧凑终端架构的一个参考，不代表通用针脚定义。安装套件还应区分线缆硬件与集成方责任，包括设备配置、SIM 服务、安装、使用同意及账号权限。

caption.en: An opened tracker illustrates the relationship between enclosure, module and connecting wires.
caption.zh: 打开的定位器说明壳体、模块与连接导线的关系。

title.zh: 外置 GPS / GNSS 天线

copy.en: Antenna placement is an RF decision as well as a mounting decision. Nearby metal, coated glazing, the ground plane and the enclosure can alter reception. An active antenna contains amplification and requires a compatible bias supply, often carried on the coax; a passive antenna has different needs. Confirm supported bands, bias voltage and current, connector and cable loss against the receiver documentation. A roof-mounted antenna may improve its view of the sky, but the cable entry still needs sealing and strain control. Cable quality cannot remove satellite blockage in a tunnel or guarantee a position fix between tall buildings.
copy.zh: 天线位置既是安装问题，也是射频问题。附近金属、镀膜玻璃、接地平面与壳体都可能改变接收表现。有源天线包含放大部分，需要匹配的偏置供电，通常经同轴线传送；无源天线的需求不同。应依据接收器资料确认频段、偏置电压与电流、接头及线缆损耗。车顶安装可能改善天空可见范围，但线缆穿入位置仍需要密封和应力控制。线缆质量不能消除隧道中的卫星遮挡，也不能保证高楼之间始终定位成功。

caption.en: An active GPS antenna exposes its electronics beneath the cover.
caption.zh: 拆开外壳的有源 GPS 天线可见内部电子部分。

title.zh: 解决方案：车型专用 T 型线束与转接

copy.en: A T-harness introduces an approved branch between a known pair of mating vehicle interfaces. The drawing must preserve every pass-through circuit and identify the new branch, including which pins are intentionally unused. Similar housings can carry different functions across model years and equipment packages. Document the original connector reference, terminal system, cavity numbering and latch orientation; photographs alone may not establish the circuit. Avoid arbitrary connections to safety-critical controllers. Vehicle data access may require an approved gateway, software support or permissions. The harness provides physical interconnection; it does not grant access to protected data or translate protocols by itself.
copy.zh: T 型线束在明确的车辆对插接口之间加入经过批准的支路。图纸必须保留所有直通回路，并标明新增支路及有意不接的针位。不同年款与配置可能使用外观类似、功能不同的壳体。需记录原始接头型号、端子系统、腔位编号与卡扣方向，仅凭照片不一定能确认回路。不能任意接入安全关键控制器。车辆数据访问可能还需要批准的网关、软件支持或权限；线束提供物理连接，不会自行授权访问受保护数据，也不会自动转换通信协议。

caption.en: A third-party tracker and cable set illustrates a device-side branch; it is not a universal vehicle T-harness.
caption.zh: 第三方定位器与配线套件用于说明设备侧支路，不是通用车辆 T 型线束。

title.zh: OBD II 延长线与分线组件

copy.en: An OBD extension can move a telematics device away from the driver's knee space while preserving service access. A splitter needs more review than simply duplicating the connector. Connected devices can affect bus loading, diagnostic sessions and vehicle sleep behavior. The familiar 16-position diagnostic interface does not mean every cavity has the same use on every vehicle, nor that an adapter contains a fuse or protocol converter. Specify pass-through pins, branch lengths, current demand, the service-tool use case and any CAN topology limits. Validate the complete installation on the intended platform; a mechanical fit is not evidence that two diagnostic devices can communicate simultaneously.
copy.zh: OBD 延长组件可将通信终端移离驾驶员膝部空间，同时保留维修接口。分线组件需要比复制一个插座更完整的审核：接入设备可能影响总线负载、诊断会话和车辆休眠。常见的 16 位诊断接口不意味着每个针位在所有车辆上用途相同，也不意味着转接线自带保险或协议转换器。应规定直通针位、支路长度、用电需求、诊断工具使用场景及 CAN 拓扑限制。在目标平台验证完整安装，机械上能插入并不能证明两台诊断设备可以同时通信。

caption.en: A diagnostic plug illustrates cavity layout; a wiring drawing defines the actual pass-through circuits.
caption.zh: 诊断插头说明腔位排列，实际直通回路由接线图定义。

title.zh: 带保险保护的定位器电源线束

copy.en: Power, ground and ignition sensing are separate circuit functions. A permanent supply can keep a tracker alive when the vehicle is parked, but standby consumption and the vehicle's sleep strategy must be considered. An ACC feed is not automatically the required ignition signal. Select conductor size, fuse characteristics and the connection point from the device load and the vehicle-approved installation, not from a universal color rule. Put protection where it can protect the intended branch and remain serviceable. Confirm the ground reference and operation during cranking. A passive power loom does not regulate a supply outside the device's allowable range.
copy.zh: 电源、地线与点火检测是不同的回路功能。常电可在停车时保持定位器运行，但必须考虑待机耗电与车辆休眠策略。ACC 电源不一定就是设备要求的点火信号。导体规格、保险特性与取电位置，应依据设备负载和车辆允许的安装方式选择，而不是套用通用线色规则。保护器件应设置在能保护目标支路且便于维护的位置，同时确认接地参考及起动过程中的工作情况。无源电源线束不能将超出设备范围的电压自动稳压。

caption.en: An automotive fuse box illustrates the environment around protected vehicle feeds.
caption.zh: 汽车保险盒体现车辆受保护供电支路的安装环境。

title.en: Material Recommendation: Copper and RF Coaxial Cable
title.zh: 材料建议：铜导体与射频同轴线

copy.en: Power conductors are selected for resistance, voltage drop, flexibility and termination. Tinning can support corrosion resistance and certain joining processes, but it does not make the complete assembly waterproof. The antenna path instead needs a specified coaxial construction: center conductor, dielectric, shield and jacket work together. Common GNSS interfaces use a nominal 50-ohm path; verify the selected receiver rather than substituting a 75-ohm video cable because it looks similar. RG174 and RG316 are familiar reference cable types, with different construction and loss characteristics. Length, bend limits, contact preparation and the mating connector must be specified as a combination.
copy.zh: 电源导体根据电阻、压降、柔性和端接方式选择。镀锡有助于耐腐蚀及某些连接工艺，但不能让完整组件自动防水。天线路径则需要明确的同轴结构，中心导体、介质、屏蔽与护套共同工作。常见 GNSS 接口采用标称 50 Ω 路径，应核对所选接收器，不能因为外观接近就改用 75 Ω 视频线。RG174 与 RG316 是常见参考线型，结构与损耗特性不同。长度、弯曲限制、接点处理和配套连接器必须作为组合规定。

caption.en: An RP-SMA coax termination illustrates cable-to-contact construction; RP-SMA and SMA mating polarity must be distinguished.
caption.zh: RP-SMA 同轴端接说明线缆与接点的结构，RP-SMA 与 SMA 的接触极性需要区分。

title.en: Braided Sheath, Polymer Jacket and Shielding Mesh
title.zh: 编织套、聚合物护套与屏蔽网

copy.en: Textile sleeving and conductive braid have different roles. A textile sheath helps manage abrasion and bundling; a metallic screen controls an electromagnetic boundary when properly terminated. Neither can compensate for a damaged coax dielectric. Specify jacket material from temperature, oils, sunlight, flexibility and mounting conditions. An overmold may provide strain relief or environmental protection, but molding resin, adhesion, connector geometry and validation determine the result. Drainage and a controlled drip path can matter as much as an external cover. Avoid labeling every braided or molded assembly waterproof without defining the mated condition and test method.
copy.zh: 纺织编织套与导电编织网承担不同作用：前者帮助耐磨和成束，后者在正确端接时形成电磁边界，两者都不能补偿受损的同轴介质。护套材料应结合温度、油污、日照、柔性与固定条件选择。包胶可以提供应力缓解或环境防护，但实际效果取决于树脂、粘接、接头形状和验证。排水与受控滴水路径有时和外部包覆同样重要，不能在未定义对插状态及试验方法时，把所有编织或包胶组件都标成防水。

caption.en: A textile-braided cable close-up illustrates external abrasion protection, not conductive shielding.
caption.zh: 纺织编织线缆特写用于说明外部耐磨层，不是导电屏蔽。

title.en: Industries and Applications: Fleet Management & Logistics
title.zh: 行业与应用：车队管理与物流

copy.en: Delivery vans, buses and heavy trucks can share a telematics platform while needing different harnesses. Supply architecture, connector locations and available data interfaces vary between vehicles. A repeatable kit defines branch labels, mounting references and the permitted connection method, reducing ambiguity during fleet installation. Navigation reception, cellular coverage and vehicle data availability should be evaluated separately. The cable assembly cannot guarantee real-time reporting when the network is unavailable. Fleet operators also need an authorized process for driver information, access control and retention of tracking data; these are operational responsibilities outside the physical wiring specification.
copy.zh: 配送车、客车与重卡可以使用同一通信平台，却需要不同线束。车辆之间的供电架构、接头位置和数据接口并不相同。可重复安装的套件会规定支路线号、固定基准和允许的接线方式，减少批量部署中的歧义。导航接收、蜂窝覆盖和车辆数据可用性应分别评估，网络不可用时线缆组件不能保证实时上报。车队还需建立获得授权的司机告知、权限管理和定位数据保留流程，这些运营责任不属于实体线束规格本身。

caption.en: Delivery vehicles illustrate repeated fleet installations across several units.
caption.zh: 配送车辆体现同一车队内的重复安装需求。

title.en: Motorcycles, Heavy Equipment and Outdoor Installations
title.zh: 摩托车、工程设备与户外安装

copy.en: Small vehicles need flexible routes around steering and suspension movement; construction equipment adds dust, vibration and frequent servicing. Marine or exposed installations introduce salt, UV and water-entry concerns that require a separate specification. Choose the connector's sealed version where needed, define strain relief and keep harnesses clear of moving and hot parts. A short assembly still needs a minimum bend radius and secure support. Antenna location must preserve both reception and physical protection. These projects can share manufacturing methods with fleet harnesses, but their environmental acceptance criteria cannot be assumed from a sheltered passenger-car installation.
copy.zh: 小型车辆需要适应转向与悬架运动的柔性路线；工程设备还存在粉尘、振动和频繁检修。船用或外露安装增加盐分、紫外线和进水风险，需要单独规定。必要时选择连接器的密封版本，明确应力缓解，并使线束避开运动件和热源。即便组件很短，也需要满足最小弯曲半径并可靠支撑。天线位置还要兼顾接收与机械防护。这些项目可与车队线束共享制造方法，但不能直接沿用车内遮蔽安装的环境验收条件。

caption.en: Rain and road exposure illustrate the environmental review needed for open vehicle installations.
caption.zh: 雨水与路面暴露说明开放式车辆安装需要环境审核。

copy.en: The process begins with a controlled pin map and routing drawing, followed by connector and cable confirmation. Power branches are cut, stripped and terminated with the specified tooling. Coax preparation separately controls the exposed center conductor, dielectric and shield lengths so stray strands cannot bridge the contact. Labels distinguish GNSS, cellular, power and data connections before installation. Prototype review checks mating, latch access, routing and the equipment's operation. Once accepted, the drawing, bill of materials and inspection plan define repeat production. Quantity and lead time depend on component availability and the agreed verification scope rather than a fixed promise for every configuration.
copy.zh: 流程从受控针脚表与走线图开始，再确认接头和线材。电源支路按规定工装完成裁线、剥线和端接；同轴处理则独立控制中心导体、介质和屏蔽的露出长度，避免散股跨接接点。装配前以标识区分 GNSS、蜂窝、电源与数据连接。样件审核检查对插、卡扣操作、走线与设备运行，确认后由图纸、物料表和检验计划定义重复生产。数量与交期取决于元件供应及约定的验证范围，而不是所有配置都适用的固定承诺。

caption.en: Controlled wire stripping is one preparation step before the specified termination process.
caption.zh: 受控剥线是规定端接工艺之前的准备步骤。

title.zh: 可靠性、集成与可维护性

copy.en: Continuity and pin mapping establish basic circuit correctness but do not characterize RF performance. Depending on the design, inspection may include shielding continuity, connector retention, insulation checks and agreed insertion-loss or return-loss measurements. A system trial should also consider cranking, sleep current, antenna reception and recovery after a supply interruption. Record test limits and equipment rather than treating a successful location fix as proof of every requirement. Serviceable routing allows a technician to identify and replace a branch without disturbing unrelated circuits. Certification of the tracker or a connector does not automatically certify the completed harness or the vehicle installation.
copy.zh: 导通与针脚检查建立基本回路正确性，但不能表征射频性能。按设计需要，检验可包含屏蔽导通、接头保持力、绝缘检查，以及约定的插入损耗或回波损耗测量。系统试用还应考虑起动、休眠电流、天线接收与供电中断后的恢复。应记录试验限值和设备，不能把一次定位成功当作所有要求都已满足。便于维护的布线能让技术人员识别和更换支路而不影响无关回路。定位器或某个接头的认证不等于成品线束或车辆安装的认证。

caption.en: NIST network-analyzer work illustrates RF measurement equipment, not a test of our product.
caption.zh: NIST 网络分析仪研究体现射频测量设备，不是本公司产品的测试。

q.en: Does one GPS harness fit every 12 V vehicle?
q.zh: 一套 GPS 线束适配所有 12 V 车辆吗？

a.en: No. Supply voltage alone does not define connector pinout, ignition behavior, vehicle data access or installation geometry. Confirm the exact platform and tracker.
a.zh: 不适配。供电电压不能单独确定针脚、点火逻辑、车辆数据访问或安装形状，需要确认具体车型与定位器。

q.en: Does a longer antenna cable improve reception?
q.zh: 天线线缆越长，接收就越好吗？

a.en: Only if relocation improves the antenna environment enough to justify the added loss. Length itself does not amplify the signal; verify the receiver and antenna link budget.
a.zh: 只有改善天线位置带来的收益足以抵消新增损耗时才可能有帮助。长度本身不会放大信号，需要审核接收器与天线的链路预算。

q.en: Can the harness convert CAN data into GPS reports?
q.zh: 线束能把 CAN 数据自动转换成 GPS 报告吗？

a.en: A passive harness cannot. Data interpretation and reporting require compatible gateway electronics, software and authorized access.
a.zh: 无源线束不能。数据解释与上报需要兼容的网关电子设备、软件和授权访问。

q.en: Are all versions sealed for outdoor use?
q.zh: 所有版本都适合户外密封使用吗？

a.en: No. Define the connector variant, mated condition, cable entry and test requirement. A jacket or braided sleeve alone is not an ingress-protection rating.
a.zh: 不是。需要规定接头版本、对插状态、线缆入口和试验要求，护套或编织套本身不构成防护等级。

intro.en: Project-reviewed high-voltage interconnections for electrified equipment, with defined insulation, shielding, interlock and validation requirements.
intro.zh: 面向电气化设备，按项目审核绝缘、屏蔽、互锁与验证要求的高压连接组件。

knowledge.en: Voltage withstand, temperature rise, shielding and HVIL are separate requirements that must work together.
knowledge.zh: 绝缘耐受、温升、屏蔽与高压互锁是不同要求，需要在系统中协调。

notes.en: High-voltage projects require engineering and validation review before quotation. This page is not an energized-service procedure.
notes.zh: 高压项目报价前需完成工程与验证条件审核，本页不是带电维修操作指南。

delivery.en: Agree component sources, tooling, drawings, samples and verification scope before releasing a production build.
delivery.zh: 生产放行前确认物料来源、工装、图纸、样件及验证范围。

subtitle.en: Power, insulation and controlled interfaces
subtitle.zh: 动力连接、绝缘与受控接口

lead.en: High-voltage harnesses connect an electrified vehicle's energy and conversion equipment. Battery-to-inverter leads, motor phase cables, charging interconnections and auxiliary feeds are related but different assemblies. A project may need shielded single-core cable, multi-core cable, a panel interface or a protected branch with a low-voltage interlock loop. Orange identification alone does not establish a voltage rating or a safe installation. We first review the circuit, mating interfaces, operating environment and verification requirements, then confirm whether the materials, tooling and production controls match that specific project.
lead.zh: 高压线束连接电气化车辆的储能与能量转换设备。电池至逆变器连接线、电机相线、充电连接线和高压附件馈线相互关联，但不是同一种组件。项目可能需要屏蔽单芯线、多芯线、穿板接口，或带低压互锁回路的受保护分支。橙色标识本身不能证明额定电压或安装安全。我们先审核回路、对插接口、运行环境和验证要求，再确认材料、工装与生产控制是否适合具体项目。

openingCaption.en: Electric-vehicle chassis exhibit: energy storage, structure and cable routes must be coordinated.
openingCaption.zh: 电动车底盘展品：储能、车体结构与线缆路线需要协调设计。

copy.en: An engineered assembly controls cable length, bend direction, support positions and connector access as one installation. A short auxiliary feed for an electric compressor does not have the same duty as a traction inverter link. Lower circuit resistance can reduce loss, but simply increasing conductor size may compromise the terminal, seal or bending space. Defined variants allow a platform to use different cable lengths or connector orientations without losing traceability. Our review separates electrical performance from packaging convenience: a harness that fits physically still needs the correct current profile, voltage class, insulation system and component documentation.
copy.zh: 工程化组件把电缆长度、弯曲方向、支撑位置和接头操作空间作为一个安装整体控制。电动压缩机的短附件馈线，与牵引逆变器连接线承担不同的任务。降低回路电阻有助于减少损耗，但单纯加粗导体可能破坏端子、密封或弯曲空间的匹配。通过明确的变型资料，同一平台可以采用不同长度或接头方向，同时保持版本可追溯。审核时需把电气性能与空间便利分开：能够装进去的线束，仍需匹配电流曲线、电压类别、绝缘体系及元件资料。

caption.en: A hybrid engine bay illustrates the restricted space around power-conversion equipment.
caption.zh: 混合动力机舱说明功率变换设备周围的安装空间限制。

title.zh: 材料建议：电动车高压线材

copy.en: Conductor material and cross-section are selected with continuous current, short-duration peaks, route length, bundling and ambient temperature. Copper and aluminum need different compatible termination systems. XLPE, silicone and other insulation families have grade-specific thermal, mechanical and fluid-resistance properties; a polymer name is not a complete cable specification. Record conductor construction, insulation thickness, overall diameter, minimum bend radius and required evidence. ISO 19642 includes automotive cable construction and test documents, with separate parts for voltage class, material and configuration. The agreed edition and applicable part belong in the purchase specification, not a blanket statement that every orange cable is compliant.
copy.zh: 导体材料与截面需要结合连续电流、短时峰值、路线长度、成束状态和环境温度选择。铜与铝需要不同的兼容端接体系。XLPE、硅橡胶等绝缘材料的热、机械和耐液体性能取决于具体等级；材料名称不是完整电缆规格。资料应明确导体结构、绝缘厚度、总外径、最小弯曲半径及所需证据。ISO 19642 系列包含汽车电缆结构和试验文件，不同电压类别、材料与配置对应不同分册。采购规格应写明约定版本与适用分册，而不能笼统宣称所有橙色电缆均符合标准。

caption.en: An EV charging-cable cross-section illustrates conductor and insulation layers, not a rating for a traction harness.
caption.zh: 电动车充电电缆截面说明导体与绝缘层结构，不代表牵引线束的额定参数。

copy.en: External sleeving manages abrasion, local heat and contact with brackets; it does not replace the cable's electrical insulation. A split corrugated tube is not a watertight conduit. Heat-shrink and adhesive-lined products require a compatible substrate, diameter range and process, while sharp edges may need a grommet or a separate barrier. Position sleeves so that connector seals and latches remain accessible. Protection must not conceal damaged insulation or become the only support for a heavy cable. Water paths, drainage and strain relief are reviewed together, particularly where a cable enters a battery enclosure or passes through a body panel.
copy.zh: 外部套管用于管理摩擦、局部热源及与支架的接触，不能替代电缆自身的电气绝缘。开口波纹管并不是水密导管。热缩和带胶产品需要匹配基材、直径范围与加工条件；锐利边缘可能还需要护线圈或独立隔离件。套管位置应保留密封和锁扣的操作空间。防护层不能用于掩盖绝缘损伤，也不应成为重电缆的唯一支撑。电缆进入电池外壳或穿过车身板时，需要共同审核进水路径、排水条件和应力释放。

caption.en: Heat-shrink tubing illustrates local sleeving; material and adhesive selection remain project-specific.
caption.zh: 热缩管说明局部套管防护，材料与胶层仍需按项目选择。

copy.en: A connector specification includes the exact plug, header, contacts, seals, shield parts and locking configuration. TE AMP+ HVA 280, HVA 1200 and Amphenol ePower are examples of different high-voltage interconnect families, not mutually interchangeable names. Verify the manufacturer drawing and application specification for the chosen variant rather than transferring a headline rating from another wire size. Lug and busbar interfaces also need defined contact surfaces, fastening details and insulation clearances. Original components or any proposed alternative must be identified explicitly in the quotation and bill of materials. Listing a brand does not indicate manufacturer authorization or approval of our finished assembly.
copy.zh: 连接器规格应包含准确的插头、座端、接点、密封件、屏蔽零件与锁止配置。TE AMP+ HVA 280、HVA 1200 和 Amphenol ePower 是不同高压互连系列的例子，名称之间不能互换。选定变型后，应核对制造商图纸与应用规范，不能把其他线径的宣传额定值直接移用。铜端子与母排接口同样需要明确接触面、紧固要求和绝缘间距。原厂物料或拟采用的替代方案均应在报价和物料清单中说明。列出品牌不表示厂家授权，也不表示对方已认可我们的成品组件。

caption.en: A small crimped ring terminal illustrates barrel and palm geometry; high-voltage lugs need their own approved specification.
caption.zh: 小型压接环形端子说明压接筒与安装掌面的结构，高压铜端子需另行确认适用规格。

title.zh: 解决方案：高压互连线束

copy.en: Begin with the power architecture: battery output, distribution, inverter, charger and auxiliary loads. The branch for a heater or DC/DC converter may need different wire, shielding and protection from the main traction link. Record polarity or phase identity, connector orientation, separation from low-voltage circuits and the service envelope. A busbar-to-cable transition requires its own support and insulation review. Samples help establish geometry but cannot reveal every hidden function. We use customer-approved electrical data and installation references to define the assembly; the vehicle's contactor, precharge and protection strategy remains part of the wider system design.
copy.zh: 首先确认动力架构：电池输出、配电、逆变器、充电机与附件负载。加热器或 DC/DC 转换器分支所需的线材、屏蔽和保护，可能与主牵引连接不同。资料需注明极性或相别、接头方向、与低压回路的隔离及检修空间。母排转接电缆的位置需要独立的支撑与绝缘审核。样品能够提供几何参考，但不能揭示所有隐藏功能。我们依据客户批准的电气资料和安装参考定义组件；车辆接触器、预充与故障保护策略仍属于更大范围的系统设计。

caption.en: A Prius conversion battery installation illustrates system packaging, not a recommended retrofit.
caption.zh: Prius 改装电池安装照片用于说明系统布置，不构成改装建议。

copy.en: Electric cars use compact links around batteries, chargers and drive units. Electric trucks and buses add longer routes, higher vibration exposure and intensive duty cycles. Off-road machinery introduces contamination and protected service access; stationary energy equipment changes mounting, maintenance and installation rules. These application families are useful starting points, not a universal approval list. Railway, marine, aerospace and defense work requires a separate review of applicable standards, material traceability, testing and supplier qualification. A road-vehicle connector or cable document alone does not establish suitability for those sectors.
copy.zh: 电动乘用车需要在电池、充电机和驱动单元周围布置紧凑连接。电动卡车与客车增加了长距离走线、较强振动及密集工作周期。非道路机械还涉及污染和受保护的检修位置；固定式能源设备则改变了安装、维护与适用规则。这些应用类别是需求讨论的起点，并不是通用认可清单。轨道、船舶、航空航天和军用项目需要单独审核适用标准、材料追溯、测试及供应商资质，仅有道路车辆的接头或线材文件，不能证明适用于上述行业。

caption.en: Electric buses provide an application context for power distribution and auxiliary feeds.
caption.zh: 电动客车体现动力分配与辅助供电的应用场景。

copy.en: Engineering review first defines circuit identity, dimensions, component sources and inspection criteria. Process preparation then confirms stripping limits, termination tooling, shield preparation and assembly sequence against the applicable component instructions. Prototype evaluation addresses fit, locking, cable support and agreed electrical checks before a repeat-production version is released. Production records link the build to its drawing and material revision. Packaging protects exposed contacts, seals and minimum bend radii. Special tests, third-party validation and customer approvals are identified in the project plan rather than described as routine completed results for every order.
copy.zh: 工程审核先确定回路标识、尺寸、物料来源与检验条件。工艺准备再依据适用的元件说明，确认剥切限制、端接工具、屏蔽处理和装配顺序。样件在量产版本放行前评估空间配合、锁止、支撑及约定电气项目。生产记录应能够关联图纸和物料版本。包装需要保护外露接点、密封件与最小弯曲半径。特殊测试、第三方验证及客户批准应在项目计划中明确，而不是写成每个订单都已经完成的常规结果。

caption.en: Crimp comparison: the source identifies the left impression as insufficient and the right as correctly formed. Tooling matters.
caption.zh: 压接对比：原图指出左侧压痕不足，右侧成形正确，说明工装匹配的重要性。

copy.en: Current produces heating in the conductor and contact interfaces; insulation and nearby components constrain the acceptable temperature. Review the actual duty cycle and installation instead of treating a free-air connector rating as a sealed-enclosure rating. Voltage loss depends on the complete circuit resistance, including terminations. Voltage class also concerns insulation coordination and separation, not simply thicker copper. A temperature sensor or monitoring lead can be included only when its location, interface and control function are defined. The harness itself does not automatically switch off an overheating system unless a separately specified device and control architecture provide that function.
copy.zh: 电流会使导体与接触界面发热，绝缘和邻近元件限制了可接受温度。应按实际工作周期与安装状态审核，不能把自由空气中的接头额定值当作密闭箱体中的额定值。压降取决于包含端接位置在内的完整回路电阻。电压类别还涉及绝缘配合与间距，并不是铜更粗就能解决。只有明确了位置、接口及控制功能，才能加入温度传感器或监测引线。除非另行规定的器件与控制架构提供该功能，线束本身不会在系统过热时自动断电。

caption.en: Motor thermography illustrates uneven heat distribution; it is not a test result for this harness.
caption.zh: 电机热像说明温度分布不均，不是本页线束的测试结果。

title.en: Shielding Against EMI and Electrical Noise

copy.en: Fast inverter switching can couple noise into nearby circuits. Cable braid or foil is only part of the answer: the shield needs a controlled termination at the connector and equipment boundary. Exposed lengths, discontinuities and poorly supported shield contacts can reduce performance. The chosen grounding strategy, route separation and enclosure connections are reviewed with the system EMC requirements. A continuity reading across a shield does not describe its high-frequency transfer behavior. Likewise, shielding is not a replacement for insulation, sealing or fault protection. EMC evidence must relate to the actual assembly and installation, not just the presence of a metal braid.
copy.zh: 逆变器的快速开关可能向邻近回路耦合噪声。编织或箔屏蔽只是解决方案的一部分，屏蔽层还需要在连接器与设备边界形成受控端接。外露长度、不连续位置和缺少支撑的屏蔽接点都可能影响效果。接地策略、线路隔离与壳体连接应结合系统 EMC 要求审核。测得屏蔽层导通，并不能说明其高频传输特性。同样，屏蔽不能代替绝缘、密封或故障保护。EMC 证据必须对应实际组件与安装，而不是仅凭存在一层金属编织网。

caption.en: Braid on a coaxial cable illustrates a conductive shield layer, not a high-voltage cable specification.
caption.zh: 同轴电缆上的编织网用于说明导电屏蔽层，不是高压电缆规格。

copy.en: HVIL uses a separate low-voltage monitoring path to help detect an open or improperly connected high-voltage interface. The response depends on the vehicle controller and contactor strategy; a closed loop is not proof that the circuit is de-energized. Connector position assurance, touch protection and mechanical coding address different risks and should not be confused. Validation may include circuit mapping, isolation, contact resistance, dielectric checks and specified environmental conditioning under an approved plan. Tests involving energized high-voltage equipment require qualified personnel and the equipment's safety procedure. This overview does not authorize bypassing an interlock or working on a live traction circuit.
copy.zh: HVIL 通过独立的低压监测路径，帮助识别高压接口断开或连接异常。系统如何响应，取决于车辆控制器和接触器策略；互锁回路闭合不能证明高压回路已经断电。连接位置保证、防触电与机械防错针对不同风险，不能混为一谈。验证可能包含回路映射、隔离、接触电阻、介电检查及规定的环境处理，均需按批准计划执行。涉及带电高压设备的试验需要合格人员和设备规定的安全程序。本页不授权绕过互锁，也不是牵引高压回路的带电作业指导。

caption.en: NASA motor-controller thermal research illustrates controlled engineering validation, not company testing or HVIL certification.
caption.zh: NASA 电机控制器热研究说明受控工程验证，不代表本公司试验或互锁认证。

q.en: Does orange insulation prove an 800 V rating?
q.zh: 橙色绝缘就代表可以用于 800 V 吗？

a.en: No. Identification color is separate from voltage rating. Confirm the cable and connector variants, insulation coordination and the project's verification requirements.
a.zh: 不是。识别颜色与额定电压是不同概念，需要确认线材和接头变型、绝缘配合及项目验证要求。

q.en: Can the same harness serve every EV platform?
q.zh: 同一套线束可以适配所有电动车平台吗？

a.en: No. Current duty, interfaces, control functions, route and environment change by platform. A similar-looking connector does not establish interchangeability.
a.zh: 不能。电流任务、接口、控制功能、走线和环境随平台变化，外观相似的接头并不代表可以互换。

q.en: What should be supplied for engineering review?
q.zh: 工程审核需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide system voltage, current profile, circuit and interface drawings, route dimensions, environmental requirements, quantity and the required test or approval documents.
a.zh: 请提供系统电压、电流曲线、回路与接口图、路线尺寸、环境要求、数量以及所需试验或批准文件。

q.en: Does this page claim vehicle or functional-safety certification?
q.zh: 本页是否代表已获得整车或功能安全认证？

a.en: No. Component references and project-review capability are not finished-harness or vehicle certification. Applicable evidence and responsibilities must be agreed for each project.
a.zh: 不代表。元件资料与项目审核能力不等于成品线束或整车认证，适用证据与责任需要按项目约定。

intro.en: Custom battery terminal leads, starter feeds, earth straps and jumper assemblies, defined by the complete current path and installation.
intro.zh: 围绕完整电流路径与安装空间，定制电瓶端子线、起动机供电线、接地搭接线及跨接组件。

knowledge.en: Conductor area, termination, length and operating duty jointly determine voltage drop and thermal behavior.
knowledge.zh: 导体截面、端接质量、长度和工作周期共同决定压降与温升。

notes.en: Define permanent installation separately from temporary jump starting. Follow the vehicle manufacturer's instructions and approved connection points.
notes.zh: 永久安装线路与临时跨接起动应分别定义。操作遵循车辆制造商说明与指定连接点。

delivery.en: Release drawings, material part numbers, polarity, branch dimensions and inspection requirements before production.
delivery.zh: 生产前确认图纸、物料型号、极性、分支尺寸及检验要求。

subtitle.en: From the battery terminal to the return path
subtitle.zh: 从电瓶端子到回流路径

lead.en: A battery cable is part of a circuit, not simply a thick wire. It may join the battery to a starter, connect a chassis ground, link batteries in an approved arrangement or provide an accessible service connection. The category includes ring-lug leads, terminal-clamp cables, flexible earth straps and detachable power leads. Temporary booster cables have a different operating procedure from a permanently installed harness. We develop the assembly around the equipment's circuit, interfaces, route and duty cycle rather than treating one cable size as suitable for every vehicle.
lead.zh: 电瓶搭接线是完整回路的一部分，不只是加粗的电线。它可以连接电瓶与起动机、建立车身接地、按已批准方案连接电瓶组，或把维修接口引到便于操作的位置。这个小类覆盖环形端子线、电瓶桩头线、柔性接地带和可插拔电源连接线。临时救援跨接线与永久安装线束的使用方式不同。我们围绕设备回路、接口、走线路径和工作周期开发组件，而不是把同一种线径套用于所有车辆。

caption.en: The mounting point and current path define the cable configuration.
caption.zh: 连接位置与电流路径共同决定电缆配置。

copy.en: A purpose-built cable replaces unnecessary joins with controlled cable length, lug orientation and mounting geometry. Positive starter leads, negative battery cables, engine-to-chassis bonds and auxiliary battery links have different routing and current duties. An accessible detachable connection can simplify service when its contacts, keying and electrical rating match the equipment. Flexible strands may help installation, but flexibility does not establish continuous-flex life or current capacity. Likewise, a large clamp does not prove that the conductor inside is large enough. Design starts with load and starting-current information, allowable voltage loss, ambient temperature and the complete positive and return paths.
copy.zh: 按设备开发的组件可通过明确长度、端子方向和安装位置，减少不必要的中间接点。起动机正极线、电瓶负极线、发动机与车身接地带以及辅助电瓶连接线，承担不同的走线和电流任务。便于接近的可插拔接口能够改善维修操作，但其端子、机械防错与电气额定值必须匹配设备。多股柔性结构有助于安装，却不直接证明往复弯曲寿命或载流能力。同样，夹钳外观很大，也不能证明内部导体足够粗。设计应从负载与起动电流、允许压降、环境温度以及正负完整路径开始。

title.zh: 汽车用铜端子与接头选择

caption.en: Barrel size, stud hole and palm geometry must all match the installation.
caption.zh: 压接管径、螺栓孔与端子掌面形状都需要匹配安装位置。

copy.en: Options include straight ring lugs, angled palms, inspection-hole lugs, two-hole lugs, battery post clamps and selected detachable connectors. A lug has two separate interfaces: its barrel must fit the conductor and its palm must fit the stud and contact surface. Names such as SC or DT alone do not define a universal dimensional or performance standard. Confirm the actual drawing, hole diameter, barrel dimensions, conductor class, plating and approved tooling. Tinned copper is a common option; aluminum conductors require specifically compatible terminations and processing. Copper-only contacts cannot be made aluminum-compatible by adding solder or choosing a similar-looking lug.
copy.zh: 可选结构包括直式环形铜鼻、折弯掌面端子、观察孔端子、双孔端子、电瓶桩头夹及指定的可插拔接头。端子有两个不同接口：压接管需要匹配导体，掌面需要匹配螺栓和接触表面。SC、DT 等名称本身并不构成统一的尺寸或性能标准，必须核对实际图纸、孔径、管径、导体结构、镀层与批准工具。镀锡铜是一种常见选项；铝导体则需要专门兼容的端接体系与加工方法。只适用于铜线的接点，不能靠加焊锡或换成外观相似的端子来兼容铝线。

title.en: Solutions for the Complete Current Path
title.zh: 完整电流路径的解决方案

caption.en: A small Powerpole connection illustrates detachable keying; it is not an SB-series battery connector.
caption.zh: 小型 Powerpole 接头用于说明可拆连接与防错结构，并非 SB 系列电瓶接头。

copy.en: A remote battery location may need a longer feed, a protected pass-through and a defined return connection. A dual-battery arrangement may add isolation, charging control or a distribution point, which must be designed as a system rather than joined indiscriminately. Detachable leads can use a specified Anderson SB family interface, but connector size, color keying, contact part number and wire range require verification. A starter circuit's short-duration current is not a continuous operating rating. Protection selection must coordinate with the equipment architecture and expected fault current; adding an arbitrary inline fuse or bypassing the original protection is not a universal solution.
copy.zh: 电瓶安装较远时，可能需要加长供电线、受保护的穿板位置以及明确的回流连接。双电瓶结构还可能涉及隔离、充电控制或配电点，需要按系统设计，不能直接随意并接。可拆卸连接线可以采用指定 Anderson SB 系列接口，但必须确认壳体规格、颜色防错、端子料号与适配线径。起动回路的短时电流并不等于连续工作额定值。保护装置需与设备架构及预期故障电流配合；任意增加一个在线保险丝，或绕开原有保护，都不能作为通用方案。

caption.en: Equipment duty changes the requirements for the battery circuit.
caption.zh: 设备的工作方式会改变电瓶回路的设计要求。

copy.en: Passenger vehicles and trucks use battery leads for starting, charging and grounded returns. Off-road machinery adds vibration, mud and difficult routing; marine and recreational vehicles introduce moisture, service-access and auxiliary-load considerations. Stationary generators and backup equipment may prioritize long idle periods, dependable connections and inspection access. These are related applications, not interchangeable cable approvals. Route temperature, fluid exposure, fastening, battery arrangement and applicable equipment rules must be defined separately. Low-voltage battery leads are also distinct from orange high-voltage traction cables in an electric vehicle. An auxiliary battery connection must not be represented as suitable for the traction system.
copy.zh: 乘用车和卡车中的电瓶连接线服务于起动、充电和接地回流。越野与工程机械增加了振动、泥水及复杂走线条件；船舶和房车还涉及潮湿、检修空间与辅助负载。固定式发电机和备用电源可能更关注长期静置后的连接可靠性与检查可达性。这些应用相互关联，但不意味着电缆批准要求可以互换。路线温度、液体暴露、固定方式、电瓶组合和设备适用规范应分别定义。低压电瓶连接线也不同于电动车中橙色的高压驱动电缆，不能把辅助电瓶连接组件宣传为适用于高压动力系统。

caption.en: Termination quality depends on the matched conductor, terminal and tool.
caption.zh: 端接质量取决于导体、端子与工具的配套。

copy.en: The electrical connection is created inside the barrel and at the bolted contact, not by the outer heat-shrink tube. Preparation must avoid damaged strands, trapped insulation and incompatible barrel fill. The specified die, crimp position and number of compressions follow the terminal manufacturer's instructions. Pull testing and visual inspection assess different aspects of workmanship; neither alone establishes low resistance in service. A supported cable exit reduces bending at the barrel transition. At installation, use the equipment's fastening and torque specification: excessive torque can damage a stud or palm, while insufficient contact pressure can cause resistance and local heating.
copy.zh: 电气连接形成在压接管内部和螺栓接触面，而不是外面的热缩管。导体准备需避免损伤铜丝、夹入绝缘层以及管内填充不匹配。压模、压接位置和压接次数应遵循端子制造商说明。拉力检查和外观检查反映不同的加工质量，任何一种单独通过，都不等于实际工况下连接电阻合格。支撑电缆出口可降低压接过渡位置的弯曲应力。安装时采用设备规定的紧固方式与扭矩：过度拧紧可能损伤螺柱或掌面，接触压力不足则可能增加电阻并形成局部发热。

title.zh: 防腐蚀与长期使用安全

caption.en: Corrosion at the connection can increase resistance without breaking continuity.
caption.zh: 接点腐蚀可能在仍然导通的情况下增加电阻。

copy.en: Plating, terminal boots and correctly selected adhesive-lined heat shrink can help protect a connection, but none makes every installation waterproof. The seal must accommodate the actual cable diameter and exit geometry; water can also enter elsewhere and migrate along strands. Insulation selection should consider temperature, oils, abrasion and the battery-compartment environment. SAE J1127 is a reference for low-voltage battery cable; the specified revision, cable construction and test requirements belong in the purchase specification. A reference to that standard is not certification of the finished harness. Regular inspection should address loose connections, damaged insulation, corrosion and unsupported movement.
copy.zh: 镀层、端子护套以及合适的带胶热缩管能够改善连接防护，但并不使每一种安装都自动防水。密封结构必须适配实际线缆外径和出线形状；水分也可能从其他位置进入并沿导体丝束迁移。绝缘材料需考虑温度、油类、摩擦及电瓶舱环境。SAE J1127 是低压电瓶电缆的参考标准，采购规格应写明适用版本、结构与检验要求。引用该标准不等于成品线束已获得认证。定期检查应关注连接松动、绝缘损伤、腐蚀以及缺少支撑造成的晃动。

caption.en: A caliper illustrates dimensional measurement; cable drawings still need defined terminal datums.
caption.zh: 卡尺用于说明尺寸测量；电缆图纸仍需明确端子测量基准。

copy.en: Useful drawings state whether length is measured between hole centers, contact faces or cut ends. Define lug clocking, bend direction, branch positions, post polarity, labels and service loops. A short straight-line measurement may miss the length needed around brackets and moving components; excess slack can rub or enter a pinch point. AWG and square-millimeter sizes should be checked against the actual conductor specification, not treated as exactly interchangeable labels. Prototype installation can confirm fit before the configuration is released. Drawings or samples are useful starting points, but hidden circuit functions and the intended electrical duty still require customer confirmation.
copy.zh: 有用的图纸会说明长度是按孔中心、接触面还是切线端测量，同时明确端子转角、弯曲方向、分支位置、正负极、标签与维修余量。两点之间的直线尺寸可能遗漏绕过支架和运动件所需的长度；余量过多也可能产生摩擦或进入夹点。AWG 与平方毫米规格应对应实际导体参数检查，不能把近似名称当作完全相同的截面。样件试装可以在配置放行前确认空间配合。图纸或样品都可作为开发起点，但隐藏的回路功能和预期电气工况仍需客户确认。

title.en: Why Review or Upgrade a Battery Cable?
title.zh: 何时需要评估或更换电瓶连接线

caption.en: Meter and probes illustrate test equipment, not a recorded battery-cable test result.
caption.zh: 仪表与测试线用于说明检查工具，不代表已完成的电瓶线测试结果。

copy.en: Slow cranking or intermittent power does not automatically mean the cable needs a larger conductor. Battery condition, the starter, grounds and terminations may all contribute. A continuity beep uses very little current and can miss a connection that becomes restrictive under load. A controlled voltage-drop test across the positive and return paths helps locate loss when the circuit is operating; the equipment's service limits and safe test procedure take precedence. Compare the cable, lug and bolted interfaces separately where access permits. Thermal observations may support the investigation, but surface appearance alone cannot establish an acceptable electrical connection.
copy.zh: 起动无力或间歇断电，并不自动意味着必须更换更粗的导体。电瓶状态、起动机、接地和端接位置都可能参与形成问题。导通蜂鸣检查所用电流很小，可能识别不出只有带载时才明显的接触阻力。按受控方法检查正极与回流路径上的压降，有助于在回路工作时定位损耗；具体限值和安全操作以设备维修要求为准。条件允许时，可以分别比较电缆、端子及螺栓接点。温升观察能够辅助判断，但表面外观不能单独证明电气连接合格。

title.zh: 加工检验与维修使用边界

caption.en: Temporary jump leads are used only at the vehicle's approved connection points.
caption.zh: 临时跨接线应仅用于车辆规定的连接位置。

copy.en: A released build defines cut length, stripping, terminal preparation, crimp tooling, sleeve position, polarity and identification. Inspection can include dimensions, contact retention, pull checks and agreed electrical tests, with acceptance criteria tied to the drawing and intended duty. Portable jump leads require a separate assessment of clamp insulation, grip and short-duration operation. They are not a replacement for a permanent battery lead. Follow the specific vehicle manual for jump starting; system voltage and approved connection points matter, and some hybrids must not supply jump-start assistance. This product overview is not a live-battery installation procedure.
copy.zh: 已放行的加工资料应定义裁线长度、剥皮、端子准备、压接工具、套管位置、极性和标识。检验可以涵盖尺寸、端子保持、拉力检查及约定电气项目，判定条件对应图纸与预期工况。便携跨接线还需单独评估夹钳绝缘、夹持和短时工作能力，不能用来替代永久安装的电瓶连接线。跨接起动应遵循具体车型说明，系统电压与指定连接点十分重要，部分混动车型不允许作为救援供电车辆。本页产品介绍不是带电安装操作指南。

q.en: Are permanent battery leads and jumper cables the same?
q.zh: 永久安装的电瓶线与救援跨接线一样吗？

a.en: No. Mounting, insulation, terminations and operating duty differ. A temporary clamp connection is not a substitute for a released permanent installation.
a.zh: 不一样。固定、绝缘、端接和工作周期不同，临时夹钳连接不能替代已确认的永久安装方案。

q.en: Can current capacity be selected from AWG alone?
q.zh: 只看 AWG 就能确定载流能力吗？

a.en: No. Review conductor material and area, length, ambient temperature, bundling, voltage drop, connections and the continuous or intermittent duty.
a.zh: 不能。还需核对导体材料与截面、长度、环境温度、成束状态、压降、连接点以及连续或间歇工作要求。

q.en: Can you match a drawing or existing cable?
q.zh: 可以按图纸或现有样品定制吗？

a.en: Yes. Provide dimensions, terminal references, polarity, installation photographs, electrical duty, quantity and required inspection. A sample establishes geometry but not every hidden requirement.
a.zh: 可以。请提供尺寸、端子资料、极性、安装照片、电气工况、数量及检验要求。样品能提供几何参考，但不包含全部隐藏要求。

q.en: Does thicker insulation mean more copper?
q.zh: 外皮更厚就意味着铜更多吗？

a.en: No. Overall diameter includes insulation. Conductor material, cross-sectional area and resistance must be checked independently.
a.zh: 不是。总外径包含绝缘层，需要独立检查导体材料、截面和电阻。

intro.en: Custom relay and fuse-box harnesses connect protected power feeds, switching circuits and vehicle loads in a serviceable assembly.
intro.zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束连接受保护馈线、开关控制回路与车辆负载，组成便于安装和维护的配电组件。

knowledge.en: Fuse selection, contact duty, conductor capacity, coil suppression and enclosure temperature must be coordinated.
knowledge.zh: 熔断器、触点任务、导体容量、线圈抑制与盒内温度需要协调设计。

notes.en: Provide the voltage, circuit diagram, load profile, connector details, mounting space and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供电压、原理图、负载曲线、连接器资料、安装空间与验证要求。

delivery.en: Released drawings, material approval, sample validation and controlled assembly define each production version.
delivery.zh: 通过图纸放行、物料认可、样品验证与受控组装定义每个生产版本。

faq.zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束常见问题

subtitle.en: Protected feeds, controlled loads and maintainable distribution
subtitle.zh: 受保护的馈线、可控的负载与可维护的配电

lead.en: A relay switches a load; a fuse interrupts specified overcurrent conditions. A complete harness connects both functions with power, trigger, return and output wiring. Builds range from a pre-wired relay socket and inline fuse holder to a multi-branch junction box with dedicated feeds, common busbars and option-specific connections. We develop the assembly around your equipment, circuit information and installation space.
lead.zh: 继电器负责接通和断开负载，熔断器在规定的过流条件下切断回路。完整线束把这两种功能与电源、触发、回流和输出导线连接起来。结构既可以是预接继电器插座与在线保险丝座，也可以是带独立馈线、公共母排和选装接口的多分支接线盒。我们根据设备、回路资料与安装空间开发适合项目的组件。

caption.en: Relay sockets determine terminal retention and service access.
caption.zh: 继电器插座关系到端子保持与维修可达性。

copy.en: Single-relay harnesses suit one controlled lamp, horn, pump or fan circuit. Dual-relay assemblies can separate two loads or operating modes; multi-relay fuse boxes organize several protected branches in one mounting location. Pre-terminated sockets, labeled outputs and defined mounting points simplify repeat installation. The assembly may include ring terminals, sealed connectors, inline fuse holders, a switch lead or an equipment-specific interface. Two relays do not automatically provide redundancy: a shared upstream fuse, feed or return remains a common failure point. Each branch therefore needs a documented purpose and protection path.
copy.zh: 单继电器线束适合独立灯具、喇叭、泵或风扇回路；双继电器组件可分开控制两组负载或工作模式；多继电器保险丝盒则把多个受保护分支组织在同一安装位置。预端接插座、输出标识与明确的安装点有助于重复装配。组件可以包含环形端子、密封连接器、在线保险丝座、开关引线或设备专用接口。两只继电器并不自动构成冗余，共用的上游保险丝、馈线或回流仍可能成为共同故障点，因此每个分支都需要明确的功能与保护路径。

caption.en: Stranded copper illustrates conductor construction, not an automotive material approval.
caption.zh: 多股铜线用于说明导体结构，不代表该示例线材已获得车用认可。

copy.en: Conductor area follows current, length, voltage drop, ambient temperature and bundling. Stranding supports flexibility, while the selected insulation grade must match heat, fluids and abrasion. PA or PBT housings, copper-alloy terminals, plating, seals and cavity plugs are reviewed as a matched system. The exact resin grade matters more than the polymer name alone. Split-loom tubing protects against mechanical contact but is not a watertight enclosure. A transparent relay cover does not establish switching capacity, and a ceramic socket does not remove the need to control terminal temperature. Material selection is recorded in the approved bill of materials.
copy.zh: 导体截面积应结合电流、长度、压降、环境温度与成束状态确定。多股结构有利于柔性，所选绝缘等级还需适应热、油液与磨损。PA 或 PBT 壳体、铜合金端子、镀层、线封与堵头需要作为配套系统审核，具体树脂牌号比聚合物名称本身更重要。开口波纹管提供机械防护，但不构成水密外壳。透明继电器盖不能证明开断能力，陶瓷插座也不能免除端子温升控制。最终用料应记录在批准的物料清单中。

caption.en: Mounted fuse positions illustrate branch organization and replacement access.
caption.zh: 保险丝安装位置对应分支组织与更换空间。

copy.en: Start with a load list that distinguishes continuous current, startup inrush, intermittent duty and abnormal conditions. Then coordinate the source feed, branch conductors, fuse characteristics, relay contacts and return path. Auxiliary-light kits may use the original lamp circuit only as a trigger, but that signal must first be checked for PWM, diagnostic pulses and controller limits. Cooling fans and pumps need an appropriate motor-load switching assessment. Winch or reversing-motor systems require a dedicated contactor and interlock review. We can develop a new assembly from released drawings or compare an existing sample with its circuit and equipment records before defining a replacement.
copy.zh: 先建立负载清单，区分持续电流、启动浪涌、间歇任务与异常状态，再协调能源端馈线、分支导体、熔断特性、继电器触点及回流路径。辅助灯套件可能仅把原车灯线作为触发信号，但必须先核对 PWM、诊断脉冲和控制器限制。冷却风扇与泵需要按电机负载评估开断任务；绞盘或换向电机系统则需要专用接触器与互锁审核。我们可以依据已放行图纸开发新组件，也可以结合回路和设备记录审核现有样品，再定义替换方案。

caption.en: Agricultural equipment introduces vibration, dust and field-service constraints.
caption.zh: 农业设备需要考虑振动、粉尘与现场维修条件。

copy.en: Passenger vehicles and commercial trucks use these assemblies for lighting, fans, pumps and body accessories. Agricultural and construction equipment add long routes, vibration, contamination and field repair. Emergency and specialist vehicles may require separated priority loads and defined backup-power boundaries. RV and custom-vehicle projects introduce parked loads, isolation and parasitic-current concerns. Marine projects require a separate review of salt exposure, installation location and applicable vessel requirements. These applications share a need for controlled distribution, but they do not share one universal fuse size, enclosure rating or wiring diagram.
copy.zh: 乘用车与商用卡车可用于照明、风扇、泵及车身附件供电；农业和工程设备还需考虑长路径、振动、污染与现场维修；应急及专用车辆可能需要分离关键负载并定义备用供电边界；房车与改装项目需要关注驻车负载、隔离和寄生电流；船用项目则另行审核盐雾、安装区域及适用船舶要求。这些应用都需要受控配电，但不共用一种通用保险丝规格、外壳等级或接线图。

caption.en: Electrical measurements support inspection; loaded tests require a defined fixture and method.
caption.zh: 电气测量用于辅助检验，受载试验还需明确夹具与方法。

copy.en: Verification begins with cavity-to-cavity continuity, polarity, isolation and relay operation against the released circuit. Loaded voltage-drop and temperature-rise checks reveal losses that a no-load continuity test cannot show. Insulation-resistance, dielectric, transient and environmental tests are specified for the actual assembly and customer requirements. Internal diodes, suppression devices or electronic modules may require isolation or different test connections. A test plan identifies operating conditions, sample configuration, instrumentation and acceptance limits. ISO 8820-2 provides automotive fuse-selection guidance; applicable fuse-family documents and component datasheets remain part of the project reference set. Listing a standard does not mean every assembly has passed its tests.
copy.zh: 验证从已放行回路对应的孔位导通、极性、隔离和继电器动作开始。受载压降与温升检查能够发现空载导通测试无法反映的损耗。绝缘电阻、耐压、瞬态和环境试验依据实际组件与客户要求规定；内部二极管、抑制器件或电子模块可能需要隔离或采用不同测试接法。试验计划应说明工作条件、样品配置、仪器与接收限值。ISO 8820-2 提供汽车熔断器选用指导，适用熔断器分册与元件数据表共同构成项目参考依据。列出标准不代表所有组件已经通过其中的试验。

caption.en: An installed fuse panel shows why access and identification belong in the layout.
caption.zh: 装车保险丝面板说明可达性与标识需要参与布局设计。

copy.en: A compact power-distribution module or junction box should shorten high-current paths while leaving room to remove fuses, open the lid, release terminals and use service tools. Busbar layout, cable exits, mounting orientation and branch bend allowances are established together. Dense packing also increases thermal interaction between adjacent devices; an open-air component rating cannot by itself demonstrate enclosed-box capacity. Spare cavities need defined plugs or approved terminals, and future options need a documented electrical budget. Compactness is useful when assembly, cooling and maintenance remain practical.
copy.zh: 紧凑的配电模块或接线盒应缩短大电流路径，同时保留保险丝拔取、盖板开启、端子退针和维修工具操作空间。母排布局、线束出口、安装方向与分支弯曲余量需要一起定义。高密度安装还会增强相邻器件间的热耦合，单个元件的开放空气额定值不能独立证明密闭盒内能力。备用孔位需要指定堵头或认可端子，后续选装回路需要明确电气余量。只有装配、散热与维护都可执行时，紧凑设计才真正有价值。

caption.en: A circuit-position label supports controlled assembly and later service.
caption.zh: 回路位置标识有助于受控装配与后续维修。

copy.en: Requirement review records the voltage, load profile, drawing, connectors, mounting and environment. Engineering then freezes the circuit table, BOM, branch dimensions, terminal orientation and inspection points. Samples are checked for fit, operation and agreed loaded conditions before the production version is released. Assembly controls cover cutting, stripping, crimping, terminal seating, seals, supports and labeling. Electrical inspection uses the approved circuit mapping; additional tests follow the order requirements. Delivery documentation can include the drawing revision, connection instructions, labels and agreed inspection records. Quantities, lead times and special validation are confirmed for each project.
copy.zh: 需求审核记录电压、负载曲线、图纸、连接器、安装与环境；工程阶段冻结回路表、BOM、分支尺寸、端子方向与检验点；样品完成装配适配、功能和约定受载条件检查后，再放行生产版本。组装控制覆盖下线、剥线、压接、端子就位、密封、支撑与标识。电气检查依据批准的回路映射执行，附加试验遵循订单要求。交付资料可以包括图纸版本、接线说明、标签与约定检验记录，数量、交期及特殊验证按项目确认。

caption.en: Rain represents exposure conditions, not a waterproof test of the product.
caption.zh: 雨景用于说明暴露环境，不表示产品已完成防水试验。

copy.en: Water resistance depends on the lid seal, wire seals, unused-cavity plugs, cable diameter and installed orientation. An IP claim applies only to a defined assembly and test condition. Vibration review includes relay retention, busbar support, connector locks and cable-exit strain. Heat soak and fluid exposure must be compatible with every material, including small seals and labels. Increasing contact resistance can create local heating even when current is below the fuse rating. Discoloration, loose terminals or repeated nuisance operation therefore call for fault investigation before a higher-rated fuse is considered.
copy.zh: 抗进水能力取决于盖板密封、线封、空孔堵头、线缆外径和安装方向，IP 声明仅适用于规定组件及测试条件。振动审核包括继电器保持、母排支撑、连接器锁止和导线出口受力。热浸及油液暴露需要与所有材料兼容，包括小型密封件与标签。即使电流低于保险丝额定值，接触电阻增大也可能造成局部发热。因此，出现变色、端子松动或反复异常熔断时，应先查明故障，再讨论是否调整保险丝规格。

title.zh: 熔断器类型与保护配合

caption.en: Fuse geometry, rating and holder compatibility must be checked together.
caption.zh: 熔断器结构、额定值与底座兼容性需要一起核对。

copy.en: Requests may specify ATO/ATC, MINI, low-profile MINI, MICRO2, MICRO3 or MAXI blade fuses, JCASE or MCASE cartridge formats, or MIDI and MEGA bolt-down types. These names identify different product families, not interchangeable approvals. Review the exact part number, rated voltage, interrupting capacity, time-current curve, pulse endurance and ambient-temperature derating. The fuse must coordinate with the conductor and fault-current source. A marked current rating is neither an instantaneous opening threshold nor permission to load the complete holder continuously at that value. Manufacturer data and the installed thermal condition govern the final selection.
copy.zh: 需求可能涉及 ATO/ATC、MINI、低矮型 MINI、MICRO2、MICRO3 或 MAXI 插片熔断器，JCASE、MCASE 盒式结构，以及 MIDI、MEGA 螺栓式类型。这些名称代表不同产品家族，不能视为可互换的认可。需要核对准确料号、额定电压、分断能力、时间电流曲线、脉冲耐受与环境温度降额，并使熔断器与导体及故障电流来源配合。标称电流既不是瞬时开断阈值，也不表示整个底座组件可以始终按该数值运行。最终选型以制造商资料及安装后的热条件为依据。

title.en: Relay Contacts, Coil Drive and Suppression

caption.en: Read the actual relay schematic and part number before assigning socket cavities.
caption.zh: 分配插座孔位前应核对实际继电器原理图与料号。

copy.en: Four-pin normally-open and five-pin changeover relays are common, but a second output terminal is not always a normally-closed contact. Mini ISO and micro relay packages also differ in terminal arrangement. Read the actual schematic, coil voltage, contact-load specification and suppression option before wiring the socket. Resistive, lamp, motor and capacitive loads impose different make and break duties. A diode across the coil introduces polarity and may delay release; resistor or other suppression choices must be coordinated with the driver and relay manufacturer. The printed contact current alone does not define switching life, enclosure temperature or total harness capacity.
copy.zh: 四脚常开与五脚转换继电器较常见，但第二个输出端不一定就是常闭触点；Mini ISO 与微型继电器封装的端子布置也可能不同。接线前应核对实际原理图、线圈电压、触点负载规格及抑制选项。电阻、灯具、电机和电容负载具有不同的接通与断开任务。线圈并联二极管会引入极性并可能延迟释放，电阻或其他抑制方式需要与驱动器及继电器制造商建议配合。壳体印刷的触点电流不能单独定义开关寿命、盒内温度或整套线束容量。

q.en: Can you build both a relay pigtail and a complete fuse-box harness?
q.zh: 能制作继电器尾线和完整保险丝盒线束吗？

a.en: Yes. The scope can include a pre-wired socket, fused single branch, dual-relay kit or multi-circuit distribution assembly. Drawings, load data, interfaces and installation requirements define the build.
a.zh: 可以，范围可包括预接插座、带熔断单路分支、双继电器套件或多回路配电组件，具体结构由图纸、负载资料、接口与安装要求定义。

q.en: Can the same assembly work on 12 V and 24 V?
q.zh: 同一组件可以同时用于 12 V 和 24 V 吗？

a.en: Only when every affected component and operating condition supports both systems. Relay coil voltage, suppression, fuse voltage rating, electronics and load behavior require explicit review.
a.zh: 只有相关元件与工况均支持两种系统时才可以，继电器线圈电压、抑制器件、熔断器额定电压、电子部件与负载行为都需明确审核。

q.en: Does a larger fuse solve repeated fuse failures?
q.zh: 反复烧保险丝可以直接换更大的吗？

a.en: Not without reviewing the fault, load, conductor and holder. A larger fuse can leave a smaller branch inadequately protected. Investigate shorts, overload, inrush, poor contact and thermal conditions first.
a.zh: 不能未经审核直接加大规格，更大保险丝可能使小线径分支保护不足。应先检查短路、过载、浪涌、接触不良和热条件。

q.en: Are all five-pin relays interchangeable?
q.zh: 所有五脚继电器都可以互换吗？

a.en: No. Contact arrangement, terminal assignment, coil voltage, suppression polarity, load ratings and package dimensions must match the released circuit and socket.
a.zh: 不能，触点形式、端子定义、线圈电压、抑制极性、负载额定值和外形尺寸都必须与放行回路及插座匹配。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide the system voltage, loads and duty cycles, schematic or sample, fuse and relay part numbers if specified, connectors, branch lengths, installation photographs, environment, labels, quantity and required tests.
a.zh: 请提供系统电压、负载与工作周期、原理图或样品、指定保险丝及继电器料号、连接器、分支长度、安装照片、环境、标签、数量和所需试验。

intro.en: Industrial equipment harnesses connect control cabinets, sensors, actuators, motors, I/O modules and field devices inside a machine or production line. The harness is defined by the equipment layout and electrical drawing rather than by a universal model.
intro.zh: 工业设备线束用于连接控制柜、传感器、执行器、电机、I/O模块和现场设备。它不是通用固定型号，而是依据设备布局、电气图和安装路径定义。

knowledge.en: Power, control and sensitive signal circuits may require different routing, conductor, shielding and identification strategies. Branch position, service loop, bend allowance and strain relief affect whether the harness can be installed and maintained correctly.
knowledge.zh: 动力、控制与敏感信号回路可能需要不同的布线、导体、屏蔽和标识方案。分支位置、检修余量、弯曲空间和应力消除会直接影响安装与维护。

notes.en: Confirm the equipment layout, connector or terminal-block models, pin or terminal numbers, voltage and current, cable path, ambient temperature, oil or abrasion exposure and maintenance method. Similar-looking interfaces cannot be matched by appearance alone.
notes.zh: 需要确认设备布局、连接器或端子排型号、针脚或端子编号、电压电流、布线路径、环境温度、油污与磨损情况以及维护方式。外形相似的接口不能只凭外观匹配。

delivery.en: Engineering first reviews the drawing, BOM and routing constraints, then confirms materials and builds a sample. Branch dimensions, labels, connector orientation and continuity are checked against the approved sample before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 先审核图纸、BOM和布线限制，再确认物料并制作样品；经确认的分支尺寸、标签、接口方向和导通关系将作为后续重复生产的依据。

subtitle.en: One category, many electrical architectures
subtitle.zh: 一个小类，覆盖多种设备架构

lead.en: Industrial equipment harness is not one fixed model. It covers the complete family of harnesses used between control cabinets, PLC and I/O modules, sensors, servo motors, actuators, safety devices and field equipment. We can develop anything from a short internal jumper to a complex multi-branch machine harness, based on your drawing, sample, pin table or equipment layout.
lead.zh: 工业设备线束不是一个固定型号，而是覆盖控制柜、PLC与I/O模块、传感器、伺服电机、执行器、安全装置和现场设备之间连接的一整类产品。从机柜内短跳线到复杂的多分支整机线束，都可以根据图纸、样品、针脚表或设备布局进行开发。

method.en: Industrial Equipment Wire Harness Making Method
method.zh: 工业设备线束制作方法

copy.en: Pre-routed links for PLC, HMI, relays, terminal blocks, switches and cabinet doors, with wire numbers and service loops defined for installation and maintenance.
copy.zh: 用于PLC、HMI、继电器、端子排、开关和柜门之间的预制连接，可按装配与维护需求确定线号、出线和检修余量。

copy.en: Power, encoder, brake and feedback circuits can be combined or separated according to the drive system, shielding strategy and installation path.
copy.zh: 依据驱动系统、屏蔽策略和安装路径，可将动力、编码器、制动和反馈回路合并或分开配置。

copy.en: Multi-drop branches connect proximity switches, encoders, valves and field I/O. Branch length, connector direction and signal separation are built around the equipment layout.
copy.zh: 通过多分支结构连接接近开关、编码器、阀组和现场I/O，分支长度、接口方向与信号隔离方式围绕实际布局设计。

copy.en: Sealed connectors, conduit, braid, grommets and branch protection can be combined for equipment exposed to dust, oil, vibration, splash or frequent service.
copy.zh: 针对粉尘、油污、振动、飞溅或频繁检修环境，可组合密封接头、波纹管、编织套、护线圈和分支防护。

copy.en: Compact jumpers and organized looms connect boards, displays, power modules and panel-mounted components where routing space and assembly order are limited.
copy.zh: 在布线空间和装配顺序受限的机箱内，使用紧凑跳线和成束布线连接电路板、显示器、电源模块及面板器件。

copy.en: For reciprocating motion, conductor construction, cable jacket, bend radius, travel, clamp points and connector strain relief are reviewed as one complete routing system.
copy.zh: 面向往复运动工况，将导体结构、护套、弯曲半径、行程、固定点和接口应力防护作为完整布线系统审核。

copy.en: Copper construction and wire size are selected from actual current, voltage drop, flexing, termination and temperature requirements, not from connector appearance.
copy.zh: 根据实际电流、压降、弯曲工况、端接方式和温度要求选择铜导体结构与线径，不以接头外观代替计算。

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, PUR, TPE or other specified materials are evaluated against temperature, oil, abrasion, movement, chemical exposure and the customer's applicable document.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、PUR、TPE或其他指定材料，需结合温度、油污、磨损、运动、化学环境及客户适用文件进行审核。

copy.en: Foil, drain wire, copper braid, textile braid, conduit and heat-shrink solve different electrical or mechanical problems; the termination method is defined with the system grounding plan.
copy.zh: 铝箔、排流线、铜编织、纺织编织、波纹管和热缩材料分别解决不同的电气或机械问题，屏蔽端接需与系统接地方案一起确认。

copy.en: Housing, terminal, seal and cable diameter must form a compatible system. Original references, mating-part data or physical samples help prevent a similar-looking but incorrect match.
copy.zh: 壳体、端子、密封件与线缆外径必须形成兼容系统；原始型号、对插件资料或实物样品有助于避免“外观相似但无法互配”。

title.en: Build from drawing or pin table

copy.en: We review circuit mapping, branch datum, connector direction, labels and installation constraints before a first article is released.
copy.zh: 在首件制作前审核回路对应、分支基准、接口方向、标识和安装限制。

copy.en: A reference harness can be measured and mapped, but electrical function, mating interfaces and any hidden components still require customer confirmation.
copy.zh: 可对参考线束进行尺寸与回路整理，但电气功能、对插接口及隐藏元件仍需客户确认。

copy.en: When the original part is difficult to source, alternatives are compared by fit, terminal system, electrical rating, sealing and documented approval, not by appearance alone.
copy.zh: 原物料供应困难时，从装配、端子系统、电气额定、密封和书面批准等方面比较替代方案，不只比外观。

title.zh: 从快速样品到重复生产

copy.en: Sample feedback is converted into a controlled drawing, BOM and inspection plan so later batches reproduce the approved configuration.
copy.zh: 将样品反馈转化为受控图纸、BOM和检验计划，使后续批次持续复现已确认配置。

copy.en: PLC cabinets, distributed I/O, conveyors, actuators, safety switches and assembly cells.
copy.zh: PLC控制柜、分布式I/O、输送线、执行器、安全开关与装配单元。

copy.en: Spindle auxiliaries, sensors, lubrication, cooling, doors and internal control connections.
copy.zh: 主轴附件、传感器、润滑、冷却、安全门和机内控制连接。

copy.en: Motors, photoelectric sensors, heaters, valves, weighing modules and replaceable machine sections.
copy.zh: 电机、光电传感器、加热元件、阀组、称重模块与可更换机组。

copy.en: Conveyors, sorters, lifts, mobile modules, proximity detection and field communication.
copy.zh: 输送机、分拣机、升降模组、移动单元、接近检测与现场通信。

copy.en: Low-voltage controls, pumps, fans, sensors and auxiliary systems in storage, treatment and monitoring equipment.
copy.zh: 储能、处理与监测设备中的低压控制、泵、风机、传感器和辅助系统。

copy.en: Instrument panels, acquisition modules, test fixtures, internal interconnects and replaceable interface leads.
copy.zh: 仪表面板、采集模块、测试工装、机内互连和可更换接口线。

copy.en: Drawing, sample, pin map, load, environment, quantities and installation limits.
copy.zh: 确认图纸、样品、针脚、负载、环境、数量和安装限制。

copy.en: Freeze routing, branch datum, connector orientation, protection and inspection points.
copy.zh: 定义回路、分支基准、接口方向、防护和检验点。

copy.en: Confirm wire, terminal, housing, seal, sleeve, label and any approved alternatives.
copy.zh: 确认线材、端子、壳体、密封、套管、标签与认可替代。

copy.en: Cut, strip, crimp, assemble, protect and form the harness to the reviewed data.
copy.zh: 依据审核资料完成下线、剥线、压接、组装、防护与成型。

copy.en: Check dimensions, connector direction, labels, continuity and other agreed project items.
copy.zh: 核对尺寸、接口方向、标签、导通及其他约定项目。

copy.en: Release the approved drawing, BOM, work instruction and inspection record for repeat orders.
copy.zh: 依据已批准图纸、BOM、作业文件和检验记录进行重复产出。

copy.en: Sealed connector systems, correct cable diameter, cavity plugs, conduit and branch protection are selected for the actual exposure and agreed test method.
copy.zh: 根据实际暴露环境和约定测试方法，选择密封接口系统、匹配线径、堵孔件、波纹管和分支防护。

copy.en: Clips, routing clearance, braid, conduit, grommets and strain relief reduce repeated rubbing and concentrated load at branches and connectors.
copy.zh: 通过卡扣、路径间隙、编织套、波纹管、护线圈和应力防护，降低重复摩擦及分支、接口的集中受力。

copy.en: Material temperature range, bend radius, travel and clamp spacing are reviewed against the machine's real duty cycle rather than a generic category claim.
copy.zh: 将材料温度范围、弯曲半径、行程和固定间距与设备真实工作周期对照审核，不作脱离项目的通用寿命承诺。

copy.en: Power and sensitive circuits are separated where needed; twisted pairs, shielding and grounding are defined from the controller and system architecture.
copy.zh: 按需要隔离动力与敏感回路，双绞、屏蔽和接地方式依据控制器与系统架构定义。

copy.en: Defined branches, labels and connector orientation reduce on-machine cutting, tracing and rework.
copy.zh: 明确的分支、标识和接口方向，减少现场裁线、查线和返工。

copy.en: Circuit identification, service loops and replaceable interfaces help technicians locate and replace a branch.
copy.zh: 回路识别、检修余量和可更换接口，帮助技术人员快速定位与更换分支。

copy.en: The approved sample is translated into controlled documents and inspection points for later production.
copy.zh: 把确认样品转化为受控文件与检验点，用于后续重复生产。

title.en: A design matched to your machine

copy.en: Electrical function, routing, service access and environment are handled as one project instead of forcing a stock harness into the machine.
copy.zh: 将电气功能、布线、维护空间与环境作为同一项目综合处理，不用现货线束生硬套入设备。

copy.en: Super Smile was founded in Shenzhen in 2023. Our 3,000 m² factory and team of more than 100 people support engineering review, harness processing, assembly and inspection. Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection before shipment; any additional electrical, mechanical or environmental test is defined according to the project.
copy.zh: 超斯迈尔于2023年成立于深圳，拥有3000㎡工厂和100余人团队，可完成工程审核、线束加工、组装和检验。成品出货前进行导通与外观检查，其他电气、机械或环境项目则按具体订单约定。

q.en: Does industrial equipment harness mean one standard product?
q.zh: 工业设备线束是一个固定产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a family covering cabinet, motor, sensor, I/O, sealed, internal and moving harnesses. The actual assembly is defined by your electrical and mechanical data.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖控制柜、电机、传感器、I/O、密封、机内及运动线束等多种结构，最终产品依据项目的电气与机械资料定义。

q.en: What can I send if I do not have a complete drawing?
q.zh: 没有完整图纸时可以提供什么？

a.en: A sample, connector photos, mating-part references, pin table, equipment layout and required lengths can start the review. Unknown electrical functions must still be confirmed before production.
a.zh: 可先提供样品、接口照片、对插型号、针脚表、设备布局和长度要求；不确定的电气功能仍需在生产前确认。

q.en: Can you make prototypes and small batches?
q.zh: 可以做样品和小批量吗？

a.en: Yes. Prototype and small-batch builds can be used to check fit, routing and electrical mapping before a controlled repeat order.
a.zh: 可以。可先通过样品或小批量确认装配、布线和电气对应，再转入受控的重复生产。

q.en: Can you match an existing connector?
q.zh: 可以匹配已有连接器吗？

a.en: We can review it from the original reference, mating connector data or a physical sample. A visual match alone is not enough to confirm the terminal, keying and seal system.
a.zh: 可通过原始型号、对插资料或实物样品进行审核；仅凭外观无法确认端子、防错和密封系统。

q.en: What is inspected before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前检查哪些项目？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Dimensions, polarity, insulation, pull force or other items are included when they are specified in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通和外观检查；尺寸、极性、绝缘、拉力或其他项目，按已批准项目计划执行。

q.en: How do you keep repeat orders consistent?
q.zh: 重复订单如何保持一致？

a.en: The approved sample, drawing revision, BOM, work instruction, label rule and inspection points are kept as the controlled production reference.
a.zh: 以已批准样品、图纸版本、BOM、作业文件、标签规则和检验点作为受控生产依据。

intro.en: Control panel harnesses organize the connections between switches, indicator lamps, relays, PLC or HMI modules, terminal blocks and external equipment. They are designed around the panel layout and service method.
intro.zh: 控制面板线束用于组织开关、指示灯、继电器、PLC或HMI模块、端子排与外部设备之间的连接，结构围绕面板布局和检修方式设计。

knowledge.en: Panel depth, component spacing, door movement and terminal access determine branch length and exit direction. Clear wire numbers, terminal labels and defined connector keying reduce assembly and maintenance errors.
knowledge.zh: 面板深度、器件间距、柜门运动和端子操作空间决定分支长度与出线方向。清晰的线号、端子标识和防错接口有助于减少装配与检修错误。

notes.en: Provide the panel drawing, component model list, terminal schedule, door or hinge movement, wire-number rules and connection table. Confirm whether the harness is supplied loose, mounted to the panel or delivered with specified accessories.
notes.zh: 建议提供面板图、器件型号清单、端子表、柜门或铰链运动范围、线号规则和接线表，并确认线束是散装交付、面板预装还是连同指定附件交付。

delivery.en: After a layout and terminal review, a first assembly is checked on the actual panel or an agreed fixture. Terminal positions, labels, branch lengths and continuity are recorded before batch assembly.
delivery.zh: 完成布局与端子审核后，首件可在实际面板或约定工装上核对；端子位置、标签、分支长度和导通结果确认后再进行批量装配。

subtitle.en: One category, many panel layouts and service methods
subtitle.zh: 一个小类，覆盖多种面板布局与检修方式

lead.en: A control panel harness is not a single fixed loom. It includes pre-routed connections for cabinet doors, operator panels, PLC and HMI modules, relays, terminal blocks, power supplies, field interfaces and replaceable control assemblies. We define every branch around the actual panel drawing, component spacing, hinge movement, wire-number rule and installation sequence.
lead.zh: 控制面板线束不是单一固定线型，而是覆盖柜门、操作面板、PLC与HMI模块、继电器、端子排、电源、现场接口及可更换控制组件之间预制连接的一整类产品。每条分支都围绕实际面板图、器件间距、铰链运动、线号规则和安装顺序定义。

method.zh: 控制面板线束制作方法

copy.en: Pre-routed branches connect pushbuttons, selector switches, indicator lamps, emergency stops and door-mounted devices while allowing the required hinge movement and service loop.
copy.zh: 通过预制分支连接按钮、选择开关、指示灯、急停及柜门器件，同时预留所需的铰链运动范围和检修余量。

copy.en: Organized interconnects link controllers, I/O modules, displays, communication modules and power supplies with defined pin routes and connector orientation.
copy.zh: 以明确的针脚路径和接口方向，组织控制器、I/O模块、显示器、通信模块与电源之间的连接。

copy.en: Cut-to-length wires, jumpers, ferrules, terminals and labels can be prepared for relay banks, terminal strips, breakers and contactors according to the approved connection table.
copy.zh: 可依据确认的接线表，为继电器组、端子排、断路器和接触器准备定长导线、跳线、管形端头、端子与标识。

copy.en: Pluggable branches provide a repeatable boundary between the cabinet and sensors, motors, valves, actuators or replaceable machine modules.
copy.zh: 通过可插拔分支，在控制柜与传感器、电机、阀组、执行器或可更换设备模组之间建立可重复装配的接口边界。

copy.en: Harnesses can be supplied loose, formed for a specific panel or installed with agreed accessories so the customer's assembly team receives a controlled wiring set.
copy.zh: 线束可以散装交付、按指定面板预成型，也可连同约定附件预装，使客户装配团队获得受控的布线套件。

copy.en: Short pigtails and detachable branches make frequently serviced switches, displays, fans or field interfaces easier to remove without disturbing the complete cabinet loom.
copy.zh: 短尾线与可拆分支便于更换经常检修的开关、显示器、风扇或现场接口，不必扰动整套柜内线束。

copy.en: Wire size, strand construction and temperature class are selected from actual current, voltage drop, termination method, cabinet temperature and applicable project documents.
copy.zh: 根据实际电流、压降、端接方式、柜内温度和项目适用文件选择线径、绞合结构与温度等级。

copy.en: PVC, XLPE, PTFE, TPE or specified wire families are reviewed together with ducting, sleeving, grommets and clearance from heat or sharp metal edges.
copy.zh: PVC、XLPE、PTFE、TPE或指定线材体系，需要与线槽、套管、护线圈以及热源和金属锐边间距一起审核。

copy.en: Heat-shrink markers, sleeves, printed labels, color rules and terminal references are arranged around the customer's drawing and maintenance practice.
copy.zh: 热缩标识、号码管、打印标签、颜色规则和端子编号，围绕客户图纸及维护习惯统一定义。

copy.en: Power, switching and sensitive signal circuits are separated where required. Twisted pairs, shields and grounding methods follow the controller and cabinet architecture.
copy.zh: 按需要隔离动力、开关量与敏感信号回路，双绞、屏蔽和接地方式依据控制器与柜体架构确定。

title.en: Build from panel drawing and connection table
title.zh: 依据面板图与接线表制作

copy.en: We review component positions, terminal references, branch datum, door movement, wire numbering and connector orientation before releasing the first assembly.
copy.zh: 首件制作前审核器件位置、端子编号、分支基准、柜门运动、线号规则和接口方向。

title.en: Develop from an existing panel or sample
title.zh: 依据现有面板或样品开发

copy.en: An existing harness or cabinet can provide routing and interface references, while electrical function and any hidden jumpers still require confirmation.
copy.zh: 现有线束或控制柜可用于整理布线路径与接口资料，但电气功能及隐藏跳接仍需确认。

copy.en: Defined labels, color coding, keyed connectors and branch grouping reduce terminal mistakes during panel assembly and later service work.
copy.zh: 通过明确标签、颜色规则、防错接口和分支归组，减少面板装配及后续检修中的接线错误。

copy.en: The project can cover loose harnesses, pre-formed routing sets, specified accessories or agreed panel-side installation, depending on the customer's assembly boundary.
copy.zh: 可按客户装配边界提供散装线束、预成型布线套件、指定附件或约定的面板侧预装。

copy.en: PLC cabinets, assembly cells, conveyors, robot peripherals, safety circuits and distributed I/O panels.
copy.zh: PLC控制柜、装配单元、输送线、机器人外围、安全回路与分布式I/O面板。

copy.en: Operator stations, heater controls, drives, sensors, valves and replaceable process modules.
copy.zh: 操作站、加热控制、驱动器、传感器、阀组和可更换工艺模组。

copy.en: Control panels for fans, pumps, dampers, thermostats, sensors and building automation interfaces.
copy.zh: 用于风机、泵、风阀、温控器、传感器和楼宇自动化接口的控制面板。

copy.en: Fixture panels, production cells, inspection stations, material handling and line-side service interfaces.
copy.zh: 工装面板、生产单元、检测工位、物料搬运及线边检修接口。

copy.en: Low-voltage monitoring, auxiliary power, pump control, distribution and equipment-room panels.
copy.zh: 低压监测、辅助供电、泵控制、配电和设备间控制面板。

copy.en: Instrument racks, acquisition panels, test fixtures, safety interlocks and replaceable test interfaces.
copy.zh: 仪器机架、采集面板、测试工装、安全联锁和可更换测试接口。

copy.en: Confirm layout, component models, terminal schedule, circuit function, labels, quantities and installation boundary.
copy.zh: 确认布局、器件型号、端子表、回路功能、标识、数量和安装边界。

copy.en: Define branch datum, service loops, hinge movement, duct entry, connector orientation and protection points.
copy.zh: 定义分支基准、检修余量、铰链运动、线槽入口、接口方向与防护位置。

copy.en: Confirm wire, ferrule, terminal, connector, marker, sleeve and any approved alternatives.
copy.zh: 确认线材、管形端头、端子、连接器、标识、套管及认可替代物料。

copy.en: Cut and strip to the reviewed data, then crimp, terminate, mark and protect every circuit.
copy.zh: 依据审核资料完成下线与剥线，并对每个回路进行压接、端接、标识与防护。

copy.en: Check branch reach, terminal access, door movement, duct entry and the agreed panel-side assembly method.
copy.zh: 核对分支到达、端子操作空间、柜门运动、线槽入口及约定的面板侧装配方式。

copy.en: Verify continuity, circuit mapping, polarity where applicable, labels, dimensions and agreed workmanship points.
copy.zh: 核对导通、回路对应、适用时的极性、标签、尺寸和约定工艺项目。

copy.en: Conductor size, insulation, terminals and protective components are reviewed from the real circuit load and project requirements, not from a generic panel category.
copy.zh: 导体、绝缘、端子及保护元件依据真实回路负载与项目要求审核，不以通用面板类别代替计算。

copy.en: Wire numbers, terminal references and service loops are arranged so technicians can trace and replace a branch without obscuring adjacent devices.
copy.zh: 通过线号、端子编号和检修余量，让技术人员能够追踪并更换分支，同时不遮挡相邻器件。

copy.en: Power and sensitive circuits, shield termination and protective grounding are defined from the complete panel and equipment architecture.
copy.zh: 动力与敏感回路隔离、屏蔽端接及保护接地方式，依据完整面板与设备架构确定。

copy.en: The customer identifies the applicable machine, panel or market requirements. Materials, inspection items and documents are then confirmed for that project; the category page does not claim universal certification.
copy.zh: 由客户明确适用的设备、面板或市场要求，再针对项目确认材料、检验项目和文件；本类别页面不作通用认证声明。

copy.en: Pre-cut lengths, defined labels and prepared terminals reduce on-panel measuring, stripping and tracing work.
copy.zh: 预定长度、明确标识和已完成的端接，减少面板现场量线、剥线和查线工作。

copy.en: Organized branches and documented terminal references help maintenance teams locate a circuit and replace a service branch.
copy.zh: 有组织的分支与记录明确的端子编号，帮助维护人员定位回路并更换检修分支。

copy.en: The approved panel harness is converted into controlled drawings, material data, label rules and inspection points.
copy.zh: 把确认的面板线束转化为受控图纸、物料资料、标签规则和检验点。

title.en: A harness matched to the panel

copy.en: Branch lengths, service access, door movement and connection order are developed as one assembly instead of adapting a generic loose-wire set.
copy.zh: 把分支长度、维护空间、柜门运动和接线顺序作为同一装配系统开发，不用通用散线套件勉强适配。

q.en: Is a control panel harness one standard product?
q.zh: 控制面板线束是固定标准产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a category covering door looms, controller interconnects, terminal wiring, panel-to-machine interfaces, pre-installed sets and service branches. The finished assembly follows the actual panel data.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖柜门线束、控制器互连、端子布线、面板至设备接口、预装套件和检修分支等结构，最终成品依据实际面板资料定义。

q.en: What information should be provided first?
q.zh: 首先需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: A panel layout, circuit or connection table, component models, terminal schedule, wire-number rule, hinge movement and delivery boundary are the most useful starting materials.
a.zh: 面板布局、回路或接线表、器件型号、端子表、线号规则、铰链运动范围和交付边界，是最有帮助的起始资料。

q.en: Can you match an existing panel harness?
q.zh: 可以匹配现有面板线束吗？

a.en: Yes. A sample or existing panel can be measured and mapped, but hidden jumpers, electrical function and mating references still require confirmation before production.
a.zh: 可以。可对样品或现有面板进行测量和回路整理，但隐藏跳接、电气功能及对插资料仍需在生产前确认。

q.en: Can labels and wire numbers follow our rules?
q.zh: 标签和线号可以按我们的规则制作吗？

a.en: Yes. The project can use the customer's numbering, color, sleeve, printed-label or barcode rules after the content and placement are approved.
a.zh: 可以。确认内容与位置后，可按客户的编号、颜色、号码管、打印标签或条码规则执行。

q.en: Can the harness be installed in the panel before delivery?
q.zh: 线束可以在交付前预装到面板吗？

a.en: The delivery boundary can include loose harnesses, pre-formed sets, specified accessories or agreed panel-side installation. The exact scope is confirmed during quotation and engineering review.
a.zh: 交付范围可以包括散装线束、预成型套件、指定附件或约定的面板侧预装，具体边界在报价与工程审核阶段确认。

q.en: Which tests are performed before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前进行哪些测试？

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Circuit mapping, polarity, dimensions, pull force, insulation or other items are included when specified in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查；回路对应、极性、尺寸、拉力、绝缘或其他项目，按已批准项目计划执行。

intro.en: Robotic harnesses carry power, control or sensor signals through moving axes, robot arms or end-of-arm tooling. Static cable construction is not automatically suitable for repeated bending or torsion.
intro.zh: 机器人线束用于在运动轴、机械臂或末端工具之间传输电源、控制或传感信号。适用于固定安装的线材，不一定适合持续弯折或扭转。

knowledge.en: Repeated bending, torsion and drag-chain travel create different mechanical loads. Bend radius, torsion angle, travel length, acceleration, clamping position and connector strain relief must be considered as one routing system.
knowledge.zh: 往复弯折、扭转和拖链运动产生的机械载荷不同。弯曲半径、扭转角度、行程、加速度、固定位置和接口应力消除需要作为一套运动系统共同评估。

notes.en: Do not select only by conductor count. Provide the robot or axis layout, motion video or path, expected cycle range, available bend radius, torsion angle, cable carrier information and electrical function. Actual life must be validated under the project motion profile.
notes.zh: 不能只按芯数选型。应提供机器人或运动轴布局、运动视频或路径、预期循环次数范围、可用弯曲半径、扭转角度、拖链信息和电气功能；实际寿命需按项目运动工况验证。

delivery.en: The sample stage confirms routing length, clamp points and connector orientation before motion testing by the customer or an agreed method. Production specifications are frozen only after the sample and motion conditions are accepted.
delivery.zh: 样品阶段先确认布线长度、固定点和接口方向，再由客户或按约定方法进行运动验证；样品与运动条件确认后，才冻结量产规格。

subtitle.en: Motion begins with the routing system
subtitle.zh: 运动可靠性从布线路径开始

lead.en: A robotic harness is a family of power, servo, brake, encoder, sensor, communication and tool-side assemblies developed around the real axis motion. Cable construction, bend radius, torsion, clamp position and connector support must work as one system.
lead.zh: 机器人线束是一类围绕真实轴运动开发的动力、伺服、制动、编码器、传感、通信及工具端组件。线材结构、弯曲半径、扭转、固定点和接口支撑必须作为同一系统协同设计。

copy.en: Power, brake, feedback and signal branches follow several rotating joints while maintaining defined service loops and supported transitions.
copy.zh: 动力、制动、反馈和信号分支随多个旋转关节运动，同时保持明确的检修余量与受控过渡。

copy.en: Compact moving assemblies require low-mass routing, stable branch geometry and clamp positions matched to acceleration and stroke.
copy.zh: 紧凑型高速机构需要低负载布线、稳定分支几何，并使固定位置与加速度和行程相匹配。

copy.en: Welding cells may combine power, control, cooling, sensing and tool circuits with protection selected for heat, sparks and mechanical contact.
copy.zh: 焊接单元可能同时包含动力、控制、冷却、传感与工具回路，并按热量、飞溅和机械接触选择防护。

copy.en: Replaceable grippers, vision units, valves and sensors can use a defined tool-side interface for quicker service and changeover.
